show:iron chef.name: Iron Chef
show:iron chef.summary: Iron Chef is an innovative cooking competition from Japan. Originally produced by Fuji TV, Iron Chef combined the excitement of a one on one sports competition with gourmet cooking. The title Iron Chef comes from the original Japanese title, Ironmen of Cooking. This innovative game show was always popular in its native Japan, but it found international success when the Food Network bought the series and began airing English dubbed episodes. It became a cult classic as viewers were treated to exotic ingredients and innovative cooking techniques. No expense was spared. Chefs seemed to have almost limitless supplies of the most exotic and expensive gourmet ingredients. The competition is hosted by Chairman Kaga, an over-the-top master of ceremonies. He introduced a "secret ingredient" that the challenger and the chosen Iron Chef had to incorporate into every dish.

show:unspeakable.name: Unspeakable
show:unspeakable.summary: Unspeakable chronicles the emergence of HIV and Hepatitis C in Canada in the early 1980s and the tragedy that resulted after thousands of people were infected by tainted blood. One of the largest medical disasters in Canadian history, the blood scandal triggered a federal inquiry and precedent-setting lawsuit resulting in billions of dollars in compensation to victims.

episodes:30871.name: Emergence
episodes:30871.summary: In 1982, two families, are badly shaken when they learn that a mysterious deadly disease called AIDS is threatening the blood system. Each has boys with hemophilia. The medical community struggles to understand the growing epidemic.

episodes:30871.name: Contraction
episodes:30871.summary: Will fights to get those in charge of blood safety to heed the danger. The Landrys struggle to keep their family together. Dr. Christos Tsoukas publishes a study on hemophiliacs.

episodes:30871.name: Heat-Treatment
episodes:30871.summary: In 1985 Will Sanders questions why the Red Cross may still be distributing tainted blood when safe, heat-treated product is available. Margaret Sanders battles the prejudice surrounding AIDS.

episodes:30871.name: Unsafe
episodes:30871.summary: In 1987, hemophiliacs untouched by AIDS believe blood products are safe. But one company's heat-treating process proves flawed and seven more people, five of them children, are infected. Brash and outspoken hemophiliac, Jim Krepke joins the fight. Will has a victory while Ben seeks direction. Alice and Peter try to pull themselves together.

episodes:30871.name: Compensation
episodes:30871.summary: Over the early 90's, victims of tainted blood begin to come forward and pressure the government with lawsuits. With Margaret's help, the Hemophilia Society works tirelessly behind the scenes for compensation. Lucky to avoid HIV, Ryan Sanders suffers through the side-effects of treatment for Hepatitis C. Peter meets Darby and despite his HIV, they fall in love. Having finished the archival history, Ben starts work on a more personal book but it causes further rift between him and Peter.

episodes:30871.name: Krever
episodes:30871.summary: In 1994, Justice Horace Krever is appointed to lead an inquiry into the tainted blood scandal. Shocking revelations and heart wrenching testimony are laid bare as he digs for the truth. Estranged from his family, Ben's quest for revenge is galvanized, as victims around him continue to die. Krever is halted when those he intends to accuse of misconduct take him to court.

episodes:30871.name: Intent
episodes:30871.summary: The supreme court rules in favour of Krever and his report finally comes out. It names many for wrongdoing and aims to rebuild the flawed blood system in Canada. While victims still suffer and loved ones mourn the dead, at least many feel that their voices were heard and those responsible were held accountable. But Ben is not satisfied and pushes for criminal charges.

episodes:30871.name: Apologies
episodes:30871.summary: As the criminal trial falls apart, Ben considers taking matters into his own hands. Peter and Ryan both struggle with illness while forging families of their own. In 2015, both of their lives hang in the balance as the tragedy finally threatens to catch up to them.

show:dr g medical examiner.name: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
show:dr g medical examiner.summary: Dr. G: Medical Examiner documents cases handled by deputy chief medical examiner Dr. Jan C. Garavaglia (aka Dr. G) of Florida's District Nine Medical Examiner's Office. Each episode features two or three cases Dr. G has handled in the Orlando area, and also in Bexar County, Texas and Jacksonville, Florida where she was previously employed. Some portions of the show have been dramatized and some names have been changed to protect the dignity of individuals and their families.

show:the wiggles.name: The Wiggles
show:the wiggles.summary: While performing songs for children, the Wiggles are joined by their many friends.

episodes:10576.name: Anthony's Friend
episodes:10576.summary: The Wiggles wake to find Anthony playing with his imaginary friend, Morty, the giant turtle. He listens to music, plays basketball and tells jokes. Is Anthony playing a trick on all of us, or does Morty really exist?

episodes:10576.name: Foodman
episodes:10576.summary: Inspired by a TV superhero, Anthony imagines himself being Foodman, who is able to eat tall sandwiches with a single bite, faster to the table than a speeding train, Foodman the hungry hero. Will Foodman save the day? Do the Wiggles need saving? If not, can he save himself?

episodes:10576.name: Murray's Shirt
episodes:10576.summary: The Wiggles are having a barbeque at the Wiggle House. Murray needs to change out of his red shirt and when he does, The Wiggles don't recognize him. After trying to convince them with his antics, Murray puts his red shirt back on again and The Wiggles once again know who he is. But is that Jeff in the floral shirt? Where has Jeff gone?

episodes:10576.name: Building Blocks
episodes:10576.summary: The Wiggles are having a building blocks competition. Greg and Jeff are competing against Anthony and Murray but Jeff has fallen asleep! What will Greg do? Will Jeff wake up in time? Can Greg and Jeff still win the game?

episodes:10576.name: Jeff the Mechanic
episodes:10576.summary: The Wiggles are preparing to go on tour but the Big Red Car is broken, so The Wiggles call the mechanic. But they have to wait such a long time for her to arrive that they have all fallen asleep except Jeff! Who will fix the big red car now?

episodes:10576.name: Lilly
episodes:10576.summary: Lilly Lavender the movie star visits the Wiggle House looking for a star for her next movie. All The Wiggles are auditioning but who will steal the show?

episodes:10576.name: Zardo Zap
episodes:10576.summary: Zardo Zap has arrived from outer space to visit Wiggle House. Will The Wiggles discover Zardo's trick? What will Zardo do next? Will the real Jeff return?

episodes:10576.name: The Party
episodes:10576.summary: The Wiggles are having a party for all their friends and are busy preparing all the food. But why does Anthony have a sore tummy? What will the guests think? Will there be enough food for everybody else?

episodes:10576.name: Wiggle Opera
episodes:10576.summary: Jeff falls asleep while listening to some opera music. It seems that whatever style of music Jeff listens to while asleep changes his behaviour!

episodes:10576.name: Haircut
episodes:10576.summary: It is a hot day at the Wiggle House and the hot weather is making Anthony's hair grow very quickly! The Wiggles decide to call Madame Bouffant to give Anthony a haircut. Is this a new look for Anthony? What will happen to Anthony's hair when the cold weather arrives?

episodes:10576.name: Muscleman Murray
episodes:10576.summary: Murray tries to make his muscles bigger when he buys himself a muscleman machine. After two hours on the muscleman machine Murray thinks he is strong enough to lift the very heavy weights, but is he?

episodes:10576.name: Spooked Wiggles
episodes:10576.summary: The Wiggles have been watching a scary movie with the lights off and are feeling spooked. But Dorothy the Dinosaur and Captain Feathersword have come to pay a visit to The Wiggles. The Wiggles start to hear noises outside and think a monster is lurking. Will The Wiggles discover Dorothy the Dinosaur and Captain Feathersword? Are they too spooked to know the difference? And is there another unexpected visitor outside?

episodes:10576.name: Funny Greg
episodes:10576.summary: Greg has lost his sense of humour and The Wiggles try to cheer him up by telling jokes and pulling funny faces. But they can't make Greg laugh. That is, until one of The Wiggles friends save the day. Who will it be?

episodes:10576.name: Food
episodes:10576.summary: Food is the flavour of the day and when the Wiggles start eating there are antics all 'round. Everyone has a favourite food except Anthony. He loves everything!

episodes:10576.name: Counting and Numbers
episodes:10576.summary: The Wiggles go through a number of counting adventures beginning with a colourful race. Captain Feathersword finds a heavy treasure chest and excitedly opens it, expecting a huge bounty only to find four bones perfect for Wags and the three Wagettes.

episodes:10576.name: Dancing
episodes:10576.summary: The Wiggles are all set to perform, but as usual, Jeff is asleep. The guys wake him, but there's another problem Anthony has lost his wiggle!

episodes:10576.name: Dressing Up
episodes:10576.summary: Dressing up is lots of fun particularly with the Wiggles. They help Henry shine his shoes and put on silly hats for Captain Feathersword's photograph. It's when they accidentally swap shirts though that things get weird. Each wearing the wrong coloured shirt, the guys end up with the wrong food and have to swap their shirts again to set things straight.

episodes:10576.name: Your Body
episodes:10576.summary: The Wiggles have fun discovering how different parts of their bodies help them every day.

episodes:10576.name: At Play
episodes:10576.summary: What does a Wiggle dream about? Magic tricks, bowls of pasta and flying, of course. The Wiggles wake from their dreams to have a picnic in Dorothy's rose garden. Just when they're starting to dance, Dorothy realizes that she can't join in properly she's lost her voice!

episodes:10576.name: Safety
episodes:10576.summary: The Wiggles love driving around Wiggle Town in their Big Red Car and what adventures they have! Their journey only begins when they're all wearing their seatbelts. Whilst the guys are out driving, Dorothy decides to prune some of her rose bushes using a very wobbly ladder. With one big wobble, the ladder falls and Dorothy is left hanging from the bush. The Wiggles soon come to the rescue and Dorothy promises never to stand on top of the ladder again.

episodes:10576.name: Story Telling
episodes:10576.summary: Even when it rains, The Wiggles still have loads of fun. This time, Dorothy joins the guys and entertains them with a tale. Captain Feathersword and Murray tell some tall tales about the creation of the Wiggle Rainbow whilst Jeff looks on. Anthony tries to make some carrot soup, but when Greg can't pull the rabbit out of the hat, he uses Anthony's carrot as the bait.

episodes:10576.name: Friends
episodes:10576.summary: The Wiggles have so many friends including Dorothy, Henry, Wags and of course, Captain Feathersword. Relaxing in their backyard, The Wiggles are remembering some of the fun times they've had with their pals. Dorothy comes over with some pasta and a great time is had by all.

episodes:10576.name: Multicultural
episodes:10576.summary: Everyone is different. The Wiggles show us how boring life would be if we were all the same. By eating the same food, sitting the same way, reading the paper and smelling flowers the same way, The Wiggles show us how much fun it is to be different.

episodes:10576.name: Music and Musical Instruments
episodes:10576.summary: The Wiggles can make music out of anything. From banging rocks in a cave to shaking milk cans, The Wiggles and their friends have a great time creating some fantastic sounds. The music bug pays a visit to Dorothy and then bites Captain Feathersword and Wags, sending them all into bursts of vibrant song and dance.

episodes:10576.name: Hygiene
episodes:10576.summary: If you can't see germs, how do we know how big they are? The Wiggles shrink down to germ size to demonstrate, so that we can only see them through a magnifying glass. Back to their normal size, The Wiggles show us how important it is to be clean and healthy.

episodes:10576.name: Animals
episodes:10576.summary: Animals are our friends and have a whole range of "super" senses that humans don't. Wags is no exception. He shows Captain Feathersword that he can run faster, bark louder and hear more than the Captain. Murray ponders what it's like to be snake and have the ability to slither around everywhere. He doesn't like it very much and decides he's happy to be a human.

episodes:10576.name: History
episodes:10576.summary: When the Wiggles find their dusty treasure chest under a tree, they begin remembering fun parts of their history. Pulling out their old video tapes, toys and tiny T-shirts, the Wiggles explain how much they've grown. We even see the Wiggles singing and dancing when they were little boys!

episodes:10576.name: Family
episodes:10576.summary: The Wiggles and their friends are like one big happy family. With a little help from their friends Dorothy the Dinosaur, Henry the Octopus and Captain Feathersword, the Wiggles show us that there are many different kinds of families.

episodes:10576.name: Movement
episodes:10576.summary: There's lots of laughter, colour, singing and dancing as the Wiggles and friends show us many ways of moving around.

episodes:10576.name: Nutrition
episodes:10576.summary: Eating good food gives you lots of energy and that's just what's needed to keep up with all the Wiggles' singing and dancing.

episodes:10576.name: Directions
episodes:10576.summary: It's usually not much fun being lost, but when the Wiggles lose their way to meet Dorothy the Dinosaur, it's an entirely different thing! Walking down Happy Street, Sad Street, Sneezy Street or Cold Street, the Wiggles find themselves going from laughter to tears and from sneezing to freezing. Thank goodness Officer Beaples is around to help them find their way.

episodes:10576.name: Manners
episodes:10576.summary: It's so important to have good manners even for a pirate. When Captain Feathersword interrupts the Wiggles writing songs, he's given a lesson on politeness.

episodes:10576.name: Travel
episodes:10576.summary: The Wiggles are ready to take Dorothy for a drive in the Big Red Car. They've promised to take her to the beach. Anthony packs lots of food and comics, Murray packs quite a few pieces of sporting equipment and Dorothy arrives with another load of things to take "just in case". The Big Red Car is full. They can't go anywhere. So, the Wiggles show disappointed Dorothy that there are many different ways of travelling - including the magical Wiggle way!

episodes:10576.name: Play
episodes:10576.summary: The Wiggles and their friends love to play and to play tricks. Once again Wags and the Wagettes play a trick on Captain Feathersword, making him believe that Wags the Dog has a magic stick. When he throws it, it comes back. When the Captain finds out that he has been tricked, there's laughter all round.

episodes:10576.name: The Body
episodes:10576.summary: It's incredible what the Wiggles can do when they look after their bodies by exercising and eating good food. After a work out with Dorothy the Dinosaur, they can sing, dance and still go to visit Captain Feathersword.

episodes:10576.name: Communication
episodes:10576.summary: Strange things are happening in Wiggle Town. Captain Feathersword worries his pirates as he learns "Doggy Talk" so that he can speak to Wags.

episodes:10576.name: Work
episodes:10576.summary: The Wiggles show us how much fun working can be. Trying to write new songs the Wiggles appear to be having so much fun that Dorothy doesn't even know they were working.

episodes:10576.name: Imagination
episodes:10576.summary: Sometimes all it takes to solve a problem is a little imagination. When Dorothy the Dinosaur's rose bush is being eaten by a munch worm, she uses her imagination and, with the help of Wags the Dog, solves the problem.

episodes:10576.name: Cows and Ducks
episodes:10576.summary: We all know how much Jeff likes to sleep. But sleepwalking too? Dreaming that he's a cow, Jeff wanders around Wiggle Town causing lots of fun and antics.

show:andromeda.name: Gene Roddenberry's Andromeda
show:andromeda.summary: Dylan Hunt is the courageous captain of the most glorious starship in the universe, the Andromeda Ascendant. After 300 years frozen in time at the event horizon of a black hole. Dylan Hunt wakes... to a universe in chaos. The Systems Commonwealth, the greatest civilization in history, has fallen. But together with an unlikely band of renegades and aliens who become his crew, Dylan begins his quest to rekindle the light of civilization and push back the evils that grip the universe!

previousepisode.name: The Heart of the Journey: Part 2

episodes:486.name: Under the Night
episodes:486.summary: The Commonwealth vessel Andromeda, captained by Dylan Hunt, in a last ditch effort to avoid a trap, maneuvers toward a nearby black hole.Time dilation near the black hole slows time for the Andromeda and Dylan until a freighter tows it out 300 years later. Dylan now must fight off the band of scavengers attempting to claim his ship as salvage.

episodes:486.name: An Affirming Flame
episodes:486.summary: Captain Dylan Hunt, attempting to drive the invaders from his ship, manages to scare off Gerentex. The remaining scavengers work with Dylan to regain engine control and break free from the gravity well.

episodes:486.name: To Loose the Fateful Lightning
episodes:486.summary: The crew find an old Highguard Space Station inhabited by the teen-aged decedents of the original crew. Harper finishes building Rommie, the Andromeda's Avatar.

episodes:486.name: D Minus Zero
episodes:486.summary: Confusion about the chain of command causes issues when the crew is attacked by Restorers.

episodes:486.name: Double Helix
episodes:486.summary: When the Andromeda tries to help in a conflict between the Than and a Nietchean pride, Tyr is offered a chance to join with the pride.

episodes:486.name: Angel Dark, Demon Bright
episodes:486.summary: Trance tries to pilot the Andromeda through slipstream and the crew travels back to a time just before the Commonwealth fell.

episodes:486.name: The Ties That Blind
episodes:486.summary: Answering a distress call from a Wayist vessel, Beka is surprised to find her brother aboard.

episodes:486.name: The Banks of the Lethe
episodes:486.summary: When Andromeda runs experiments on a black hole, Dylan sends a message into the black hole saying goodbye to his loved ones. The message is received by the woman he left behind, 300 years earlier.

episodes:486.name: A Rose in the Ashes
episodes:486.summary: While attempting to get the Arazians to rejoin the Commonwealth, Dylan is arrested for sedition and sentenced to life imprisonment.

episodes:486.name: All Great Neptune's Ocean
episodes:486.summary: Tyr disrupts a chancellor's visit by bringing up past deeds committed against Nietzscheans. After the chancellor is killed and Try is found unconscious, Andromeda's crew must find the culprit.

episodes:486.name: The Pearls That Were His Eyes
episodes:486.summary: Beka receives a message from her Uncle Sid, who seems to be be in urgent trouble.

episodes:486.name: The Mathematics of Tears
episodes:486.summary: While Trance has taken an unannounced vacation, Dylan and the rest of the crew investigate the remains of a derelict High Guard starship, the Pax Magellanic.

episodes:486.name: Music of a Distant Drum
episodes:486.summary: After Tyr loses his memory, he is befriended by a family while Nietchiens search for him and what he has stolen from them.

episodes:486.name: Harper 2.0
episodes:486.summary: After Harper is attacked by a dying Perseid, he gains a level of intelligence much greater than usual.

episodes:486.name: Forced Perspective
episodes:486.summary: A mission Dylan performed for the old Commonwealth comes back to haunt him.

episodes:486.name: The Sum of Its Parts
episodes:486.summary: When the Andromeda passes through a debris field, the crew is surprised to find the debris force its way into the ship and form an android, who claims to come in peace.

episodes:486.name: Fear and Loathing in the Milky Way
episodes:486.summary: While Trance and Harper are out on the Maru, they are surprised to find Gerentex aboard.

episodes:486.name: The Devil Take the Hindmost
episodes:486.summary: Dylan and Rev respond to a request for aid from Rev's former master.

episodes:486.name: The Honey Offering
episodes:486.summary: Two Nietchean prides will form an alliance and free two systems if the Andromeda will escort the bride-to-be to her wedding.

episodes:486.name: Star-Crossed
episodes:486.summary: A pod carrying a humanoid android escapes a freighter the Andromeda was attempting to protect before it was destroyed.

episodes:486.name: It Makes a Lovely Light
episodes:486.summary: Harper overrides some of Andromeda's protocols to fake a reactor meltdown to spring a surprise party for Dylan on his birthday.

episodes:486.name: ... Its Hour Come Round at Last
episodes:486.summary: When Harper accidently restores a backup of Andromeda's personality profile, she no longer recognizes the crew and presumes they are intruders.

episodes:486.name: The Widening Gyre
episodes:486.summary: Before going on a rescue mission with Rommie, Dylan orders Beka to use the Nova Bomb to destroy the Magog World Ship if he doesn't return.

episodes:486.name: Exit Strategies
episodes:486.summary: Under attack from Nietzscheans, the Maru, bearing parts for the repair of the Andromeda, crash lands on an arctic planet.

episodes:486.name: A Heart for Falsehood Framed
episodes:486.summary: Dylan Hunt is moderating negotiations between Doge Miskich and the Than Hegemony, which are complicated by Doge's possession of the Hegemon's Heart, a gem which is a sacred Than relic.

episodes:486.name: Pitiless as the Sun
episodes:486.summary: Andromeda helps when a planet's cargo vessels are attacked by unknown vessels. On the planet, Trance is interrogated about her past.

episodes:486.name: Last Call at the Broken Hammer
episodes:486.summary: The crew searches for people to organize the new Commonwealth.

episodes:486.name: All Too Human
episodes:486.summary: On a mission to find out about a weapon being developed, Rommie is discovered to be an AI. Her contact becomes wary because the AIs on his planet had revolted against their creators.

episodes:486.name: Una Salus Victus
episodes:486.summary: In an effort to allow the Andromeda and the unarmed fleet she is escorting to pass through a Drago-Kazov controlled system, Dylan and Tyr assault a base controlling old High Guard turrets along the route. Bekka takes the Maru to search for a ship that is separated from the convoy.

episodes:486.name: Home Fires
episodes:486.summary: The crew gets news of a colony that was formed when Dylan's fiancee escaped the fall of the Commonwealth.

episodes:486.name: Into the Labyrinth
episodes:486.summary: While the Andromeda is hosting a diplomatic conference, Harper encounters a reporter who offers to remove his Magog larvae in exchange for the information that had been downloaded into his brain.

episodes:486.name: The Prince
episodes:486.summary: With his dying breath, King Florin of Ne'Holland appoints Dylan and Tyr as his son Prince Erik's co-regents.

episodes:486.name: Bunker Hill
episodes:486.summary: The Sabra-Jaguar pride goes to war with the Drago-Kazov, pulling Dylan and the Andromeda along with them.

episodes:486.name: Ouroboros
episodes:486.summary: The Magog larvae in Harper's belly are close to hatching. Harper and Höhne work on a device to bend time and space to extract them.

episodes:486.name: Lava and Rockets
episodes:486.summary: Attacked while buying supplies, Dylan and Tyr separate. When Tyr escapes on the Eureka Maru, Dylan must find another way back to the Andromeda.

episodes:486.name: Be All My Sins Remembered
episodes:486.summary: Beka receives news of a former crew-mate's death and that she was named as next of kin in his will. As they travel to claim his belongings, Harper and Beka tell Dylan about their comrade.

episodes:486.name: Dance of the Mayflies
episodes:486.summary: Andromeda encounters a vessel badly damaged in a Than attack and rescues the survivors. The causalities from the vessel come to life and try to infect the crew.

episodes:486.name: In Heaven Now are Three
episodes:486.summary: Beka leads Trance and Dylan on a quest for the Engine of Creation.

episodes:486.name: The Things We Cannot Change
episodes:486.summary: While investigating a black hole, the Maru suffers a hull breach with Dylan on board. He wakes up to find himself in bed with his wife.

episodes:486.name: The Fair Unknown
episodes:486.summary: The Andromeda finds a Calderan ship ravaged by what appears to be a Vedran, the creator race of the first Commonwealth.

episodes:486.name: Belly of the Beast
episodes:486.summary: Andromeda investigates a mythical beast that eats planets. They soon discover it's real and are promptly swallowed by the beast.

episodes:486.name: The Knight, Death, and the Devil
episodes:486.summary: Andromeda gets word of a fleet of Highguard ships in Tartarus. The crew goes after Ryan, an AI with knowledge of the location.

episodes:486.name: Immaculate Perception
episodes:486.summary: When the Knights of Genetic Purity start attacking a cluster of Nietchean prides, Andromeda tries to stop them.

episodes:486.name: Tunnel at the End of the Light
episodes:486.summary: Dylan is hosting the signing of the New Commonwealth charter on board the Andromeda when they are attacked by a Pandimensional Species. Ships coming from another universe through a dimensional tunnel fight the Andromeda and Nietzschean and Commonwealth fleets. Beka and Tyr try to close the tunnel by launching a Nova bomb from the Maru.

episodes:486.name: If the Wheel Is Fixed
episodes:486.summary: After the Maru returns to the Andromeda with no one aboard, Beka and Tyr materialize on the Andromeda with no explanation. The crew tries to keep the Andromeda from falling into the dimensional tunnel.

episodes:486.name: The Shards of Rimni
episodes:486.summary: After Dylan receives a package and takes Harper on a secret mission, he becomes a wanted man.

episodes:486.name: Mad to Be Saved
episodes:486.summary: Andromeda saves a damaged freighter that was venting oxygen. The crew's leader informs Dylan that they have escaped from a hellish slave world that no one has ever escaped from before.

episodes:486.name: Cui Bono
episodes:486.summary: Dylan and the Andromeda are ordered by the reformed High Guard to transport and protect a candidate for election to Second Triumvir of the New Commonwealth—Beka's "Uncle" Sid.

episodes:486.name: The Lone and Level Sands
episodes:486.summary: While being chased by Ogami, the Maru is rescued by the Bellerophon, a long lost starship from Earth.

episodes:486.name: Slipfighter the Dogs of War
episodes:486.summary: Andromeda is hit by massive shockwaves emanating from a star going supernova, and signs point towards the use of a weapon similar to a Nova bomb.

episodes:486.name: The Leper's Kiss
episodes:486.summary: A founding father of the New Commonwealth contacts Dylan to help in taking down a very deadly assassin named "the Leper" who is currently targeting him.

episodes:486.name: For Whom the Bell Tolls
episodes:486.summary: A stowaway creature is discovered devouring the Maru's electronics. Unable to stop the creature from moving to the Andromeda and reproducing, the crew must find the creatures before they permanently cripple the ship.

episodes:486.name: And Your Heart Will Fly Away...
episodes:486.summary: An unknown armored man appears on the command deck of the Andromeda and engages Dylan in combat. When defeated, the man shatters into dark matter particles that infect the Andromeda's guidance system.

episodes:486.name: The Unconquerable Man
episodes:486.summary: In an alternate timeline, Gaheris Rhade takes command of the Andromeda and attempts, with the aid of the crew of the Maru and a hologram of Dylan, to reestablish the Commonwealth and drive back the Magog threat.

episodes:486.name: Delenda Est
episodes:486.summary: Harper and Rommie encounter a cat—a species that has been extinct for hundreds of years; general malfunctions and space-time distortions plague the Andromeda.

episodes:486.name: The Dark Backward
episodes:486.summary: Trance sees a probable future that results in the deaths of the entire crew and the destruction of the Andromeda.

episodes:486.name: The Risk All Point
episodes:486.summary: On their way to the launching of the first new Commonwealth starship in over three hundred years, Dylan, Beka, and Tyr warn of an incoming Nietzschean battle group. Their suspicions that there is an agent on board the starship are confirmed when it is destroyed. Survivors in escape pods discover that the pods are leaking air.

episodes:486.name: The Right Horse
episodes:486.summary: Beka is called as a character witness for a friend on a planet where lying and deception are punishable crimes.

episodes:486.name: What Happens to a Rev Deferred?
episodes:486.summary: The crew gets a message from Rev Bem. He's on a planet that's about to be destroyed. The Andromeda goes after the wayward Magog.

episodes:486.name: Point of the Spear
episodes:486.summary: A newly colonized planet of the Commonwealth comes under attack by Pyrian "pyroformers", but when Dylan destroys the machines, the Pyrian fleet arrives to defend its property.

episodes:486.name: Vault of the Heavens
episodes:486.summary: While in command of the Andromeda during the night shift, Harper causes a malfunction in the engine that could cause the destruction of the Andromeda.

episodes:486.name: Deep Midnight's Voice
episodes:486.summary: The Andromeda gets caught in the middle of a battle between two Nietzschean prides.

episodes:486.name: The Illusion of Majesty
episodes:486.summary: The Andromeda saves a hibernation capsule from destruction, but sustains heavy damage at the hands of its pursuers, who demand that Dylan return the inhabitant, their princess, to their custody.

episodes:486.name: Twilight of the Idols
episodes:486.summary: Andromeda encounters a group whose leader claims to have a connection to the old Commonwealth.

episodes:486.name: Day of Judgement, Day of Wrath
episodes:486.summary: Gabriel's core personality, which has been hiding inside Rommie's mind, decides to strike during the launching of the Commonwealth's newest High Guard ship.

episodes:486.name: Shadows Cast by a Final Salute
episodes:486.summary: Tyr has convinced the Nietcheans he is the genetic reincarnation of Drago Museveni, the progenitor of his race. He forces Dylan to choose between saving the Andromeda crew or the Drago-Katzoff pride.

episodes:486.name: Answers Given to Questions Never Asked
episodes:486.summary: Andromeda encounters the remainders of the Commonwealth Fleet, whose leaders went into hiding when fighting broke out. The search form them leads to the All Forces Nullification Point.

episodes:486.name: Pieces of Eight
episodes:486.summary: After the governing body of the Commonwealth votes no-confidence in triumvir Tri-Jema, she sends Dylan visit an augur who is said to be infallible. Dubbed Citizen Eight, the augur aims to take Tri-Jema's place as triumvir and remove Dylan from command of the Andromeda.

episodes:486.name: Waking the Tyrant's Device
episodes:486.summary: Dylan, sent on a mission by a triumvir, discovers that the moon that is the target of the mission is the base of Kroton, the half-human, half-android genius that created the Magog world-ship.

episodes:486.name: Double or Nothingness
episodes:486.summary: The Andromeda investigates the site of a reported Nietzschean attack on a Commonwealth battleship, but find no debris and no sign that any conflict occurred.

episodes:486.name: Harper/Delete
episodes:486.summary: Andromeda comes between two Nietzschean siblings. One has a weapon that can eliminate higher brain functions; the other holds her nephew hostage.

episodes:486.name: Soon the Nearing Vortex
episodes:486.summary: Tyr returns. He's sided with the Collectors against his former crew and he wants the map for the Route of Ages.

episodes:486.name: The World Turns All Around Her
episodes:486.summary: The Collectors tell Tyr that the map for the Route of Ages is a map to the Abyss it. The crew of the Andromeda has the map but Tyr has Beka.

episodes:486.name: Conduit to Destiny
episodes:486.summary: The Andromeda receives a distress call from a Commonwealth prison experiencing a riot.

episodes:486.name: Machinery of the Mind
episodes:486.summary: When one scientist is kidnapped and others are killed at a conference on dealing with the Magog threat, the crew must figure out who is responsible. Meanwhile Dylan is kidnapped by the Collectors.

episodes:486.name: Exalted Reason, Resplendent Daughter
episodes:486.summary: The daughter of a king is kidnapped by a ruthless renegade. But when the crew finds her, she says her father tried to kill her, and the renegade is actually a hero.

episodes:486.name: The Torment, the Release
episodes:486.summary: The Collectors now control the Commonwealth. Dylan and the crew are put on trial.

episodes:486.name: The Spider's Stratagem
episodes:486.summary: Andromeda captures a smuggler with a shipment of bioarmor. They try to track down the origins of the armor, but there's more to the armor than they first realize.

episodes:486.name: The Warmth of an Invisible Light
episodes:486.summary: When Dylan activates an experimental cloaking device, he gets swept into an alternate dimension.

episodes:486.name: The Others
episodes:486.summary: The Andromeda encounters two ships from a planet where they have been fighting for as long as anyone can remember.

episodes:486.name: Fear Burns Down to Ashes
episodes:486.summary: Rev Bem says he knows of a weapon against the Abyss; he will only show Dylan in person.

episodes:486.name: Lost in a Space That Isn't There
episodes:486.summary: The Abyss has infected Beka; the crew must find a way to free her of the Abyss.

episodes:486.name: Abridging the Devil's Divide
episodes:486.summary: Dylan, Harper and Rhade are captured by Templars. Beka, Trance and Rommie track down a smuggler.

episodes:486.name: Trusting the Gordian Maze
episodes:486.summary: An emissary from Tri-Gemma arrives, claiming that she is still on the crew's side, despite the current circumstances. Is she telling the truth or is she after something?

episodes:486.name: A Symmetry of Imperfection
episodes:486.summary: Rommie has become too emotional; the Andromeda cuts off her access and runs a full diagnostic, disabling many of the ship's resources.

episodes:486.name: Time Out of Mind
episodes:486.summary: A man from Beka's past, posing as a Wayist, is killed by agents of the Abyss. The crew must find what he was after before the Abyss finds it.

episodes:486.name: The Dissonant Interval: Part 1
episodes:486.summary: The Andromeda rescues a defenseless ship from former Commonwealth fighters. The occupants are an ambassador and his pilot, returning to Arkology from successful peace negotiations with the Magog on board the World-Ship.

episodes:486.name: The Dissonant Interval: Part 2
episodes:486.summary: With the Magog World-Ship at hand, Dylan must defend Arkology as one of the Paradine, beings said to have witnessed the creation of the universe.

episodes:486.name: The Weight: Part 1
episodes:486.summary: Dylan exits the route of ages and ends up on Seefra. The beings on Seefra have limited technology and no escape from the system.

episodes:486.name: The Weight: Part 2
episodes:486.summary: Beka has joined a salvage crew that ends up on Seefra. The crew leader has found the Andromeda, but Dylan still has a claim to it.

episodes:486.name: Phear Phactor Phenom
episodes:486.summary: Dylan finds Harper, but Harper's not happy to see his former boss; he's adjusted to life on Seefra.

episodes:486.name: Decay of the Angel
episodes:486.summary: Doyle is plagued by nightmares and half-remembered dreams of life on board the Andromeda, but she was never a member of the crew.

episodes:486.name: The Eschatology of Our Present
episodes:486.summary: Beka receives a message from Virgil Vox, the radio personality, concerning a secret from her past.

episodes:486.name: When Goes Around...
episodes:486.summary: A new woman arrives in town seeking Dylan's aid. She reveals that she was a Commonwealth scientist before it fell and that she is trapped in a time loop.

episodes:486.name: Attempting Screed
episodes:486.summary: The return of Flavin sparks a conflict between two rival gangs over who gets his ship and the bounties within.

episodes:486.name: So Burn the Untamed Lands
episodes:486.summary: Harper discovers a new weapon in the system that is powered by a crystal, which Harper feels will be able to power the Andromeda.

episodes:486.name: What Will Be Was Not
episodes:486.summary: A bar fight spills out into the streets and a remark from Rhade aimed at Dylan drives Trance over the edge, causing her to leave the Andromeda.

episodes:486.name: The Test
episodes:486.summary: After Rhade, Harper, and Beka each have dealings with the Stranger, he is murdered. Now they're all on trial for his death.

episodes:486.name: Through a Glass Darkly
episodes:486.summary: While Rhade is busy defending refugees on Seefra Five from the army of a local warlord, Dylan is surprised to find Höhne, the Perseid scientist thought to be dead.

episodes:486.name: Pride Before the Fall
episodes:486.summary: Beka's new boyfriend turns out to be more than she suspected.

episodes:486.name: Moonlight Becomes You
episodes:486.summary: While Beka, Harper, Rhade, and Doyle are searching for Vedran treasure, they find a door that is rumored to reveal a test that if passed will yield great wealth, but if failed will cause madness.

episodes:486.name: Past Is Prolix
episodes:486.summary: Harper discovers a program built into the Seefra system that can destroy eight of the planets. Dylan begins plans to evacuate the eight planets, but is interrupted by a new arrival through the Route of Ages.

episodes:486.name: The Opposites of Attraction
episodes:486.summary: While Harper develops a way to save the Seefra system from its impending doom, a spy has slipped aboard the Andromeda.

episodes:486.name: Saving Light from a Black Sun
episodes:486.summary: When the blinking sun of the Seefra system goes dark for an extended period of time, Dylan takes the opportunity to study the workings of the artifact in hopes of finding a way to fix it.

episodes:486.name: Totaled Recall
episodes:486.summary: Dylan is gravely wounded in a lab accident, but wakes up in the bar with Harper telling bad jokes.

episodes:486.name: Quantum Tractate Delirium
episodes:486.summary: As Trance's sun closes on Seefra-9, Doyle rebuilds Rommie to help evacuate the planet.

episodes:486.name: One More Day's Light
episodes:486.summary: Dylan deals with the residents of Seefra One, who are unhappy with the number of refugees arriving on their planet.

episodes:486.name: Chaos and the Stillness of It
episodes:486.summary: Harper is captured by General Burma, a man who believes all technology to be evil.

episodes:486.name: The Heart of the Journey: Part 1
episodes:486.summary: Dylan and his crew deal with the survivors on Seefra One.

episodes:486.name: The Heart of the Journey: Part 2
episodes:486.summary: Analyzing fragments of the destroyed Earth, Romy finds radical isotopes, proof that the Abyss aided the Nietzscheans in the destruction of the planet.

show:the rifleman.name: The Rifleman
show:the rifleman.summary: Lucas McCain is an ex-soldier who loses his wife after the birth of one son, Mark. Lucas and Mark move to North Fork and attempt to make a living as farmers. However, outlaws and criminals ride into North Fork regularly, and Lucas' past comes back to haunt him from time to time. Inevitably, Lucas has to pick up his rifle and uses his marksmanship skills to deal with trouble.

episodes:3877.name: The Sharpshooter
episodes:3877.summary:
Lucas and Mark decide to enter a local turkey shoot to raise money to buy a ranch. The competition pits Lucas against the young sharpshooter, Vernon Tippert, who is sponsored by his bullying uncle, Wes Tippert. Although Vernon is a crack shot, he is no match against Lucas's superior skills as a marksman. The dramatic tension in "The Sharpshooter" turns on McCain throwing the match after the competition's promoter threatens to harm Lucas' young son should Tippert lose the competition. The unfolding story shows Lucas McCain reconciling the moral dilemma of protecting his young son and participating in a rigged competition.

"The Sharpshooter" introduced not only the main characters, setting and back story for THE RIFLEMAN series, but also established its thematic distinctions from other popular western adventure programs produced during the Golden Age of television. To be sure, the staples of the genre inform THE RIFLEMAN's storylines—law and order, right and wrong, pioneer spirit and rugged individualism—but the central themes revolve around the father and son relationship—the first primetime television series to portray a single parent raising a child alone—and nuanced morality plays that explored human nobility and very human frailties, foibles and failings, as well as the archetypal white-hatted good guys and black hatted bad guys and outlaws.

episodes:3877.name: Home Ranch
episodes:3877.summary: Two tough hired hands beat up Lucas and burn his ranch house, when he refuses their demands that he move off the property in order to please a wealthy cattleman who has been using the ranch as grazing land. On foot, Lucas pursues the gunmen, finds himself facing their boss and is challenged to a vicious fistfight.

episodes:3877.name: End of a Young Gun
episodes:3877.summary: Lucas is forced to give refuge to a young bank robber who has been injured while saving the life of Lucas' young son Mark. Trouble ensues when the rest of the outlaw gang appear. The young robber has had a change of heart and wants to go straight, but the gang insists that he will rejoin them. Wanting to help the young man, Lucas is caught in the fight.

episodes:3877.name: The Marshal
episodes:3877.summary: Micah Torrance, formerly a famous Marshal, but now a drunken derelict with a crippled arm from a gunfight, turns up in North Folk and is taken on as a hired hand by Lucas McCain, who wants to give the man a chance to rehabilitate himself. His good deed backfires when three outlaws ride into town bent on avenging themselves for past troubles with Micah. The outlaws kill the local sheriff, leaving Lucas and Micah to protect the town alone.

episodes:3877.name: Eight Hours to Die
episodes:3877.summary: A vengeful judge is convinced that Lucas is responsible for the death of his son, an outlaw who was executed for murder. He captures Lucas and plans to force him to watch Mark hang in retribution for his son's death.

episodes:3877.name: Duel of Honor
episodes:3877.summary: When the stagecoach breaks down in North Fork an Italian Count, Alfredo di Montova, has to spend the night at the hotel. His fancy dress and accented English makes him a target for town bully Sim Groder and his little crowd. The Count is a calm and collected type but when Groder pushes him too far, he challenges him to a duel. With Lucas acting as his second, di Montova teaches the bully a lesson.

episodes:3877.name: The Safe Guard
episodes:3877.summary: A Texas gunslinger is hired to protect the bank of North Fork. When he appears at the McCain Ranch, he doesn't leave a very good impression with Lucas, and for good reason - he has a secret. Mark is proud when he sells his first pig.

episodes:3877.name: The Sister
episodes:3877.summary: Mark introduces the pretty Rebecca Snipe to his father, and her two burly brothers are convinced that Lucas would be a fine husband for their sister. Meanwhile three gunmen plot to kill the rancher.

episodes:3877.name: New Orleans Menace
episodes:3877.summary: A gambler, fleeing New Orleans with his henchmen, takes a liking to Lucas' ranch. When McCain refuses to sell, his life is threatened.

episodes:3877.name: Young Englishman
episodes:3877.summary:
Lucas accuses the young foreman of a neighboring ranch of rustling one of his calves.

Guest Stars:Allen Case, James Coburn, Ted de Corsia and Dick Rich

episodes:3877.name: The Gaucho
episodes:3877.summary:
Lucas helps an Argentinian family who are new to North Fork when they are ridiculed by others.

Guest Stars:Perry Lopez, Lawrence Dobkin, Chana Eden, Dennis Cross, Harlan Warde, Stuart Randall, Robert L. Crawford, Jr., Morris Lippert, Montie Montana and Lauren Janes

episodes:3877.name: The Pet
episodes:3877.summary:
Lucas allows Mark to take in a homeless horse after its owner is killed in a gunfight. Lucas soon discovers the truth about the horse and has to fight a gunman who does not want his secret to be exposed.

Guest Stars:Robert J. Wilke, Bill Erwin, Hal John Norman and Edgar Buchanan

episodes:3877.name: The Sheridan Story
episodes:3877.summary:
Wanting to teach Mark about tolerance and acceptance, Lucas hires an injured and bitter confederate soldier (Royal Dano) to work on his ranch, only the Union army also arrives at the farm.

Guest stars:Lawrence Dobkin, Frank Wilcox, Bill Meigs, Stephen Chase, Fritz Ford and Royal Dano

episodes:3877.name: The Retired Gun
episodes:3877.summary:
A famous gunman (Robert Webber) promises his new bride that he will retire from gunfighting and settle in North Fork, but five outlaws try to make him break his promise.

Guest Stars: Eileen Harley, Jack Kruschen, John Anderson, Duke Snider, Joe Mell, Herman Rudin and Robert Webber

episodes:3877.name: The Indian
episodes:3877.summary: Lucas McCain and his son Mark come across U.S. Deputy Marshal Sam Buckhart who is escorting an Indian prisoner. To Lucas' surprise he finds that Buckhart himself is an Indian, educated at Harvard College. In North Fork, Buckhart goes about his business until some of the townsfolk realize he is an Indian and decide to take matters into their own hands. It's left to Lucas to show them the error of their ways.

episodes:3877.name: The Second Witness
episodes:3877.summary: As the second witness of a murder, Lucas is asked to travel to another town to testify at the accused man's trial. The catch is, the only other witness has been murdered and his killer has not been identified.

episodes:3877.name: The Trade
episodes:3877.summary: An outlaw will surrender if his sweetheart gets the reward.

episodes:3877.name: One Went to Denver
episodes:3877.summary: Lucas welcomes an old friend who turns up at his ranch for an unexpected visit. Knowing that his friend Tom Birch has a reputation for lawlessness, Lucas is at first concerned but then is reassured by Tom's statement that he is just passing through North Fork on his way to Denver. Later, however, Lucas finds himself involved in a plot to rob the North Fork Bank and must choose between backing up the Marshal and helping the friend who once saved his life.

episodes:3877.name: The Deadly Wait
episodes:3877.summary: Dan Maury, a criminal arrested by Micah Torrance, returns from five years in prison determined to avenge himself upon the town marshal.

episodes:3877.name: The Wrong Man
episodes:3877.summary: A corrupt marshal from outside North Fork goes after an outlaw with a price on his head. However, he sees an opportunity to make some extra money, so he murders an innocent man to pass off as the outlaw so he can collect the bounty, and then proceeds to blackmail the real outlaw.

episodes:3877.name: The Challenge
episodes:3877.summary: An escaped killer is out to prove that his time in prison hasn't slowed down his speed with a gun.

episodes:3877.name: The Money Gun
episodes:3877.summary: Bookkeeper Asa Manning (William Phipps) hires a professional gunman (John Dehner) to provoke Oat Jackford (Bert Freed), a bully rancher who suspects him of embezzlement, into a gunfight. Lucas is forced to assist Jackford, the man he once hated.

episodes:3877.name: A Matter of Faith
episodes:3877.summary: A drought has forced local cowhands to seek work on a railroad construction project and railroad executives are afraid that their workers will desert them when an old man (Royal Dano) claims to have found a way to make rain.

episodes:3877.name: Blood Brothers
episodes:3877.summary: Lucas is surprised when Micah wishes death on a dying man (Max Wagner) he brings into North Fork, then Lucas discovers that Micah holds a big secret.

episodes:3877.name: Stranger at Night
episodes:3877.summary: Mark stumbles across a dead man and the only clue to his identity is a belt with the initials RM.

episodes:3877.name: The Mind Reader
episodes:3877.summary:
Accused of a murder he did not commit, a young man (Michael Landon) is finally cleared by the accidental discovery of a "mind reader" (John Carradine).

Guest Stars:John Carradine, Michael Landon, Sue Randall, Steven Ritch, Vic Perrin, Robert Bice, William Schallert, James Chandler, John Harmon and Charles Seel

episodes:3877.name: The Patsy
episodes:3877.summary: Three gunfighters (John Anderson, Steven Marlo, Dennis Cross) use a cowardly barber (Whit Bissell) and his son to talk Lucas into a gunfight so they can kill Lucas and take over the town.

episodes:3877.name: Bloodlines
episodes:3877.summary:
After Lucas is blamed for killing a young man, an outlaw father and his two sons attempt to kill Lucas.

Guest stars:Denver Pyle, Warren Oates, Christopher Dark, Buddy Hackett, Rhys Williams, Bill Quinn, Archie Butler, and Whitey Hughes

episodes:3877.name: The Blowout
episodes:3877.summary:
An ailing gunfighter (John Dehner) comes to North Fork to die under a doctor's care in order to spare his family. But the gunfighter is being pursued by bank robbers (John Milford, Howard Ledig) from whom he stole robbery money.

Guest stars:Hugh Sanders, Bill Quinn, Glenn Strange, George Brenlin, James Parnell, and Archie Butler

episodes:3877.name: Obituary
episodes:3877.summary:
After Lucas accuses a newspaper writer's (Alexander Scourby) misleading articles of causing an innocent man's death, the writer begins writing articles about Lucas.

Guest stars:Joanna Moore, Brian D. Hutton, Chris Alcaide, Steve Darnell, Ian Murray, Whitey Hughes, and Archie Butler

episodes:3877.name: Tension
episodes:3877.summary:
After a wanna-be bounty hunter (Harry Dean Stanton) kills a man (Gregory Walcott) wanted for a crime committed long ago, Lucas and Mark try to protect the widow (Sydna Scott) from learning about her husband's criminal past.

Guest stars:Robert H. Harris, Jack Elam, Jeff Connors, and Ted Stanhope

episodes:3877.name: Eddie's Daughter
episodes:3877.summary:
Eddie's daughter (Gloria DeHaven), who is withholding criminal information and stolen money, comes to meet her father (John Harmon) and causes trouble for Lucas.

Guest stars:Bill Quinn, Peter Whitney, Ray Teal, Jeff Daley, and Kathleen Mulqueen

episodes:3877.name: Panic
episodes:3877.summary: Town ne'er-do-well Brett Conway finds out that a couple who moved near North Fork and soon fell sick are actually ill with highly contagious and potentially fatal yellow fever. Knowing that Lucas was the person who initially discovered the couple, Conway threatens to spread the news of their condition to the entire town, thereby causing a panic, unless Lucas buys his silence.

episodes:3877.name: Ordeal
episodes:3877.summary: Lucas and Mark find themselves in deep trouble when their wagon breaks down while they're crossing the desert.

episodes:3877.name: The Spiked Rifle
episodes:3877.summary: In order to rob the stage which is carrying $20,000.00 in cash, an unarmed outlaw informs Lucas, who is riding shotgun, that his son's life is in mortal danger if he doesn't hand over the money.

episodes:3877.name: Letter of the Law
episodes:3877.summary: An outlaw gang kidnaps Micah and threatens to kill him unless their leader is released from jail. Lucas must decide whether to turn loose the notorious killer or face the possibility of the murder of his friend Micah.

episodes:3877.name: The Legacy
episodes:3877.summary: Lucas tries to do a good turn for the town drunk, but things go awry when the man's son mistakenly believes that he is now the owner of Lucas' ranch.

episodes:3877.name: The Baby Sitter
episodes:3877.summary: A singer in a dance hall asks Lucas to take care of her daughter in order to hide the child from the woman's ex-husband, who has come to North Fork to take her away.

episodes:3877.name: The Grasshopper
episodes:3877.summary: While on a train trip, Lucas and Mark are threatened by an escaped murderer. As if that weren't bad enough, the train is suddenly caught in a huge cloud of grasshoppers, forcing it to stop.

episodes:3877.name: A Time for Singing
episodes:3877.summary: Mark learns a new preacher is an impostor.

episodes:3877.name: The Deserter
episodes:3877.summary: Lucas learns why a young soldier deserted.

episodes:3877.name: The Vision
episodes:3877.summary:
While ill with typhoid fever, Mark has a vision of his mother (Marian Seldes).

Guest stars: Milton Parsons, Karl Swenson, Hope Summers, Natividad Vacío, Jeanne Wood, Dennis Cross, John Abbott, and Chuck Hicks

episodes:3877.name: The Lariat
episodes:3877.summary:
An old friend (Richard Anderson) of Lucas' arrives in North Fork to open a gambling casino.

Guest stars: Steve Conte, Dayton Lummis, George Macready, James Flavin, Bill Quinn, Harlan Warde, Whitey Hughes, Jack Tornek, Archie Butler, Rod McGaughy, and Snub Pollard

episodes:3877.name: Smoke Screen
episodes:3877.summary:
The daughter (Jennifer Lea) of a prosperous rancher (Douglas Kennedy) is found murdered.

Guest stars:Paul Carr, Warner Jones, George N. Neise, William Benedict, Richard Alexander, Johnny Collier, and Archie Butler

episodes:3877.name: Sins of the Father
episodes:3877.summary:
Andy Moon (George D. Wallace) and his young son (Eugene Mazzola) take shelter at the McCain ranch.

Guest stars:Richard Evans, Kay E. Kuter, Kelton Garwood, Dick Wilson, Rhys Williams, Charles Tannen, Archie Butler, and Snub Pollard

episodes:3877.name: The Prodigal
episodes:3877.summary:
A bank-robbing gunman (Kevin Hagen) decides to hide out at the McCain ranch.

Guest stars:Josephine Hutchinson, Warren Oates, Rodolfo Hoyos Jr., Rhys Williams, Lee Van Cleef, and Hope Summers

episodes:3877.name: The Fourflusher
episodes:3877.summary:
A neighbor (Whit Bissell) has bet his whole year's farm crop on a horse race.

Guest stars:James Westerfield, K. T. Stevens, Hope Summers, Archie Butler, Joe Benson, and Ralph Moratz

episodes:3877.name: The Jailbird
episodes:3877.summary:
A convict (Dabbs Greer) is released from prison and returns home to North Fork.

Guest stars:Karl Swenson, Bill Quinn, Molly Dodd, Charles Briggs, Charles Tannen, and Archie Butler

episodes:3877.name: Meeting at Midnight
episodes:3877.summary:
Lucas helps an old friend (Claude Akins), a federal agent, infiltrate a gang of robbers.

Guest stars: Chris Alcaide, John Milford, Frank de Kova, Bill Quinn, Ian Murray, Richard Alexander, and Archie Butler

episodes:3877.name: The Pitchman
episodes:3877.summary: A con man and his son want Lucas' mineral rights.

episodes:3877.name: Strange Town
episodes:3877.summary: Lucas trails an escaped prisoner to a mining town in the mountains.

episodes:3877.name: Baranca
episodes:3877.summary: A Mexican bandit and his gang ride into North Fork.

episodes:3877.name: The Martinet
episodes:3877.summary: Lucas helps a young minister who has problems with his father.

episodes:3877.name: Miss Milly
episodes:3877.summary: A store owner hires con men as collection agents.

episodes:3877.name: The Illustrator
episodes:3877.summary: When a famous New York artist is sent to paint a portrait of Hannah Shaw, they find the artist is not longer the person they were requesting. Lucas will try to help the down-on-his-luck artist.

episodes:3877.name: The Silent Knife
episodes:3877.summary: Mark and Lucas help a young man muted by a traumatic past.

episodes:3877.name: Face of Yesterday
episodes:3877.summary: When he sees the face of a young man who is calling him out, Lucas experiences a shocking flashback to his civil war days.

episodes:3877.name: The Wyoming Story (1)
episodes:3877.summary: After his herd is wiped out by hoof-and-mouth disease, McCain agrees to serve as an undercover detective for the U.S. government in order to raise enough cash to buy more cattle. He travels to Wyoming to learn the source of the repeating rifles that have fallen into the hands of rebellious Cheyenne Indians.

episodes:3877.name: The Wyoming Story (2)
episodes:3877.summary: Lucas continues his undercover assignment - searching for the source of repeating rifles that have fallen into the hands of renegade Indians. Meanwhile McCain's absence is keenly felt back in North Fork.

episodes:3877.name: Closer Than a Brother
episodes:3877.summary: Micah is terrorized by an old enemy and resigns from his job. When Micah's recurring nightmares drives him back to drunkenness, Lucas decides that the marshal must confront the source of those nightmares - a gunslinger he failed to face down sixteen years before.

episodes:3877.name: The Lost Treasure of Canyon Town
episodes:3877.summary: The Newmans are still living in the town where Micah grew up. Their plan to strike it rich are smothered by a long forgotten family secret - which Mark is about to uncover.

episodes:3877.name: Dark Day at North Fork
episodes:3877.summary: Lucas is temporarily blinded in an explosion. Unfortunately, not long after that incident an old enemy of his rides into town, looking to settle an old score.

episodes:3877.name: The Prisoner
episodes:3877.summary: Major Aaron King and Corporal Troc arrive in North Fork on horseback. When they see Lucas, they remember that he was a Lt. in the Union Army fifteen years ago. They see this chance meeting as a lucky break.

episodes:3877.name: Assault
episodes:3877.summary: Cade Conway and Vashti Croxton are arguing about where to get married. This leads to a fight and Vashti being knocked unconscious, and a traveling salesman being falsely blamed for it.

episodes:3877.name: Short Rope for a Tall Man
episodes:3877.summary: On his way through a strange little town, Lucas is arrested and accused of being a horse thief.

episodes:3877.name: The Clarence Bibs Story
episodes:3877.summary:
A slow-witted handyman gets into trouble when he accidentally kills a skilled gunfighter.

Guest Stars:Joan Taylor, Buddy Hackett, Denver Pyle, Lee Van Cleef, John Milford and X. Brands

episodes:3877.name: The Score is Even
episodes:3877.summary:
Lucas and Mark stumble across a robbery in progress.

Guest Stars:Adam Williams, Kelly Thordsen, and Joe Benson

episodes:3877.name: The Mescalaro Curse
episodes:3877.summary:
After Lucas receives a curse while attending then hanging of a murdering Indian, he goes on a hunt to find out who or what is behind the so-called curse.

Guest Stars:Ralph Moody, Charles Watts, Larry Chance, Jackie Searl, Joe Brown, Jr., and Michael Pate

episodes:3877.name: Stopover
episodes:3877.summary:
Trouble brews at Lucas' when a whisky salesman and a gunfighter (Adam West) fall for the same woman.

Lucas allows troublesome snowed-in stagecoach passengers to stay with him until the roads are passable.

Guest Stars:Adam West, Gordon Jones, Joe Higgins, and Bethel Leslie

episodes:3877.name: The Lonesome Bride
episodes:3877.summary:
Lucas almost finds himself at the altar when two drunken cowboys play a joke on him.

Guest Stars:Joan Taylor, Kay E. Kuter, Lincoln Demyan, Bill Quinn and Joan Shawlee

episodes:3877.name: Death Trap
episodes:3877.summary:
An ex-gunfighter from Lucas' past, now a doctor, comes to his aid when a dying man is brought in, but Lucas and the new doctor have unresolved anger toward each other.

Guest Stars:Philip Carey, Gigi Perreau, Hank Stohl, John Pickard, Larry Perron, William Kendis, Steve Pendleton, and James Drury

episodes:3877.name: The Queue
episodes:3877.summary:
Lucas helps a Chinese man settle into town after townspeople try to force him out because of his race.

Guest Stars:Joan Taylor, Victor Sen Yung, Dick Kay Hong, Pat Close and Paul Wexler, and Peter Whitney

episodes:3877.name: The Decision
episodes:3877.summary: A killer's rich father tries to bribe witness Lucas.

episodes:3877.name: Knight Errant
episodes:3877.summary:
An eccentric old friend of Lucas' arrives in North Fork.

Guest stars:Lawrence Dobkin, Sean McClory, Charles Reade, Jack Elam

episodes:3877.name: Honest Abe
episodes:3877.summary:
A kindly neighbor (Royal Dano) of Lucas' believes he is President Lincoln.

Guest stars:Royal Dano, Charles Cooper, K.T. Stevens, Joe Higgins, Steve Warren, Pam Smith, Rex Morgan and Pick Temple

episodes:3877.name: Sporting Chance
episodes:3877.summary:
A dapper man arrives on the stage and announces that he has come to kill Lucas.

Guest stars:Joan Taylor, Arthur Malet, James Luisi, Al Collins

episodes:3877.name: A Young Man's Fancy
episodes:3877.summary:
Mark falls head-over-heels in to his first puppy love.

Guest stars:Joan Taylor, Cheryl Holdridge, Richard Evans

episodes:3877.name: The Man from Salinas
episodes:3877.summary:
A young man arrives in North Fork to claim the body of his dead brother.

Guest stars:Robert Culp, Jack Hogan, Ralph Moody, Joe Higgins, Harlan Warde

episodes:3877.name: Two Ounces of Tin
episodes:3877.summary:
A young gunman with a killer's reputation comes to town and threatens to kill Micah.

Guest stars:Sammy Davis Jr., Johnny Ginger

episodes:3877.name: The Day the Town Slept
episodes:3877.summary: Lucas and Mark ride into North Fork after a two week hunting trip to discover that Micah is no longer Marshal. Worse then that, they have a new Marshal who is crooked and allows outlaws to deputy.

episodes:3877.name: Outlaw's Shoes
episodes:3877.summary: Lucas develops temporary amnesia while visiting a strange town.

episodes:3877.name: The Executioner
episodes:3877.summary: A former friend of Lucas' is released from prison and asks him for a job.

episodes:3877.name: Waste (1)
episodes:3877.summary: Lucas, Mark and Micah are taken prisoner by a group of bandits.

episodes:3877.name: Waste (2)
episodes:3877.summary: Lucas, Mark and Micah escape from bandits and take refuge in a deserted building.

episodes:3877.name: Lou Mallory
episodes:3877.summary: Lou Mallory, a stunning redhead, arrives in North Fork and buys the hotel.

episodes:3877.name: Quiet Night, Deadly Night
episodes:3877.summary: Lucas and several others are trapped in the hotel with a dangerous outlaw.

episodes:3877.name: Death Never Rides Alone
episodes:3877.summary: A former gunfighter arrives in North Fork with the intention of settling down.

episodes:3877.name: I Take This Woman
episodes:3877.summary: A charming Irishman claims Lou for his bride.

episodes:3877.name: Old Man Running (aka The Wanted Man)

show:the cisco kid.name: The Cisco Kid
show:the cisco kid.summary: The Cisco Kid was one of the first television programs to feature Hispanic actors as the lead characters, and it was the first show ever to be produced in color even though most TV sets in 1950 could only display black and white film. But it was the program s perfect mix of humor and adventure that kept audiences tuning in for years, and that earned the series a Primetime Emmy Award!

show:beneath the skin.name: Beneath the Skin
show:beneath the skin.summary: Horrific cuts cover her son's body after he's shot dead by Chicago police, and Cynthia Lane wants answers. A yearlong investigation by CNN's Rosa Flores shows the truth is not always black and white.

show:forensic files.name: Forensic Files
show:forensic files.summary: On Forensic Files, eagle-eyed technical experts prove there is no such thing as a perfect crime as they assemble the pieces every criminal leaves behind. Dramatic crime re-creations and, sometimes, part of the investigations are a staple of the series. Some of the re-creations include alternate versions of the crimes, which are disproved by science. The show's episodes follow each case from the initial investigation until it reaches its legal resolution.

episodes:3262.name: The Disappearance of Helle Crafts
episodes:3262.summary: In the series premiere (pilot) of Forensic Files, the longest running true crime series in television history, a Connecticut flight attendant went missing and was never seen again. Police suspected her husband was guilty of murder, and they were able to prove it - even though they never found the woman's body.

episodes:3262.name: The Magic Bullet
episodes:3262.summary: A fifteen-year-old boy died from a mysterious gunshot wound to his head while he was sitting in the lobby of his father's gun club. Ballistics, laser technology, made-to-scale models, and the latest in forensic animation showed that bullet had followed a tragic course after a misfire at the outdoor range.

episodes:3262.name: The House That Roared
episodes:3262.summary: A woman disappeared and her husband became the prime suspect -- especially after police found a huge bloodstain on the carpet of their bedroom. When they sprayed the bedroom with Luminol, they discovered it was awash with blood spatter. Complex DNA testing proved it was the wife's blood. Now all they had to do was find her body.

episodes:3262.name: The Footpath Murders
episodes:3262.summary: British detectives worked with a pioneering scientist to solve crimes of sexual assault and serial murder. This 1986 case marked the first time DNA was used as evidence in a court of law.

episodes:3262.name: Planted Evidence
episodes:3262.summary: Early one morning in a deserted area outside of Phoenix, a motorcyclist discovered the body of a young woman. She had been beaten, bound, strangled and possibly raped. The nearby plants would tell investigators more about the killer than any other single piece of evidence.

episodes:3262.name: Southside Strangler
episodes:3262.summary: Shortly after Thanksgiving in 1987, an intruder broke into a residence in Arlington, Virginia. That crime launched a new era in police investigations: DNA evidence and psychological profiling helped catch a serial killer and free an innocent man.

episodes:3262.name: Legionnaires' Disease
episodes:3262.summary: Philadelphia, the birthplace of the United States, played host to millions of tourists and hundreds of gatherings as America celebrated its 200th year of independence. History was made that summer of 1976 - not because of the bicentennial, but because of the mysterious death of 34 people at an American Legion convention. The groundbreaking investigation by the CDC had to explain why dozens inside a hotel - and some who just walked by outside - all got sick.

episodes:3262.name: The Wilson Murder
episodes:3262.summary: On the night of May 22, 1992, Betty Wilson returned home after a meeting. She walked up the stairs to the bedroom and discovered her husband, lying in a pool of blood. Jack Wilson had obviously been murdered... but how? And by whom? Even the experts couldn't agree.

episodes:3262.name: Deadly Neighborhoods
episodes:3262.summary: Eleven children in an elementary school in Phoenix contracted childhood leukemia; nine of them died. And in Guilford, Connecticut, five people were diagnosed with brain tumors on a street where there were only nine homes. Two towns, two cancer clusters, two mysteries. The investigation answered some questions, but raised many more.

episodes:3262.name: Insect Clues
episodes:3262.summary: Between 1985 and 1988, 18 people were choked, molested and left for dead in the remote desert mountains of California. The only witnesses were the insects -- and they also proved to play an important role in solving the crimes and bringing the killer to justice.

episodes:3262.name: Outbreak
episodes:3262.summary: In 1985, 121 people in South Dakota and Minnesota were struck with a mysterious illness. There had been only one outbreak like it, and when it happened then, no one could figure out why. This time, disease detectives would use scientific tools to unravel a mystery centered on the technique of a butcher.

episodes:3262.name: The List Murders
episodes:3262.summary: For 18 years, a man who murdered his entire family successfully eluded the FBI. This episode describes how investigators used both art and forensic science to catch the killer, John List.

episodes:3262.name: Raw Terror
episodes:3262.summary: In 1991 after a weekend earning wilderness merit badges, a boy scout ended up with slight fever and diarrhea, sending him to the hospital. His kidneys started shutting down and his diarrhea turned into hemorrhaging, leaving doctors puzzled.

episodes:3262.name: The Common Thread
episodes:3262.summary: In 1984, a serial killer was on the loose in Florida. Eight women had been found dead. At each crime scene, investigators found tiny red fibers, fibers they hoped would lead them to the killer.

episodes:3262.name: The Dirty Deed
episodes:3262.summary: On November 18, 1993 friends of Eileen and Derek Severs called and notified the police that the couple had been missing for several days. The police searched the Severs' home and questioned their son Roger who had recently moved in with his parents. Although the bodies had not yet been found, police arrested and detained Roger on suspicion of murdering his parents. Only after finding blood samples in Eileen's car and careful analysis of the mud flaps on Derek's car, were the police able to determine where Roger had buried his parents. Roger had used his mother's car to discard incriminating evidence and used his father's car to transport the bodies to the burial site.

episodes:3262.name: Killer Fog
episodes:3262.summary: It was the single, most deadly automobile accident in American history. Almost a hundred vehicles were involved, twelve people died, and more than fifty people were injured. It happened along a three mile stretch of highway long known for dense, thick fog. Investigators set out to determine if the fog was a natural phenomenon, or the result of something else.

episodes:3262.name: Sex, Lies & DNA
episodes:3262.summary: While Earl Morris was vacationing in California, he learned his wife had gone missing from their home in Arizona. The search for Ruby Morris involved dozens of investigators and scientists, even the coast guard. And the results of that investigation surprised everyone...especially Earl Morris.

episodes:3262.name: Bitter Potion
episodes:3262.summary: The flu-like symptoms of a mother and her children proved to be indicative something much more serious: thallium poisoning. Investigators had to find the source of the poison and when the mother died, to determine if the exposure was accidental, or if they also needed to find a killer.

episodes:3262.name: The Blood Trail
episodes:3262.summary: In a quiet village in Great Britain, a farmer came upon a chilling sight. Impaled on his fence post was a severed lamb's head along with a note which read, "You next." The author of the note didn't elaborate on why the farmer had been targeted, but between the lines, he'd said plenty.

episodes:3262.name: Fatal Fungus
episodes:3262.summary: An infant was rushed to a Cleveland emergency room with serious breathing problems. The baby's lungs were bleeding, an extremely rare life-threatening condition. Within months, there were more than 30 cases - an incidence more than a thousand times higher than anywhere else in the world. Doctors had never seen anything like it, and searched frantically for the cause and a cure.

episodes:3262.name: Charred Remains
episodes:3262.summary: Shortly after daybreak in Vancouver, British Columbia, a fire was set in a dumpster. No one saw either the arsonist or the fire, and it burned for hours in the deserted parking lot. But there was more than garbage in the container, and it would take sophisticated science to find the evidence in the ashes.

episodes:3262.name: Something's Fishy
episodes:3262.summary: Two people in Seattle, Washington died after taking an over-the-counter pain reliever; lab analysis of the pills showed they were tainted with a lethal concentration of cyanide. The investigation which followed led police to a suspect with a motive for murder and a callous disregard for others.

episodes:3262.name: Sealed with a Kiss
episodes:3262.summary: For more than a year, angry, hateful letters were sent to a first grade school teacher in a small town in Pennsylvania. When scientists analyzed the letters, they found evidence that the sender knew a lot about the victim - more, in fact, than anyone could possibly have imagined. DNA analysis would eventually help seal the perpetrator's fate.

episodes:3262.name: Postal Mortem
episodes:3262.summary: On October 15, 1985, two bomb explosions rocked Salt Lake City and resulted in two deaths. A third explosion occurred the next day; this time, the victim was injured but survived. As the investigation progressed, police came to believe the survivor was more than an innocent by-stander.

episodes:3262.name: Micro-Clues
episodes:3262.summary: After a day of fishing in a small, quiet village in Switzerland, a teenage boy did not return home as planned. The investigation revealed some important microscopic evidence in the water near where he was last seen. It was the only forensic evidence detectives had. But would it be enough for them to find him?

episodes:3262.name: Deadly Parasites
episodes:3262.summary: In the Spring of 1993, an unexplained illness struck the residents of Milwaukee, Wisconsin. Four-hundred-thousand people developed a serious gastrointestinal illness, 4,000 were hospitalized and, by the time the epidemic was under control, more than 100 people were dead. Health officials suspected it was influenza, but it proved to be more serious and more difficult to identify.

episodes:3262.name: Without a Trace
episodes:3262.summary: When eleven-month-old Chad Shelton was admitted to the hospital, his His liver function was abnormal, his platelet count was dangerously low, and there was unexplained bleeding from his gums, nose and eyelids. Eventually, Chad went into a coma, and died. When other people in the house began to get ill as well, investigators and scientists must frantically search for a cause.

episodes:3262.name: Knot for Everyone
episodes:3262.summary: In 1996 a woman named Stephanie Brown was driving some friends home to a foreign part of town. She took a wrong turn on Interstate 5 to get home and was later found dead in a flooded irrigation ditch.

episodes:3262.name: The Talking Skull
episodes:3262.summary: In 1987, a human skull and some bones were discovered at a Boy Scout Camp near Farmington, Missouri. A facial reconstruction aided the investigators in this case. Once the victim was identified as Bun Chee Nyhuis, her husband Richard H. Nyhuis, was no longer just a person of interest.

episodes:3262.name: Foreign Body
episodes:3262.summary: A mysterious illness with the same symptoms as Mad Cow Disease causes the unexpected deaths of several young people in England. Medical investigators rush to find the cause of the illness.

episodes:3262.name: Deadly Delivery
episodes:3262.summary: On December 16, 1989 Judge Bob Vance was killed when he opened up a package that contained a pipe bomb. Two days later an Attorney lost part of his arm when he opened a similar package. The police found two unopened packages that contained similar pipe bombs. The FBI's Behavioral Sciences Unit provided a psychological profile of the bomber. The profile matched that of Walter Leroy Moody, who was convicted of a similar bombing in 1972. A store clerk identified Moody as the individual who purchased four pounds of gunpowder and one thousand CCI primers. Walter Leroy Moody was convicted, and sentenced to seven life sentences.

episodes:3262.name: Similar Circumstances
episodes:3262.summary: In January 1987, Robert and Paula Sims moved to Alton, Illinois. There she gave birth to her son, Randy and daughter, Heather. Six weeks after Heather's birth, a masked individual reportedly broke into their home and kidnapped their daughter, Heather. The police learned that this wasn't the first time that the Sim's had a baby kidnapped.

episodes:3262.name: Grave Evidence
episodes:3262.summary: Stephen Scher and Martin Dillon went skeet shooting in rural Pennsylvania on a beautiful Spring day in 1976. Martin was shot dead that day, and Scher maintained a freak accident had cost his friend his life. It would take more than 20 years for the truth to be revealed, and for the jury to rule on who was responsible for the death of Martin Dillon.

episodes:3262.name: Deadly Formula
episodes:3262.summary: When four month old Ryan Stallings died under suspicious circumstances, his mother was arrested, charged, and ultimately convicted of his murder. But months later the verdict would be questioned when new evidence emerged from a startling source - his newborn brother.

episodes:3262.name: Beaten by a Hair
episodes:3262.summary: In 1992, Laura Houghteling disappeared from her Bethesda home and was never seen again. Five days later, police discovered a bloody pillow and pillowcase lying in the woods near Laura's house. Laura's bedroom was then searched and forensic science was used to direct them a to prime suspect.

episodes:3262.name: Crime Seen
episodes:3262.summary: On Friday, June 22, 1984, a couple set off for a camping trip but got lost and fell asleep at a scenic overlook in rural Virginia. They awoke to a person tapping on their car window; they both got out of the car to find out this man had a gun. He ordered the boyfriend to run to the woods and drove off with his girlfriend. The man repeatedly raped and sodomised the young woman and threatened to kill her. Instead, he let her go. When she arrived back to her car, she met her boyfriend who was there with the cops. The young lady positively identified Edward Honaker as the man who raped her. Honaker was given three life sentences, but new DNA testing might provide new information about the rapist.

episodes:3262.name: Speck of Evidence
episodes:3262.summary: On September 17, 1984 nine-year-old Vicki Lynne Hoskinson left on her pink bicycle to run an errand for her mother. She never returned home. Vicki's bike was found abandoned later that afternoon on a nearby street, slightly damaged, but there was no sign of her.

episodes:3262.name: Broken Bond
episodes:3262.summary: When a two-year-old boy was rushed to the hospital suffering from brain seizures and breathing difficulties, doctors could not find the cause of his illness. Then the boy's sister provided an important clue, and raised the possibility of a syndrome of which few had ever heard, a syndrome that would need both medical investigators, and legal authorities.

episodes:3262.name: Out of the Ashes
