episodes:469.summary: The team traces the Sinatra virus to an organ donor in the Philippines. Washington State's wilderness is contaminated by a massive amount of mercury. David feels responsible for allowing Owen to try experimental gene therapy to cure his drug addiction.

episodes:469.name: Phantoms
episodes:469.summary: Mayko tries to rid herself from the pain of her phantom limb. The team investigates the high level of mercury contamination found in Lake McGraw.

episodes:469.name: One Hand Washes the Other
episodes:469.summary: Despite his limited vision, Bob proves to be an asset to the team as they search for the source of a resistant strain of c. difficile.

episodes:469.name: Sleepers
episodes:469.summary: NorBAC investigates when several firefighters, responding to forest fires in British Columbia, present strange symptoms. The team detects deadly toxins, consistent with bio-terrorism.

episodes:469.name: Let It Burn
episodes:469.summary: NorBAC must find the creator of the weaponized biological agent that was released during fires on the West Coast. Rachel's son is attacked by a bear while researching a sudden change in their behavior.

episodes:469.name: Unbearable
episodes:469.summary: David discovers that NorBac has been tapped by Riddlemeyer. The team must find what caused the bear to attack Craig with no reason as a human being presents the same symptoms. David decides on a peculiar procedure to save Bob's eyesight.

episodes:469.name: Adrift
episodes:469.summary: Bob undergoes his eye surgery in the hope he won't go totally blind in the process but his prognosis is uncertain. In Nova Scotia, a ship's crew goes missing and the captain is the lone survivor,but he can't remember anything from the past two weeks.

episodes:469.name: Jacobson's Organ
episodes:469.summary: Fears arise that Carlos may have been infected with Crimean Congo Hemorrhagic Fever. Bob becomes hypersensitive to the emotions of others following his successful surgery. A magnetobacteria threatens the country's electronic infrastructure and Carlton is held accountable.

episodes:469.name: Back to the Future
episodes:469.summary: NorBAC discovers a link between the tantalum contamination and the recent smallpox scam. Meanwhile, a viral activation of dormant genes evolves Bob into a higher consciousness.

episodes:469.name: TB or Not TB
episodes:469.summary: Bob is put into a medically-induced coma to reduce the risk of infection resulting from the brain surgery he received at the end of last season. David and Carlos investigate a drug-resistant strain of TB that is killing Mexico's Zapatista Revolutionaries. Rachel and Mayko travel to a farming community where citizens are suffering a rash of horrific injuries due to an inability to feel pain.

episodes:469.name: La Consecuencia
episodes:469.summary: David returns to Mexico to find Carlos and to deal with the drug-resistant TB strain that has been killing the Zapatista rebels Mayko and Rachel get a lead in the mysterious outbreak in Hudson and Bob comes out of a medically-induced coma with little memory of what happened to him.

episodes:469.name: Hep Burn and Melinkov
episodes:469.summary: As if being HIV positive wasn't enough, Wes is accidentally scratched by a needle tainted with a genetically-engineered, virulent strain of Hepatitis C.

episodes:469.name: The Kiss
episodes:469.summary: Bob is haunted by memories of his time at Roth's secret lab; Wes insists that Rachel inject him with a highly experimental decoy drug to fight the virulent Hepatitis C. A contagious disease appears in a small town, resulting in mysterious brain inflammation.

episodes:469.name: Suspicious Minds
episodes:469.summary: After an experimental treatment for Hep C nearly kills him, Wes quits NorBAC to enroll in a revolutionary HCV program in Stockholm. A racist city councilor claims his daughter was poisoned by Muslim extremists. The FDA is willing to expedite some drugs to save an immune-deficient woman infected with smallpox.

episodes:469.name: Race Fever
episodes:469.summary: When a mysterious outbreak at the Tour Cycle Quebec hospitalizes several cyclists, NorBAC must investigate. Meanwhile, a controversial hyperbaric chamber treatment may help Bob manage his brain infection.

episodes:469.name: Hearts and Minds
episodes:469.summary: A pharmaceutical company comes under fire when its newly-marketed immune suppressing drug triggers a high incidence of congestive heart failure. David must find a replacement for Wes. Bob recalls romantic memories of a girl named Nina after suffering a stroke.

episodes:469.name: Brood 14
episodes:469.summary: Bob finally tracks down Nina but makes a gruesome discovery at Roth's lab that suggests an experiment on Nina is about to go terribly wrong. The team investigates unusual crow attacks that appear to target military airports.

episodes:469.name: Unbottled
episodes:469.summary: A terrorist cell infiltrates the NorBAC lab and forces the scientists to produce a deadly measles mutation to be used as chemical warfare.

episodes:469.name: What It Feels Like
episodes:469.summary: Disregarding procedure, David hires his new lover, Enuka. Mayko is contacted by the parents of a sick child who believe she is their last hope. Scientists must discover how to deactivate Nina's Jacobson's Organ as her behavior becomes increasingly erratic and violent.

episodes:469.name: Bloodless
episodes:469.summary: Forensic evidence in the case of a young boy's murder leads the NorBAC team to investigate the existence of a prehistoric creature, believed extinct for 10,000 years. A dramatic development complicates NorBAC.s plans to deactivate Nina's Jacobson's Organ.

episodes:469.name: The Sounds of Science
episodes:469.summary: Roth has given the world's most powerful leaders the stem cell treatment that Bob has discovered leads to violent paranoia. A horrific atrocity is uncovered as Carlos investigates a mysterious outbreak in Moldova.

episodes:469.name: The Truth
episodes:469.summary: David is more determined than ever to stop the birth of the first human clone after he has a chilling glimpse into the future.

show:world s most evil killers.name: World's Most Evil Killers
show:world s most evil killers.summary: Take an in-depth look at the lives and crimes of some of the World's Most Evil Killers including Jeffrey Dahmer, Richard Ramirez, Cary Stayner, Leonard Lake, Dorothea Puente and more.

episodes:35295.name: John Wayne Gacy
episodes:35295.summary: Documentary profiling Chicago killer John Wayne Gacy, who was well-liked by his local community, until it emerged he had ended the lives of 33 men in the 1970s.

episodes:35295.name: Jeffrey Dahmer
episodes:35295.summary: An insight into the crimes of Jeffrey Dahmer, the American serial killer dubbed the `Milwaukee Cannibal' after he raped, murdered and dismembered 17 people between 1978 and 1991.

episodes:35295.name: Ed Gein
episodes:35295.summary: A profile of Ed Gein, the killer and body-snatcher who came to be known as the `Butcher of Plainfield', and whose story is thought to have inspired Alfred Hitchcock's Psycho.

episodes:35295.name: Marc Dutroux
episodes:35295.summary: A profile of Belgian serial killer Marc Dutroux, who was convicted of torturing and sexually abusing six victims, up until his arrest in 1996.

episodes:35295.name: Joachim Kroll
episodes:35295.summary: A profile of the German serial killer Joachim Georg Kroll, who hunted and ate parts of his victims, earning him nicknames such as `the Duisburg Man-Eater' and `the Ruhr Cannibal'.

episodes:35295.name: Fritz Honka
episodes:35295.summary: Stuart Hamilton and Liz Yardley investigate the crimes of Fritz Honka, who killed at least four sex-workers in Hamburg in the 1970s, hiding their dismembered bodies around his home.

episodes:35295.name: Thierry Paulin
episodes:35295.summary: An insight into the crimes of Thierry Paulin, who attacked, robbed and murdered at least 18 elderly women in France during the 1980s, to fund his extravagant lifestyle.

episodes:35295.name: Volker Eckert
episodes:35295.summary: A profile of Volker Eckert, the German truck driver who used his constant travelling to spread his killing spree across Europe.

episodes:35295.name: Edmund Kemper
episodes:35295.summary: Criminologists profile Edmund Kemper aka "The Co Ed Butcher", the American serial killer whose spate of killings lasted from 1964 to 1973.

episodes:35295.name: Richard Ramirez
episodes:35295.summary: Exhibiting cruelty, callousness, and viciousness beyond any human understanding, Richard Ramirez terrorised Los Angeles with his spate of home invasions.

episodes:35295.name: Dorothea Puente
episodes:35295.summary: The story of the "Death House Landlady", who took in elderly and disabled tenants, only to murder them for their social security paychecks.

episodes:35295.name: Charles Ng and Leonard Lake
episodes:35295.summary: The chilling case of a Hong Kong kleptomaniac and a Vietnam veteran who committed a series of horrific murders from their cabin in California.

episodes:35295.name: Cary Stayner
episodes:35295.summary: Also known as the Yosemite Park Killer, Cary Stayner murdered four women in 1999 before his capture. Were his actions the result of a tragic childhood?

episodes:35295.name: Rodney Alcala
episodes:35295.summary: Examining the so called "Dating Game Killer", who appeared on a dating game show in the midst of a killing spree that may have claimed as many as 130 victims.

episodes:35295.name: Horst Kroener
episodes:35295.summary: The disturbing case of 53-year-old German Horst Kroener, who was jailed in 2016 for murdering his Filipina wife in her sleep.

episodes:35295.name: Wolfgang/Beate Schmidt
episodes:35295.summary: The case of "The Pink Giant", Wolfgang Schmidt (later Beate), a transgender German serial killer who brutally murdered five women and an infant.

episodes:35295.name: Unterweger
episodes:35295.summary: The story of the Austrian serial killer Jack Unterweger, who was heralded as an example of successful rehabilitation, only for him to kill again.

episodes:35295.name: Pawel Tuchlin aka The Scorpion
episodes:35295.summary: An examination of the Polish serial killer, who came to be known as "The Scorpion" after murdering nine women and attacking eleven others.

episodes:35295.name: Ted Bundy
episodes:35295.summary: A look at the life - and horrifying crimes - of Ted Bundy, a notorious serial killer who murdered at least 30 young women and girls between 1974 and 1978.

episodes:35295.name: Diane Downs
episodes:35295.summary: A look at the cold-hearted criminal who was convicted of murdering her daughter and attempting to kill her two other children in 1983

episodes:35295.name: Robert Berdella
episodes:35295.summary: Robert Berdella was an American serial killer known as The Kansas City Butcher, who was responsible for drugging, raping, torturing and murdering 6 young men.

episodes:35295.name: Robert Lee Yates
episodes:35295.summary: A profile of the serial killer Robert Lee Yates, who narrowly avoided the death penalty for killing at least 13 sex workers during a horrific reign of terror.

episodes:35295.name: Danny Rolling
episodes:35295.summary: A profile of serial killer Danny Rolling, nicknamed the Gainesville Ripper, who targeted Florida students with crimes so horrific that he inspired the movie Scream.

episodes:35295.name: Karol Kot
episodes:35295.summary: A look at the life of a Polish serial killer, nicknamed the Vampire of Krakow for his wildly varying choice of victims, from young children to the elderly.

episodes:35295.name: Todd Christopher Kohlhepp
episodes:35295.summary: A profile of the serial killer Todd Christopher Kohlhepp, who claimed the lives of at least seven innocent people between 2003 and 2016.

episodes:35295.name: David Berkowitz
episodes:35295.summary: A profile of David Berkowitz, the serial killer who found himself at the centre of New York's biggest manhunt after a vicious shooting spree that left six dead.

episodes:35295.name: Robert Ben Rhoades
episodes:35295.summary: A profile of the Truck Stop Killer, Robert Ben Rhoades, who targeted hitchhikers and truck-stop sex workers in a horrific string of crimes spanning 15 years.

episodes:35295.name: William Suff
episodes:35295.summary: A profile of the murderer known to some as the Riverside Prostitute Killer, who sits on death row after being convicted for the slaying of 12 women.

episodes:35295.name: Christopher Hightower
episodes:35295.summary: A profile of the Rhode Island family man and Sunday school teacher Christopher Hightower, who turned out to be a cold-blooded triple murderer.

episodes:35295.name: Sante and Kenneth Kimes
episodes:35295.summary: An investigation into the murderous mother and son Sante and Kenneth Kimes, who killed their elderly landlady in a greed-fuelled ploy.

episodes:35295.name: Richard Chase
episodes:35295.summary: A profile of Richard Chase, the serial killer who took the lives of six victims in one month, and became known to some as the Vampire Killer due to his penchant for cannibalism.

episodes:35295.name: Angel Maturino Resendiz
episodes:35295.summary: The crimes of Angel Maturino Resendiz, known to some as the Railroad Killer, who is thought to have taken the lives of more than 23 victims before his execution in 2006.

episodes:35295.name: Dayton Leyroy Rogers - The Molalla Forest Killer
episodes:35295.summary: A profile of one of Oregon's most prolific killers, Dayton Leyroy Rogers, who would prowl Molalla's forests in search of prostitutes to satisfy his lust for violence.

episodes:35295.name: Richard Roszkowski
episodes:35295.summary: A profile of triple-murderer Richard Roszkowski, who killed his ex-girlfriend Holly Flannery, her nine-year-old daughter Kylie and his former room-mate Thomas Gaudet in September 2006.

episodes:35295.name: Cesar Barone
episodes:35295.summary: A profile of serial killer Cesar Barone, currently serving a life sentence for the rape and murder of four women in Oregon in the early 1990s.

episodes:35295.name: John Allen & Lee Malvo
episodes:35295.summary: The story of the Beltway sniper attacks, a series of shootings in which John Allen and his teenage accomplice Lee Malvo killed 10 people.

episodes:35295.name: Robert Pickton
episodes:35295.summary: The story of Robert Pickton, one of the most prolific serial killers in Canadian history, dubbed `The Pig Farmer Killer" by the media

episodes:35295.name: Sean Vincent Gillis
episodes:35295.summary: The story of the serial killer Sean Vincent Gillis, who brutally snatched away the lives of eight innocent women during a decade-long killing spree in Louisiana.

episodes:35295.name: Heriberto Seda - The New York Zodiac
Joshua Wade
episodes:35295.summary: Responsible for five murders, Joshua Wade avoided justice for years and later confessed to killings that started from when he was just 14.

episodes:35295.name: Anthony Allen Shore: The Tourniquet Killer
episodes:35295.summary: After being arrested for a different crime, Anthony Allen Shore was matched up to four murders making him the Tourniquet Killer.

episodes:35295.name: Mark Goudeau: The Baseline Killer
episodes:35295.summary: The crimes of Mark Goudeau, an American abductor, robber, serial rapist and later serial killer who was active in Arizona from 2005 to 2006.

episodes:35295.name: Paul Runge
episodes:35295.summary: A killer who found some of his victims through ads, the case of Paul Runge became prominent in the debate over the death penalty in Illinois.

episodes:35295.name: Ronald Dominique - The Bayou Strangler
episodes:35295.summary: A serial killer and rapist who murdered at least 23 men and boys in the state of Louisiana between 1997 and 2006.

episodes:35295.name: Paul Michael Stephani - The Weepy-Voiced Killer
episodes:35295.summary: The story of a killer who was infamous for his whimpering confessions made over the phone to police after each of his murders.

episodes:35295.name: Lester Jones
episodes:35295.summary: An in-depth look at the crimes of the most evil murderers. Mother Paige Birgfeld went missing in 2007 and her remains were found five years later. A decade on, police closed the net on a local mechanic.

episodes:35295.name: Jerald Wingeart
episodes:35295.summary: In 1973, Dawn Magyar's body was found two months after she had vanished. Twenty-eight years on, advances in forensics helped solve the case. (

episodes:35295.name: John Eric Armstrong
episodes:35295.summary: In 1999 and 2000, John Eric Armstrong prowled Detroit looking for sex workers. A seemingly normal father, no one suspected he was a killer.

episodes:35295.name: Richard Biegenwald
episodes:35295.summary: Over a 25-year career of murder, Richard Biegenwald killed at least six people as he sought out ever more violent and inventive ways of dealing death.

episodes:35295.name: Richard Kuklinski
episodes:35295.summary: For Richard Kuklinski, crime was his way of life. As a professional murderer, his unusual methods led to a disturbing nickname, The Iceman.

episodes:35295.name: Richard Paul White
episodes:35295.summary: When police in Colorado interrogated Richard Paul White about the murder of his friend, he began confessing to even more horrifying crimes.

episodes:35295.name: Billy Mansfield Jr
episodes:35295.summary: From 1975 and 1980, Billy Mansfield Jr murdered at least five victims, but investigators suspect the extent of his serial killing is still to be revealed.

episodes:35295.name: Wayne Adam Ford
episodes:35295.summary: While working as a long-haul truck driver, serial killer Wayne Adam Ford strangled and dismembered his victims before dumping their bodies in creeks and rivers.

episodes:35295.name: Steven Dean Gordon
episodes:35295.summary: After a worker found the body of Jarrae Estepp at a California recycling center, detectives closed in on her murderer, Steven Dean Gordon, and discovered that he had killed before.

episodes:35295.name: Glen McCurley
episodes:35295.summary: Examining the crimes of Glen McCurley, who in 1974 abducted 17-year-old Carla Walker from a bowling alley car park and killed her before leaving her body in a ditch.

episodes:35295.name: William Devin Howell
episodes:35295.summary: An in-depth look at the life and crimes of William Devin Howell who was found guilty of the murders of seven different women.

episodes:35295.name: Michael Bruce Ross
episodes:35295.summary: An in-depth look at the life and crimes of Michael Bruce Ross who was executed in 2005 after raping and murdering women across Connecticut and New York.

episodes:35295.name: Donald Henry Gaskins
episodes:35295.summary: A profile of serial killer Donald Henry Gaskins who stabbed, shot, drowned and poisoned more than a dozen people in South Carolina in the 1970s.

episodes:35295.name: Wayne Willams
episodes:35295.summary: An in-depth look at the life and crimes of Wayne Williams who is serving life in prison for the murder of two men but suspected to be responsible for at least 24 other murders.

episodes:35295.name: David Marmolejo
episodes:35295.summary: An in-depth look at the life and crimes of David Marmolejo, who was convicted of the murder of his own mother.

episodes:35295.name: Emanuel Lovell Webb
episodes:35295.summary: Examining the life and crimes of Emanuel Lovell Webb, known as the East End Killer, who raped and killed four women in Bridgeport, Connecticut between 1990 and 1993.

episodes:35295.name: Westley Allan Dodd
episodes:35295.summary: Westley Allan Dodd exterior concealed a man with sadistic urges. By the age of 28, he was responsible taking the lives of three young boys.

episodes:35295.name: Joel Rifkin
episodes:35295.summary: In 1993, police officers pulled over a young man for erratic driving. Within the car, they found the body of a murdered woman.

episodes:35295.name: Charles Cullen
episodes:35295.summary: To some, nurse Charles Cullen was a friendly face, always willing to lend a hand. None suspected what he really was: a relentless and ruthless killer.

episodes:35295.name: Gregory Green
episodes:35295.summary: Gregory Green hid his past murder of his first wife and unborn baby, then in 2016 killed his second wife's four children, two by gas and two by gun, repeating his deadly violence.

episodes:35295.name: Benjamin Atkins
episodes:35295.summary: How Benjamin Atkins killed 11 women in Detroit, Michigan, in the space of seven months, making him one of the prolific serial killers in American history.

episodes:35295.name: Edward Wayne Edwards
episodes:35295.summary: An in-depth look at notorious murderers, with each edition examining their lives to find what exactly drove the killers to commit their crimes.

episodes:35295.name: Kenneth Jackson
episodes:35295.summary: An in-depth look at notorious murderers, with each ediition examining their lives to find what exactly drove the killers to commit their crimes.

episodes:35295.name: Leslie Allen Williams
episodes:35295.summary: In May 1992, Leslie Allen Williams was arrested for assault. Once in custody, Williams confessed to the murders of four teenage girls.

episodes:35295.name: Edward Covington
episodes:35295.summary: The crimes of Florida man Edward Covington, who on Mother's Day 2008 murdered his girlfriend and her two children, then mutilated the bodies. His defence attorney argued that he was mentally unstable - but the judge rejected the argument and the killer was sentenced to death.

episodes:35295.name: Ronald Honsch
episodes:35295.summary: A mother and daughter go missing, their bodies found but not identified. Years later, DNA uncovers the truth and leads police to Ronald Honsch

episodes:35295.name: Diane & Rachel Staudte
episodes:35295.summary: A mother poisons her family with antifreeze killing her husband and son, until a tip sparks an investigation that exposes Diane Staudte's crimes.

show:that girl.name: That Girl
show:that girl.summary: A perky aspiring actress tries to start a career in New York, getting encouragement from her boyfriend, Don, and her family. For many young women, Ann Marie was an independent role model for the times (the late '60s) for having left the nest in pursuit of a career. She also inspired trends in fashion with her flipped-up hairdo and cute, mod clothes.

episodes:1503.name: Don't Just Do Something, Stand There
episodes:1503.summary: Perky, aspiring actress Ann Marie is working as a candy clerk. While there she has a series of encounters with magazine reporter Donald Hollinger, which culminates in him rescuing her, during the filming  of a perfume commercial.

episodes:1503.name: Goodbye, Hello, Goodbye
episodes:1503.summary: Ann Marie makes the big move away from her parents home to live alone in New York. That doesn't last long, when soon after her Mother arrives on her doorstep wanting to move in.All this happens at the same time as Anne Marie gets her first acting job - as a mop in a childrens tv show

episodes:1503.name: Never Change a Diaper on Opening Night
episodes:1503.summary: Ann has a chance to audition for Jules Benedict, but that also involves babysitting Leon and Judy's baby...Manageable?

episodes:1503.name: I'll Be Suing You
episodes:1503.summary: Ann has to go to court because of an accident involving a pedestrian and a sewing machine

show:born to kill.name: Born to Kill
show:born to kill.summary: An in-depth look at some of the world's most prolific serial killers. Police detectives, journalists, childhood friends, room mates, attorneys and leading experts in criminal psychology offer an insight into their unique relationships with the evil of society.

episodes:13794.name: Gary Ridgway: The Green River Killer
David Berkowitz: The Son of Sam
The Angel of Death - Beverley Allitt
The Drive-By Slayers: Born to Kill
Beverley Allitt
episodes:13794.summary: Real crime. Grisly documentary series examining serial killers. Nurse Beverley Allitt poisoned a series of the young patients in her care during the 1990s.

episodes:13794.name: The Serial Killing Couple
episodes:13794.summary: The show examines the crimes of sadistic couple Paul Bernardo and Karla Homolka who carried out a series of despicable acts against different young women, including Karla's own sister.

episodes:13794.name: The Yorkshire Ripper
episodes:13794.summary: Peter Sutcliffe terrorised the north of England with a trail of gruesome murders during the 1970s.

episodes:13794.name: Robert Napper
episodes:13794.summary: Robert Napper wreaked terror on south London, murdering two women and a child.

episodes:13794.name: John Duffy and David Mulcahy
episodes:13794.summary: This edition focuses on childhood friends John Duffy and David Mulcahy who murdered several women in London.

episodes:13794.name: Gerald and Charlene Gallego
episodes:13794.summary: Despicable duo Gerald and Charlene Gallego joined forces to rape and murder several teenagers.

episodes:13794.name: Levi Bellfield
episodes:13794.summary: This edition reviews the case of Levi Bellfield who murdered three women, including Milly Dowler.

episodes:13794.name: Tony Costa (Cape Cod Casanova)
episodes:13794.summary: Tony Costa murdered four women in 1969, before penning a chilling, unpublished novel detailing his crimes.

episodes:13794.name: Richard Cottingham
episodes:13794.summary: Ruthless Richard Cottingham murdered at least six people and dismembered his victims' bodies.

episodes:13794.name: Cleophus Prince Jr. (Prince of Darkness)
episodes:13794.summary: This edition explores the case of ex-marine Cleophus Prince Jr., who raped and murdered six women in 1990.

episodes:13794.name: Sean Vincent Gillis (Dead End in Baton Rouge)
episodes:13794.summary: This edition examines the chilling case of Sean Gillis who stalked, raped and brutally murdered eight women.

episodes:13794.name: Timothy Wilson Spencer (Twisted Tourniquet)
episodes:13794.summary: The horrific case of Timothy Wilson-Spencer, who strangled five people in the 1980s. The case was historic as it was the first case solved with DNA evidence.

episodes:13794.name: David Gore and Fred Waterfield
episodes:13794.summary: This edition explores the chilling case of killer cousins David Gore and Fred Waterfield.

episodes:13794.name: David Carpenter
episodes:13794.summary: After being convicted of attempted murder and kidnapping, David Carpenter went on to kill five women.

episodes:13794.name: Bobby Joe Long
episodes:13794.summary: This edition examines the chilling case of Bobby Joe Long who raped 50 people and murdered nine.

episodes:13794.name: Peter Moore 'The Man in Black'
episodes:13794.summary: Cinema entrepreneur Peter Moore brutally murdered four men in Wales in 1995.

episodes:13794.name: Trevor Hardy 'The Beast of Manchester'
episodes:13794.summary: Manchester murderer, Trevor Hardy, took the lives of three teenage girls in the 1970s.

episodes:13794.name: Bill Suff 'The Riverside Killer'
episodes:13794.summary: Bill Suff's murderous reign of terror spanned 6 years and stole the lives of at least 12 women in California.

episodes:13794.name: Charles Albright 'The Eyeball Killer'
episodes:13794.summary: Charles Albright is suspected to have brutally murdered three women in Dallas' red light district.

episodes:13794.name: Allan Legere 'The Miramichi Monster'
episodes:13794.summary: In 1989, Allan Legere went on a brutal crime spree in Canada, committing assault, rape, arson and murder.

episodes:13794.name: Robert Reldan 'The Charmer'
episodes:13794.summary: In the 1970s, Robert Reldan kidnapped and brutally murdered two young women in New Jersey.

show:eastenders.name: EastEnders
show:eastenders.summary:
Set in the East End of London, the show focuses on the tensions between love and family with stories ranging from hard-hitting social issues, to personal, human tragedies. And there's plenty of funny moments too. 

Classic characters old and new across thousands of episodes have shared a drink in The Queen Vic, shed tears of despair or joy, sat on Arthur's bench in the Square... and at some point or other they probably crossed paths with Ian Beale.

episodes:793.name: December 25, 1994
episodes:793.summary: The season of goodwill comes to the Square. In among the festivities, Gita has a surprise for Sanjay; Ethel has some advice for Nellie; and Grant has a present for Sharon.

episodes:793.name: December 25, 1999 (Episode 1)
episodes:793.summary: Grant's Christmas present gives Phil an opportunity to make things up with his mum, but has he got other ideas?

episodes:793.name: December 25, 1999 (Episode 2)
episodes:793.summary: Barry is desperate to win back his beloved Natalie.

episodes:793.name: The Things You Do For Love
The War of the Queen Vic
Confession Is Bad For The Soul
So It's Come To This, Another Sharon Exit
August 6, 2009
episodes:793.summary: Janine has a nasty surprise in store for Beautiful Elder Mitchell sister Ronnie. Meanwhile, the scales fall from Roxy's Mitchell eyes when it comes to her wicked father, Lauren has doubts about her dad's return, and Libby stands up and fights for what she wants.

episodes:793.summary: Sharon is left stunned when she comes face-to-face with a familiar face. Jane decides to make a deal with Marcus Christie. Elsewhere Ronnie drops a bombshell on Charlie.

episodes:793.name: September 15, 2015
episodes:793.summary: It is judgement day for Max, will he be found guilty? Jane is left stunned when a familiar face returns to the Sqaure. Sharon makes a decision after learning the truth about Kathy.

episodes:793.name: September 17, 2015
episodes:793.summary: Abi returns to the court to take stand however will she stand by her story or will she free her father? Roxy is left shocked when Charlie tells her of his plans. Mick has a heart-to-heart with Lee about his son's depression. Will Lee listen to his Dad and seek help?

episodes:793.name: September 18, 2015
episodes:793.summary: After Charlie and Ronnie create tension, Roxy finds herself torn between the two - who will she decide to stand by? Kathy recieves a visit from an unexpected face.

episodes:793.name: September 21, 2015
episodes:793.summary: Two of the Square's residents are preparing to leave Walford however with word spreading of their departure, will anyone leave the Sqaure? Max's trial takes an unexpected turn, will his family turn their back on him?

episodes:793.name: September 22, 2015
episodes:793.summary: Jane moves forward with her plan to assist Max. Ronnie decides to ignore Vincent. Carol changes her mind.

episodes:793.name: September 24, 2015
episodes:793.summary: Masood is concerned after he learns about Jane's intentions. A familiar face returns to Albert Square. Ronnie takes some desperate measures.

episodes:793.name: September 25, 2015
episodes:793.summary: The latest developments in Max's trial shock everybody. Jane turns to a familiar face for help.

episodes:793.name: September 28, 2015
episodes:793.summary: It's judgement day for Max, and his fate is about to be decided. After thinking about Robbie's offer, Carol makes a decision.

episodes:793.name: September 29, 2015
episodes:793.summary: The residents of Albert Square are left feeling shocked by recent events and there's more drama in store for the Beales, Brannings and Butchers.

episodes:793.name: October 01, 2015
episodes:793.summary: Families around the Square end up reaching breaking point, as recent events cause shockwaves rippling through Walford.

episodes:793.name: October 02, 2015
episodes:793.summary: Carol gets ready to leave town as the residents of Albert Square reel from yesterday's events and start to look to the future. Lauren takes matters into her own hands. Phil's plan begins to fall apart. Linda has a heart-to-heart with Lee. Lauren continues to feel torn about what to do.

episodes:793.name: October 05, 2015
episodes:793.summary: Elaine's new man makes himself at home in the pub. Ian and Bobby return to Walford.

episodes:793.name: October 06, 2015
episodes:793.summary: Ian hits breaking point and resorts to some drastic measures. Babe decides to take matters into her own hands.

episodes:793.name: October 08, 2015
episodes:793.summary: Ian is shocked after seeing a ghost from the past, but the reunion takes a sudden turn. Elaine and Babe come to terms with recent events.

episodes:793.name: October 09, 2015
episodes:793.summary: Ian wants some answers from those closest to him. Jay's birthday celebrations take a turn.

episodes:793.name: October 12, 2015
episodes:793.summary: Kathy attempts to build some bridges with her family. Kush turns to Masood for some advice. Shabnam later drops a bombshell.

episodes:793.name: October 12, 2015
episodes:793.summary: Ben comes face to face with somebody from the past and quickly sees their true colours. Shabnam's plan starts to fall apart. A couple of residents find themselves taking things to the next level.

episodes:793.name: October 15, 2015
episodes:793.summary: Vincent continues to find himself stuck between Ronnie and Kim. Donna and Fatboy become gossip of the Square. Martin receives some life-changing news.

episodes:793.name: June 28th 2016
episodes:793.summary:
Babe approaches Pam on her stall who firmly tells her that she doesn't have her money yet, but Babe won't hear it. Mick arrives and breaks the moment – he invites Pam and Les to the Vic later; Pam's unsure but Babe tells her to be there. When Mick leaves, Babe tells Pam she expects a thousand pounds by tomorrow. Les is unimpressed when Louise hands him over five hundred pounds for Peggy's funeral deposit. Louise states that Sharon has done her research and believes they are being overcharged. Having witnessed this exchange, Pam berates Pam for Les risking the loss of business. Les assures Pam that he'll talk to the bank about extending their overdraft. Later, Les admits to Pam that he defaulted on the last mortgage payment – the bank won't help them. Pam finds Babe and tells her that she can stump up half of her money now – the rest will come later in the week. A stern Babe claims it's not good enough; she demands a thousand pounds by 5 o'clock.

Left with no other choice, Pam clocks the betting shop. Later, Pam's devastated as she watches Billy announce that the horse she's bet Peggy's funeral money on has lost. Pam heads to the Vic and tells Babe she can't hand over the money; Babe declares that she and Les are out of chances. Thinking that Babe is about to unveil a picture of Les as Christine, a tussle leads to Linda's birthday present, a framed poster for the production of ‘Gypsy' getting smashed. A shocked Vic look on as Pam sobs. Pam arrives home to find Les dressed as Christine; he's struggling to cope. Pam declares that he's taunting her with his perversion. As Pam rips of Les' wig, he falls down, clutching his chest...

Roxy heads to see Jack – she's bought Amy a hamster to apologise. Jack's firm that it's going to take a lot more than that to make up for her actions; Social Services are heading over later. Jack warns Roxy that he's going to be honest with them – he doesn't think that Roxy is fit to look after Amy alone; he's got a strong case for full custody. Roxy panics to Ronnie that she could be an unfit mother, but Ronnie assures her that Jack doesn't really believe that – she suggests that Roxy should find him and make amends.

Roxy heads to see Jack and admits that she's had a wake-up call; she can see she's been a bad mother and needs to change. Roxy tells Jack that she needs to go away and sort her head out; Amy is better off with him and Ronnie for now. Roxy says goodbye to Amy –Jack presents Amy with the hamster from earlier; telling her it's from Roxy. Roxy asks Jack not to tell Ronnie that she's gone until it's too late for her to try and talk her out if it. Later, Ronnie's taken aback when Amy dashes in and asks when she can keep in touch with Roxy – she demands to know where her sister is.

As Kathy walks into the café, she and Buster catch each other's eye. Denise is unimpressed when Carmel admits that she drunkenly flirted with Buster last night. Buster enters the café and asks Kathy whether she's avoiding him; she promises she's just busy at work. Denise tells Carmel that she's playing with fire, but Carmel claims that chances at happiness don't always come along; it makes sense to grab hold when it does. Buster asks Lee to watch the stall, claiming he has an errand to run. Buster meets Kathy in the park and opens up – he really likes her and hopes that she's on the same page. Buster gives Kathy a day to think about things and claims that if he doesn't hear from her, they'll call it quits.

Carmel heads to Buster's stall and awkwardly flirts with him, before asking him what his plans for later are. Carmel's pleased when Buster tells her to pop into Linda's birthday buffet later that he's catering for. Denise accompanies Carmel to the Vic; Kush arrives and Denise can't help but clock him. When Buster tells Carmel that he only wants to be friends, Carmel leaves the Vic. Denise tells Kush that she's up for the personal training he offered; it's a flirty moment. Kathy finds Buster on Bridge Street and tells him yes.

show:the cult.name: The Cult
show:the cult.summary: Years ago, twenty-somethings Jenni, Andy, and brothers Ryan and Nathan, disappeared from around the world without warning and with no trace. Now, suddenly and mysteriously, their families have been alerted to their existence in a secret, isolated cult, hidden deep in the New Zealand bush. But reclaiming the people they've lost isn't going to be easy. Everyone in Two Gardens has renounced their families, friends and all contact with the outside world, which they see as corrupt and impure. To them, Two Gardens is their home, a paradise, and their charismatic leader Edward North is the loving "father" of their family.

episodes:243.name: Conan in Korea
episodes:243.summary: O'Brien recently caused quite a stir when he arrived in Seoul, South Korea, to the cheers of thousands of screaming fans. That festive welcome kicked off a weeklong trip in which he was joined by Korean-American actor and The Walking Dead star Steven Yuen. The two explored various parts of the country, including the Korean Demilitarized Zone (DMZ) and the Joint Security Area (JSA). O'Brien and Yuen also teamed up with music sensation J.Y. Park to film a K-Pop music video.

show:sensitive skin.name: Sensitive Skin
show:sensitive skin.summary: Bittersweet comedy about a 61-year-old ex-model trying to cope with life in London.

episodes:11061.name: Episode 1
episodes:11061.summary: Davina Jackson has hit 61 but still looks great, as does her husband. Having downsized, they have cash for a new lifestyle, but with a dysfunctional son, not everything is rosy.

episodes:11061.name: Episode 2
episodes:11061.summary: A chance meeting with an old schoolfriend prompts Davina to start looking back on her childhood, and when her mother suffers another stroke she returns to old haunts. Meanwhile, Al meets an old flame.

episodes:11061.name: Episode 3
episodes:11061.summary: Eminent writer Robert Ringwald is over from the States to judge a book prize. While Al struggles to write an article on "what makes a classic", the crafty Ringwald has his sights set on seducing Davina.

episodes:11061.name: Episode 4
episodes:11061.summary: When Roger fires his piano teacher for making eyes at his wife, Veronica, Davina is shocked. She hires the teacher to give lessons to her husband Al, but then the teacher starts making eyes at her.

episodes:11061.name: Episode 5
episodes:11061.summary: Davina is worried that her brother-in-law, Roger, wants to start an affair with her. It's only after the unexpected arrival of Roger's son, Michael, and the liberal use of a class C narcotic that the truth is out.

episodes:11061.name: Episode 6
episodes:11061.summary: Al is losing everything. First it's his car radio, then his newspaper column and then his wife, Davina. But even after all that, there's a still greater loss to come.

episodes:11061.name: The Wilderness
episodes:11061.summary: Davina struggles to cope with life alone and a sister who blames her for everything that has happened.

episodes:11061.name: Three Lost Loves
episodes:11061.summary: Davina meets Sue Shortstop, proto feminist, and savager of male panellists on discussion shows. As Davina gets in touch with her inner goddess, Shortstop's narcoleptic husband is getting in touch with one of his beautiful students.

episodes:11061.name: The Signals
episodes:11061.summary: Davina meets Tom Paine, a personal shopper, who helps her to believe that there is life (and style) after widowhood. But her new neighbour Lizzie has some news that may derail her hopes.

episodes:11061.name: Forever Jung
episodes:11061.summary: Davina's son Orlando returns, surprising her with his new girlfriend, Cheryl. With Orlando seeming to have forgiven Davina for Al's death, but Cheryl blaming her for Orlando's past, is Orlando trying to pay her back for her affair with a younger man?

episodes:11061.name: Kiss of Life
episodes:11061.summary: Davina's brother-in-law Roger is on trial for accountancy fraud, and happens to be represented by old school mate, Leonard Richards. When Roger finds out his wife's history with Richards, he takes steps to free them both.

episodes:11061.name: Here I Am
episodes:11061.summary: Davina's friend Lizzie decides that she has had enough of a life spent waiting, prompting Davina to assess how far she really has moved forward.

show:farscape.name: Farscape
show:farscape.summary: Astronaut John Crichton assumes he'll be home in time for dinner. But a freak accident during an experimental space mission catapults him across a thousand galaxies to an alien battlefield. Suddenly, he's trapped among alien creatures wielding deadly technology - a battle that 20th century sci-fi pop culture never prepared him for. Hunted by a merciless military race, Crichton begins his quest for home from a galaxy far, far away...

episodes:429.name: Premiere
episodes:429.summary: Astronaut John Crichton attempts to use the Earth's atmosphere to propel his module Farscape 1 at high speeds but he is hit by a radiation wave and sucked through a wormhole into a distant part of the universe and straight into the middle of a space battle. After almost colliding with another ship, which explodes shortly afterwards, he is brought aboard a ship full of alien prisoners attempting to escape custody. After being partnered with a captured Peacekeeper soldier, Crichton is drawn into the prisoners' daring plan to escape the clutches of the Peacekeeper forces and their vengefully obsessed military commander.

episodes:429.name: Back and Back and Back to the Future
episodes:429.summary: The crew comes across a ship that is molecularly de-stabilizing. D'Argo makes everyone bring the ship's escape pod aboard when he discovers that the ship's passengers are Ilanics -- long-time allies of the Luxans. Aboard the escape pod, Crichton gets a shock and starts experiencing strange visions of the future, first of himself and one of the Ilanics, then of Moya's destruction.

episodes:429.name: Throne for a Loss
episodes:429.summary: When a group of Tavleks come aboard for trade negotiations, Rygel takes a vitally important crystal from Moya to make himself appear wealthy. The Tavleks kidnap Rygel to hold for ransom. Crichton, Aeryn and D'Argo attempt to rescue Rygel with the use of a Tavlek weapon. Meanwhile, Zhaan has interesting interactions with a wounded Tavlek left behind on Moya.

episodes:429.name: PK Tech Girl
episodes:429.summary: The crew find an abandoned Peacekeeper ship adrift in space. On board they discover that Crais recently deposited a unit of techs to make repairs. Meanwhile Rygel learns that this was the ship where he was first held captive and starts getting paranoid. Things get worse when a group of fire-breathing aliens show up.

episodes:429.name: Thank God It's Friday... Again
episodes:429.summary: The crew visits a planet full of happy workers. Soon D'Argo and Zhaan start working and refuse to return to the ship. Meanwhile Rygel's body fluids become explosive and Aeryn and Pilot must learn why before Rygel dies.

episodes:429.name: I, E.T.
episodes:429.summary: A Peacekeeper beacon goes off and Moya has to land on an alien planet to prevent its signal being intercepted and Moya being discovered. Crichton, D'Argo and Aeryn leave Moya and explore the planet in search of a substance that can be used to numb Moya's senses so the beacon can be removed but Crichton gets separated from the group and meets up with some inhabitants of the planet who hide him from the authorities.

episodes:429.name: Exodus from Genesis
episodes:429.summary: Moya gets infested with bugs who have come on board to breed. They turn up the temperature to speed up the process but this causes Aeryn to get heat delirium as she is cold blooded. The bugs seem to be able to replicate members of the crew. And as if that isn't enough, a Peacekeeper ship shows up.

episodes:429.name: That Old Black Magic
episodes:429.summary: Crichton is put into a head-to-head battle with Crais by a magical being named Maldis who feeds off the emotions of others and makes himself stronger by absorbing all of the negative energy and anger from Crichton and Crais.

episodes:429.name: DNA Mad Scientist
episodes:429.summary: A scientist extracts DNA from several of Moya's crew, promising them that with it he will be able to find the locations of their home planets. Conflict arises when he asks for a sample from Pilot -- specifically, one of his arms.

episodes:429.name: They've Got a Secret
episodes:429.summary: During routine searches for Peacekeeper beacons, D'Argo falls down a chute, destroys a Peacekeeper shield and gets ejected into open space. After being rescued D'Argo starts to think that everyone on Moya are members of his family. Moya, meanwhile, starts to alter the environmental conditions inside the ship so that it is hardly habitable for the crew.

episodes:429.name: Till the Blood Runs Clear
episodes:429.summary: Crichton comes across the same conditions that created the wormhole that sent him to Moya. He and Aeryn leave Moya in his module in an attempt to create another wormhole and return home. Although a wormhole forms, it is unstable and damages the module. Crichton and Aeryn are forced to make an emergency landing on a planet to make repairs. There, they encounter a holographic message sent by Crais, offering rewards for: D'Argo, Zhaan and Rygel.

episodes:429.name: The Flax
episodes:429.summary: While taking a piloting lesson on a transport pod with Aeryn, Crichton gets caught in an energy field which is invisible to their sensors. Meanwhile, back on Moya, a strange guest docks and comes aboard to warn the crew about The Flax, an invisible energy net created to catch ships which are then plundered by pirates.

episodes:429.name: Rhapsody in Blue
episodes:429.summary: Moya responds to a distress call from another pregnant Leviathan. The crew learns, upon arrival at the planet from which the call originated, that they've been deceived. The call actually came from a group of exiled Delvians who want to learn -- forcibly, if need be -- how Zhaan overcame the madness caused by giving in to her anger.

episodes:429.name: Jeremiah Crichton
episodes:429.summary: Several heated arguments with the crew prompt Crichton to take his module for a cruise. While away from the ship, a problem with Moya causes her to Starburst without warning, leaving Crichton stranded. While separated from the others, he discovers a forgotten colony with an appalling secret- a secret that their religious leaders have gone to great lengths to conceal.

episodes:429.name: Durka Returns
episodes:429.summary: When a Starburst goes badly wrong, Moya collides with a Nebari ship. On board is Durka, Rygel's former torturer, who has been mind cleansed and now serves the Nebari. Chiana, an attractive young rebel faces the same fate. Rygel takes it upon himself to take revenge on Durka and ends up undoing the cleansing and restoring him to his former, tyrannic incarnation.

episodes:429.name: A Human Reaction
episodes:429.summary: After discovering a wormhole that appears to lead back to Earth, Crichton takes the chance that it might be his ticket home. He crash lands on a beach in Australia and finds that although Earth is exactly as he remembered it, it is not exactly what he was expecting.

episodes:429.name: Through the Looking Glass
episodes:429.summary: Moya tries to Starburst to prove to the crew that she still can. It goes badly wrong, though, and she gets stuck in Starburst with reality split into several different and strange dimensions.

episodes:429.name: A Bug's Life
episodes:429.summary: A Peacekeeper ship approaches Moya, so Crichton and Aeryn pose as Peacekeeper officers on a secret mission while everyone else gets locked into cells to make the deception seem realistic. The Peacekeepers that come aboard, however have some strange and dangerous cargo aboard which wreaks havoc when accidentally released by Rygel and Chiana snooping through the Peacekeepers' possessions.

episodes:429.name: Nerve
episodes:429.summary: Crichton and Chiana try to infiltrate a Peacekeeper base to get a vital tissue graft for Aeryn, who will die without it. Crichton gets caught by Scorpius and imprisoned. He is tortured using a device called the 'Aurora Chair' which is able to look inside his mind and, as Scorpius wants, to reveal the secrets of wormholes.

episodes:429.name: The Hidden Memory
episodes:429.summary: Although still recovering from her near-death experience, Aeryn is determined to save Crichton, who is being held captive by the Peacekeepers. Zhaan and D'Argo join her, while Chiana and Rygel stay behind with Moya who is about to deliver her offspring. Soon suspicion falls on Crais, after Gilina's technical manipulation of the Aurora Chair causes Scorpius to wonder if in fact Crais is responsible. This leaves Crichton open for rescue.

episodes:429.name: Bone to Be Wild
episodes:429.summary: Moya is hiding in an asteroid field from a Peacekeeper command carrier. They receive a distress call and Crichton, Zhaan and D'Argo go down to one of the asteroids to rescue a woman who becomes intent on eating them.

episodes:429.name: Family Ties
episodes:429.summary: Rygel steals a transport pod and goes to the Peacekeeper command carrier to betray the others. However he ends up returning to Moya with Crais, who wants asylum. Meanwhile, Crichton decides to destroy Scorpius' Gammak Base.

episodes:429.name: Mind the Baby
episodes:429.summary: Crichton, Aeryn and D'Argo are stranded in an asteroid field while Scorpius searches for them. Their safety depends on Crais, who is nearby in Talyn. Aeryn teaches Crais how to control the young Leviathan - the only thing she can offer in return for the lives of her friends. When Moya returns to the asteroid field to look for her offspring, and Crichton decides to remove Crais from control of Talyn, Scorpius finally sees his chance to strike.

episodes:429.name: Vitas Mortis
episodes:429.summary: D'Argo takes part in a sacred ritual that helps an old Luxan, an Orican, to survive. During the ritual the Orican draws energy from who she thinks is D'Argo but is actually Moya. Consequently Moya starts to age rapidly.

episodes:429.name: Taking the Stone
episodes:429.summary: After getting word that her brother is dead, Chiana leaves Moya and goes to a 'grave planet' populated by a race of young people who play dangerous and life-threatening games.

episodes:429.name: Crackers Don't Matter
episodes:429.summary: The crew returns from a commerce planet with a load of crackers and a meek alien called T'raltixx, who promises he can alter Moya's electromagnetic profile in order to make her untraceable. Crichton is skeptical; it seems too good to be true. As they pass through a constellation of pulsars, an intense paranoia affects the crew, turning them violently again each other. Crichton must fight against his own paranoid delusions to work out what T'raltixx is actually doing -- and how to stop him.

episodes:429.name: The Way We Weren't
episodes:429.summary: A datacam tape is uncovered showing Aeryn as part of a Peacekeeper firing squad that executed a previous Pilot aboard Moya. The rest of the crew wants answers but Aeryn is reluctant to revisit her past - especially her relationship with Velorek, the man charged with forcibly bonding a new Pilot to Moya. Pilot (the current one, that is) refuses to communicate with the crew, not wanting to reveal his own complicity in the murky circumstances surrounding his installment as Moya's guide.

episodes:429.name: Picture If You Will
episodes:429.summary: While visiting a planet Chiana visits a trader and is given a picture which can supposedly predict the future free of charge. Back on Moya the crew become alarmed when the picture begins to predict people's deaths and soon the crew are unable to stop it. But before long it is revealed that an old enemy is responsible for what is happening.

episodes:429.name: Home on the Remains
episodes:429.summary: With Moya out of food, Chiana leads everyone to a dead Budong where she once worked. Meanwhile on Moya, Aeryn is left to deal with a carnivorous Zhaan.

episodes:429.name: Dream a Little Dream
episodes:429.summary: While waiting inside a transport pod, to be picked up by Moya, Zhaan tells Crichton about being accused and tried for murder during his absence.

episodes:429.name: Out of Their Minds
episodes:429.summary: When a hostile alien ship fires first at the Moya, the crew, despite the fact that their energy shield is up, finds their minds switched into another person's body. As a result, Crichton is in the body of Aeryn, Aeryn is in the body of Rygel, and Rygel is in the body of Crichton. In the cockpit, Pilot is in the body of Chiana, Chiana is in the body of D'Argo, and D'Argo is in the body of Pilot. They're all forced to adapt to their new bodies as they attempt to figure out what caused the switch.

episodes:429.name: My Three Crichtons
episodes:429.summary: A strange globe appears on Moya, sucking in Crichton and duplicating him creating two additional people. One who is a de-evolved 'cave man' and another who has increased mental ability.

episodes:429.name: Look at the Princess Part I: A Kiss Is But a Kiss
episodes:429.summary: Moya arrives at a planet where the people test their genetic compatibility by kissing. Crichton kisses a princess, who is next in line for the throne, and discovers that his DNA is a perfect match for her. He must now marry her and they will rule together. This is against the wishes of her brother, who is second in line for the throne -- conspiring with a Scarran.

episodes:429.name: Look at the Princess Part II: I Do, I Think
episodes:429.summary: Plots swirl around Crichton and his fiancee, Princess Katralla. The empress promises Crichton that if he doesn't marry her daughter, she will hand him over to Scorpius. Meanwhile, Prince Clavor plots to assassinate Crichton so that he may ascend to the throne in his sister's place.

episodes:429.name: Look at the Princess Part III: The Maltese Crichton
episodes:429.summary: Now married, Crichton and Katralla are frozen into living statues so that they may watch over the presiding governments of the next eighty cycles. Immediately, Clavor and the Scarran emissary attempt another assassination and succeed in removing Crichton's head. Empress Novia threatens to kill all off-worlders, putting D'Argo, Chiana and Rygel in danger. Finding Crichton's head is now a matter of life or death.

episodes:429.name: Beware of Dog
episodes:429.summary: When the crew hear rumors of creatures infesting ships in the area, they buy an alien tracker to remove the creatures aboard Moya. But it soon becomes apparent that the creatures could cause a lot of damage before the tracker finds it putting the crew in danger.

episodes:429.name: Won't Get Fooled Again
episodes:429.summary: Crichton wakes to find himself back on Earth and the Farscape project failing. However, all is not as it seems, with D'Argo, Aeryn and co. co-existing with DK and his Dad. Crichton only has Scorpius to turn to for answers before it's too late!

episodes:429.name: The Locket
episodes:429.summary: Moya gets stuck in a temporal anomoly but is unaware of it. Aeryn returns from recon after only a few hours but has aged many years.

episodes:429.name: The Ugly Truth
episodes:429.summary: When Crais and Talyn rendezvous with Moya, the crew boards Talyn, where Crais presents them with a proposal about the young ship's future. Meanwhile, a ship that Crais intended to purchase weaponry from approaches Talyn, butTalyn fires and destroys it. Crais and Talyn flee, but the crew get captured and are put on trial for for their lives.

episodes:429.name: A Clockwork Nebari
episodes:429.summary: A group of Nebari come on board Moya and attempt to mind cleanse everyone using a drug. Pilot and Rygel are the only two who can resist the effects. Crichton also remains unaffected due to Scorpius' neural clone.

episodes:429.name: Liars, Guns and Money Part I: A Not So Simple Plan
episodes:429.summary: Stark returns to Moya with a plan to rob a shadow depository and buy a contingent of slaves, one of which is D'Argo's son Jothee. D'Argo attempts the robbery on his own however and now the crew must recover him as well as the money they require.

episodes:429.name: Liars, Guns and Money Part II: With Friends Like These...
episodes:429.summary: The crew is stunned when they learn that Scorpius has bought the slaves out from under D'Argo. Rather than trade Crichton for Jothee, Crichton, D'Argo, Aeryn and Rygel seek out mercenaries to help them steal the slaves. In the process, they encounter some enemies they've fought in the past. Meanwhile, back on Moya, the stolen money has turned into metal-eating spiders that begin to consume Moya.

episodes:429.name: Liars, Guns and Money Part III: Plan B
episodes:429.summary: Crichton turns himself over to Scorpius in order to free Jothee. With all the mercenaries now aboard Moya, the crew form a plan to rescue Crichton and destroy the depository.

episodes:429.name: Die Me, Dichotomy
episodes:429.summary: The crew find a doctor that can heal Moya's burns and remove Crichton's neural chip. Things are complicated however when Crichton is informed he needs additional brain tissue from a donor in stasis who will die when the tissue is removed. Also Scorpius is beginning to take over Crichton's mind.

episodes:429.name: Season of Death
episodes:429.summary: The Diagnosan's assistant, Grunchlk, sets a Scarran loose. Scorpius uses a device to control Grunchlk and plots to escape from the ice planet with John's neural chip.

episodes:429.name: Suns and Lovers
episodes:429.summary: Moya docks at a commerce station so the crew can spend some of the money they acquired from the depository. There are complications, however, when a storm strikes the station.

episodes:429.name: Self Inflicted Wounds Part I: Could'a, Would'a, Should'a
episodes:429.summary: Moya approaches a wormhole, gets pulled in, only to collide with another ship and become fused with it. Only one ship can ultimately survive, and the aliens aboard the other ship will stop at nothing to be sure that it will be theirs.

episodes:429.name: Self Inflicted Wounds Part II: Wait for the Wheel
episodes:429.summary: The crew works out a way of getting free from the other ship and out of the wormhole. Things become more complicated when their new 'friends' begin to sabotage Moya and Crichton picks up a transmission from Earth.

episodes:429.name: ...Different Destinations
episodes:429.summary: While visiting a Peacekeeper memorial, Stark accidentally sends himself, Crichton, D'Argo, Aeryn and Jool back in time where they alter the timeline and then are forced to interfere further to restore it.

episodes:429.name: Eat Me
episodes:429.summary: In need of supplies, Crichton lands his transport pod on a dying leviathan which is full of hungry cannibals and a scientist who has the ability to create clones.

episodes:429.name: Thanks for Sharing
episodes:429.summary: Moya and Talyn, who is seriously damaged, rendezvous. They hide in the atmosphere of a planet to prevent the Peacekeepers from finding them. D'Argo and Rygel go down to the planet to find some Chromextin, a drug that will help Talyn recover. Meanwhile, Aeryn learns more about her parents and there are two Crichtons on board continuing from the last episode.

episodes:429.name: Green Eyed Monster
episodes:429.summary: Talyn is swallowed by a giant space creature known as a Budong. Crais' neural connection to Talyn malfunctions and Aeryn is forced to take control of Talyn. Meanwhile, Stark and Rygel come up with a way to help Talyn escape from the Budong.

episodes:429.name: Losing Time
episodes:429.summary: The crew of Moya start blacking out and missing portions of time. Pilot becomes inhabited by another entity who needs to 'taste' each crewmember to determine if they too are being inhabited.

episodes:429.name: Relativity
episodes:429.summary: Talyn lands on a planet covered mostly with vegetation that will help him to heal. Crichton, Aeryn and Crais leave the ship in search of Xhalax.

episodes:429.name: Incubator
episodes:429.summary: With his wormhole research stalling and his situation desperate, Scorpius inserts the original 'neurochip' into his own brain. He hopes to make contact with the clone of Crichton's personality that spilled in to the chip when it was in Crichton's brain. When they meet, Scorpius realizes that it's not going to be easy to get the clone to share information. Meanwhile, a defecting Peacekeeper scientist offers Crichton the secret of wormhole technology.

episodes:429.name: Meltdown
episodes:429.summary: When Talyn draws dangerously close to a sun because he is being pulled by some mysterious force, Talyn's crew learn that a creature named Mu-Quillus is responsible. Stark then makes a pact with a spirit of a dead alien woman and puts the whole of Talyn's crew at risk.

episodes:429.name: Scratch 'n' Sniff
episodes:429.summary: While enjoying their holiday away from Moya, Crichton, D'Argo, Jool and Chiana get a little too drunk. The next day when Crichton and D'Argo come to they find that Chiana and Jool are nowhere to be seen, now Crichton and D'Argo must work out what really happened the night before.

episodes:429.name: Infinite Possibilities Part I: Daedalus Demands
episodes:429.summary: When Crichton is accused of sharing wormhole stabilizing technology with a race known as the Charrids by the Ancient who calls himself Jack. Crichton and the rest of Talyn's crew must seek out an old acquaintance who really is the guilty one.

episodes:429.name: Infinite Possibilities Part II: Icarus Abides
episodes:429.summary: Jack (The Ancient) unlocks the wormhole knowledge in Crichton's mind so together they can build a device to destroy the Scarran dreadnought.

episodes:429.name: Revenging Angel
episodes:429.summary: There is an accident whilst D'Argo is demonstrating what his ship can do. He blames Crichton and knocks him out. In his unconscious state, Crichton has some animated dreams.

episodes:429.name: The Choice
episodes:429.summary: Still grieving for Crichton, Aeryn travels to a planet to make contact with someone claiming to be her father. After meeting with him, Aeryn goes in search of a creature who, according to her father, can channel the dead. But where her father is, can her mother be far behind?

episodes:429.name: Fractures
episodes:429.summary: A group of escaped prisoners come aboard Moya. They are followed shortly by Aeryn, Crais and Rygel who have finally returned from Talyn.

episodes:429.name: I-Yensch, You-Yensch
episodes:429.summary: D'Argo and Rygel meet Braca and Scorpius in a cafe to conduct negotiations when it is unexpectedly attacked.

episodes:429.name: Into the Lion's Den Part I: Lambs to the Slaughter
episodes:429.summary: Crichton and the rest of Moya's crew arrive at the Command Carrier to try and put an end to Scorpius' mad obsession with wormhole research. Slowly Crichton gains Scorpius' trust, but when a Peacekeeper commandant arrives at the Carrier and tells Scorpius that he must put an end to his wormhole research, Scorpius shows Crichton something which he has been searching for over the past three years... Earth.

episodes:429.name: Into the Lion's Den Part II: Wolf in Sheep's Clothing
episodes:429.summary: Crais and Talyn make the ultimate sacrifice to save the crew of Moya, by Starbursting into the Command Carrier causing it to slowly collapse in on itself. Meanwhile Scorpius and Crichton move closer to the wormhole technology they are both looking for.

episodes:429.name: Dog with Two Bones
episodes:429.summary: Moya takes Talyn's remains to the sacred burial ground where D'Argo is forced to destroy a rogue Leviathan that is attacking other ships.

episodes:429.name: Crichton Kicks
episodes:429.summary: Crichton, who is now aboard a dying Leviathan named Elack, works on his theories of wormhole physics. But when a female alien named Sikozu lands on the ship, she is followed by a squad of Grudek mercenaries who want to harvest the Leviathan's neural cluster tissue. Crichton struggles to save his new home but gets some welcome help when two old friends rejoin him.

episodes:429.name: What Was Lost Part I: Sacrifice
episodes:429.summary: Elack arrives at a planet and Crichton, Chiana and Rygel are reunited with D'Argo and Jool who are at an archaeological site run by Jool's people, the Interions. The purpose of the dig is to find a missing probe which might reverse the dangerous atmosphere of the planet. But things take a turn for the worse when Peacekeepers led by Grayza land on the planet.

episodes:429.name: What Was Lost Part II: Resurrection
episodes:429.summary: When D'Argo and Sikozu come up with a plan to crash Elack (the dying Leviathan) into the Peacekeeper pursuit craft, Crichton is forced to get closer with Grayza to ensure the success of the plan. But when the plan goes wrong Crichton and the rest of the crew are forced to go looking for the third probe to end the magnetic summer forever.

episodes:429.name: Lava's a Many Splendored Thing
episodes:429.summary: While the crew has stopped off on a planet, Rygel leaves the rest of the group and is caught in an unbreakable orange substance as he's stealing treasures he discovers in a cave. When D'Argo, Crichton and Noranti go looking for Rygel, the cave seals them in. Two huge grunts appear who have protective armor which protects them from weapons fires.

episodes:429.name: Promises
episodes:429.summary: D'Argo, Rygel, Crichton, Chiana and Sikozu get back to Moya, only to find that Scorpius is there waiting for them along with Aeryn, now suffering from heat delirium. Aeryn has granted Scorpius asylum and claims that Scorpius saved her life.

episodes:429.name: Natural Election
episodes:429.summary: While in close proximity to a wormhole, Moya is preoccupied and doesn't notice a slowly moving object heading towards her. Moya collides with the object which then covers her entire hull, causing great discomfort to her as well as the crew.

episodes:429.name: John Quixote
episodes:429.summary: While on a transport pod, Chiana nags Crichton to try out a virtual reality game. A transmission comes through from D'Argo concerning a problem with Scorpius. Despite this, Chiana pulls Crichton into one of the games, where they become trapped., and the only way out is to complete the game.

episodes:429.name: I Shrink Therefore I Am
episodes:429.summary: A group of bounty hunters come aboard Moya and take everyone hostage. When Crichton arrives back with Noranti, he destroys the bounty hunter's ship and goes aboard Moya to rescue everyone whilst Noranti puts herself into a coma so she can survive outside the ship.

episodes:429.name: A Prefect Murder
episodes:429.summary:
With Moya immobilized in Tormented Space, Crichton, Aeryn, Chiana, D'Argo and Sikozu seek temporary respite on a planet inhabited by historically warring clans who are now experiencing a fragile peace. The crew's arrival coincides with preparations for the election of a new ruler, or 'Prefect'. Incumbent Prefect Falaak is at the end of his half cycle in power, and reluctant to concede it. Popular clan leader Gashaah looks the likely successor, but faces a strong challenge from the Chieftan of the Jabuka Clan.

Aeryn begins experiencing strange hallucinations, then without warning opens fire upon a meeting of the clans; when it is over, Gaashah lies amongst the dead, D'Argo wounded. She escapes during the confusion, leaving her crewmates under suspicion.

episodes:429.name: Coup by Clam
episodes:429.summary: The crew consume food, sharing amongst themselves, unaware that if these special mollusks are not ingested by the same person, it becomes toxic. Consequently, they must quickly find a cure or they'll die. Fortunately there's someone who's happy to come through... for a price. But there's more going on here than their own problems, and solving them may be a real drag!

episodes:429.name: Unrealized Reality
episodes:429.summary: Crichton gets sucked into a wormhole while he is studying it, but instead of exiting the wormhole on the other end he becomes trapped with a mysterious man inside the wormhole. The man claims he is a relation of The Ancients who Crichton met before and gave him his wormhole technology. He demonstrates the consequences of wormhole travel to Crichton and forces him to confront the possibility that he may never be able to get home.

episodes:429.name: Kansas
episodes:429.summary: After accidentally returning to Earth, Crichton discovers it he is in 1985 and he has altered the time line, causing his father to be scheduled to fly on the doomed shuttle Challenger.

episodes:429.name: Terra Firma
episodes:429.summary: Moya arrives at Earth in present day, Christmas. The crew show their ships and technology to Earth's scientists. Crichton starts writing a journal. The creature left onboard Moya by Grayza manages to get to Earth where it starts killing and hunting down Crichton.

episodes:429.name: Twice Shy
episodes:429.summary: Moya takes on a new passenger when Chiana insists that they rescue the young female from the men exploiting her. However, they soon learn that Talikaa is not the innocent that she pretends to be, but rather an alien predator in disguise who plans to feed on their neural energy.

episodes:429.name: Mental as Anything
episodes:429.summary: Scorpius signs D'Argo, Crichton and Rygel up for a training camp where the students learn mental discipline by battling in an artificial environment.

episodes:429.name: Bringing Home the Beacon
episodes:429.summary: At a commerce settlement, Aeryn, Chiana, Noranti and Sikozu make a deal for a sensor distorter to shield Moya from detection. Construction will take time, though... leaving them stuck there just as Peacekeepers and Scarrans arrive for a secret diplomatic meeting. As Chiana and Noranti try to avoid detection, Aeryn and Sikozu do some spying. Grayza makes the Scarrans a surprising offer to ensure peace... endangering many innocent lives in the process. War Minister Ahkna has some surprises of her own... forcing Aeryn and Sikozu to take action.

episodes:429.name: A Constellation of Doubt
episodes:429.summary: Crichton watches a documentary that Moya receives from Earth about their recent visit showing interviews with Crichton's relatives and other people who interacted with the crew.

episodes:429.name: Prayer
episodes:429.summary: Crichton and Scorpius travel to one of the 'unrealized realities' where Crichton believes he heard Stark say "Katratzi". Meanwhile on a Scarran ship, Aeryn resists torture, while protecting herself and her and Crichton's child.

episodes:429.name: We're So Screwed Part I: Fetal Attraction
episodes:429.summary: Moya arrives at a station where the Scarran vessel transporting Aeryn is docked.

episodes:429.name: We're So Screwed Part II: Hot to Katratzi
episodes:429.summary: Moya arrives at Katratzi. Crichton attends the peace talks between the Scarrans and the Peacekeepers... with a nuclear bomb.

episodes:429.name: We're So Screwed Part III: La Bomba
episodes:429.summary: The plan to rescue Scorpius from Katratzi fails and all because of the hybrid himself. He claims it was for the crew's own good, but, regardless, they are now stuck. Most still want to find another way out, but Scorpius reveals some secrets and pushes a plan to strike a major blow against the Scarrans. His target, surprisingly, is the Crystherium Utilia. The crew had better hurry, especially once the Scarrans deactivate Crichton's bomb. Success ends up depending on a secret held by Sikozu. Elsewhere on Katratzi, Rygel and Noranti search for Stark, only to run afoul of his bioloid. Meanwhile, Grayza fears her plans for peace have failed and now threatens to ignite a war.

episodes:429.name: Bad Timing
episodes:429.summary: With their Crystherium stores low, the Scarrans must travel to Earth through a wormhole to replenish their supply, as those flowers grow there. With Pilot's help, Crichton tries to collapse the wormhole leading back to Earth.

show:women behind bars.name: Women Behind Bars
show:women behind bars.summary: Women Behind Bars provides an in-depth profile of the lives of incarcerated women. The show delves deep into their stories of how and why they committed their crimes.

episodes:20083.name: Teresa Deion Smith Harris & Jennifer Freels
Roberta Jeannie Moore/Donna Duggins & Evelyn Jackson

show:shadow warriors.name: Shadow Warriors
show:shadow warriors.summary: In 1651 during the Edo Period, the 11 year old Ietsuna becomes the fourth Shogun, leading his influential chief retainers to plot against each other to take the reins of power. The Hattori family, a clan of Iga Ninjas who were former vassals and protectors of the previous Shogun, Tokugawa Ieyasu have since fallen from grace. Their third generation ancestor, Hattori Hanzo is now working as the master at public bathhouse in Edo City (what is now known as Tokyo). Fearing further political upheaval and instability, the Shogun's right-hand man, Masayuki Hoshina once again calls upon the unique skills and services of Hattori Hanzo's Ninja Clan. During the day, they masquerade as ordinary citizens, but at night they ride forth as the "Kage No Gundan", the secret "Shadow Army" who opposes all those who dare to threaten the authority of the reigning Shogun.

show:yu gi oh arc v.summary: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V centers around Yuya Sakaki, as he tries to escape from harsh reality by smiling. But one Duel leads him to make a determination to confront the difficulties and he will get the power of infinite possibilities. The show's main theme is "Take a step forward with courage!!"
