show:hunter.name: Hunter
show:hunter.summary: L.A.P.D. Sgt. Rick Hunter is a tough minded, Dirty Harry type policeman who can't stand the creeps, thieves, rapists, and especially murderers who prowl the streets of Los Angeles. Unfortunately his method of doing things doesn't sit well with his precinct captains, which lead to their efforts to get rid of him. Because of his heavy handed approach, he is unable to keep partners for any significant time frame, and is assigned to Sgt. Dee Dee McCall.

previousepisode.name: Little Man with a Big Reputation

episodes:4652.name: Pilot
episodes:4652.summary: Son of a mobster, Detective Sergeant Rick Hunter finds it difficult to keep a partner. The Captain assigns Hunter a new partner, but Hunter has another maverick in mind, Sergeant Dee Dee McCall. Hunter and McCall team up to catch a serial killer.

episodes:4652.name: Hard Contract
episodes:4652.summary: Hunter & McCall make a pact of protectiveness and loyalty toward each other when she is nearly killed by her old partner after she tries to stop him from a killer-for-hire assignment.

episodes:4652.name: The Hot Grounder
episodes:4652.summary: When the Police Commissioner's wife is murdered, the commissioner becomes the prime suspect. Hunter and McCall have to investigate despite interference from the top.

episodes:4652.name: A Long Way from L.A.
episodes:4652.summary: A meek pick-pocket is accused of brutally beating a woman. Hunter and McCall are unconvinced that he could do such a thing and have to find the true culprit before it's too late.

episodes:4652.name: Legacy
episodes:4652.summary: Hunter and McCall investigate the killing of the patriarch of a mob family that Hunter knows personally.

episodes:4652.name: Flight on a Dead Pigeon
episodes:4652.summary: Hunter and McCall try to help a young girl whose Uncle was killed. It seems the man races pigeons and they're missing. Later someone tries to grab the girl, Hunter and McCall try to find out why.

episodes:4652.name: Pen Pals
episodes:4652.summary: A notorious drug dealer is killed by a thief who stole Hunter's "backup" gun, returning it immediately after the killing. With Hunter locked up in jail with an inmate planning on killing him, McCall must catch the true killer to clear Hunter's name.

episodes:4652.name: Dead or Alive
episodes:4652.summary: Hunter and McCall track a bounty hunter who is not fussy about the condition of his prey.

episodes:4652.name: High Bleacher Man
episodes:4652.summary: Hunter and McCall are assigned to protect a sleazy criminal, who has been given immunity for fingering a top criminal. Outraged at having to protect him, Hunter and McCall set out to find someone else who can finger the top criminal.

episodes:4652.name: The Shooter
episodes:4652.summary: Hunter and McCall hunt for the person who shot and killed a motorcycle cop with an armor piercing bullet like the one that was used to kill McCall's husband.

episodes:4652.name: The Garbage Man
episodes:4652.summary: Hunter and an old friend who's a parole officer get in each other's way while trying to investigate the same case.

episodes:4652.name: The Avenging Angel
episodes:4652.summary: A mentally disturbed surveillance expert attempts to "help" Hunter by killing a suspect and a witness. McCall is kidnapped when the surveillance expert is unhappy that Hunter does not approve of his actions.

episodes:4652.name: The Snow Queen (1)
episodes:4652.summary: McCall's prime informant in the case against a drug merchant is a young cocaine supplier who's being extradited as a murder witness by a New York policeman who seems mysteriously intent on killing her.

episodes:4652.name: The Snow Queen (2)
episodes:4652.summary: Dee Dee is in danger as she moves closer to exposing a ruthless drug dealer, while Hunter fights to keep a rogue policeman from killing a material witness.

episodes:4652.name: The Beach Boy
episodes:4652.summary: The Beach Boy arrives in L.A. from Hawaii and begins to kill local drug dealers. Hunter and McCall have to figure out his next move before another victim is claimed.

episodes:4652.name: Guilty
episodes:4652.summary: Hunter and McCall go after a convicted murderer who is back out on the street and has vowed to kill the jurors who convicted him.

episodes:4652.name: The Last Kill
episodes:4652.summary: Hunter and McCall go after a contract killer who is making hits throughout the city in order to ingratiate himself with a criminal kingpin in order to kill him.

episodes:4652.name: Fire Man
episodes:4652.summary: Hunter and McCall are brought in to help solve an arson/murder case. Someone has been setting fires to empty warehouses all over the city.

episodes:4652.name: Sniper
episodes:4652.summary: Hunter and McCall go after a sniper who is killing blondes that remind him of his wife who jilted him 18 years ago. Meanwhile, the Police Department personnel is being audited by a most efficient IRS Agent.

episodes:4652.name: Case X
episodes:4652.summary: A modeling agent is a front for a photographer's personal pornography ring, and when the female porn stars start turning up dead, McCall goes undercover.

episodes:4652.name: Night of the Dragons
episodes:4652.summary: Hunter and McCall's investigation of a killing in Chinatown leads them to a Chinese gang leader being pursued by a police officer with a personal interest in the case.

episodes:4652.name: The Biggest Man in Town
episodes:4652.summary: Hunter and McCall go undercover at an exclusive resort to find a blackmailer's killer.

episodes:4652.name: Rich Girl
episodes:4652.summary: When a millionaire is nearly killed, his wife is the primary heir and prime suspect until she's murdered, prompting Hunter to go undercover to find the real killer.

episodes:4652.name: Killer in a Halloween Mask
episodes:4652.summary: The Captain sends Hunter and McCall to serve as technical advisors for a television police show to keep them out of trouble. Unfortunately, the star of the show is killed, placing Hunter and McCall in the middle of another high-profile murder investigation.

episodes:4652.name: Rape and Revenge (1)
episodes:4652.summary: When McCall is raped by a South American diplomat who's immune from prosecution, Hunter turns renegade and follows the man to his homeland.

episodes:4652.name: Rape and Revenge (2)
episodes:4652.summary: Hunter takes matters into his own hands after his superiors refuse to fight the diplomat's claim of immunity. After learning of Hunter's intentions, McCall tracks her partner down to talk him out of his plan.

episodes:4652.name: Million Dollar Misunderstanding
episodes:4652.summary: A security guard turned thief loses the money he stole, and searches for it with Hunter and McCall in close pursuit.

episodes:4652.name: The Big Fall
episodes:4652.summary: Hunter and McCall are one of the teams assigned to protect a government witness. But when he is thrown out the window of the hotel room, Hunter and Dee Dee are in the middle of a Bullitt-style conspiracy of deadly double crosses. Someone in the department killed the witness and Rick and McCall must find out who and why before Hunter is pinned to the wall for murder one.

episodes:4652.name: Waiting for Mr. Wrong
episodes:4652.summary: McCall warns Hunter against becoming involved with a model who consorts with a murderous jewel thief.

episodes:4652.name: Think Blue
episodes:4652.summary: A group of corrupt cops are stealing electronics and murder a street gang member who witnesses their crimes. Meanwhile, Hunter helps a policeman who is framed for the murder of his wife.

episodes:4652.name: Blow-Up
episodes:4652.summary: Hunter is frustrated in his pursuit of a package bomber whose ruthless methods are being used to systematically kill the participants in the man's trial.

episodes:4652.name: War Zone
episodes:4652.summary: Hunter and McCall work to stop a brigade of suburban mercenaries plotting to break a drug dealer out of prison.

episodes:4652.name: Burned
episodes:4652.summary: Hunter and McCall are given 72 hours to find an attorney who falsified his death.

episodes:4652.name: Scrap Metal
episodes:4652.summary: A dying criminal sends for Hunter and says that he's the man who killed Hunter's father, and that he was paid to do it by his father's partner. Hunter goes to the man who was originally convicted for the murder and asks him if he did it or not; he says he was just trying to rob the place when the police came and assumed he did it. So Hunter sets out to find if his father's partner did have his father killed.

episodes:4652.name: Fagin 1986
episodes:4652.summary: Hunter and McCall's investigation of a teenager's death leads them to a contemporary Fagin who commands a group of barrio boys to commit crimes for him.

episodes:4652.name: 62 Hrs. of Terror
episodes:4652.summary: Hunter and McCall are called to investigate the car bombing of a Middle Eastern consulate member for which a student terrorist group claims responsibility.

episodes:4652.name: Death Machine
episodes:4652.summary: A couple of young punks rip off the house of Lucky Lacy, an underworld jewelry connection, and get away with $2,000,000 in jewels. But when Lacy hires Lincoln, a huge punk killer to find them, dead bodies start piling up and Hunter and McCall are up against their biggest foe yet!

episodes:4652.name: The Setup
episodes:4652.summary: A beautiful young woman is killed in a very professional style and Hunter knows her death is a link to a three year old case of an elusive international criminal named Varn. But before Hunter and McCall can piece together the case, Hunter is framed for a brutal assault.

episodes:4652.name: The Beautiful & the Dead (1)
episodes:4652.summary: When a dead girl disappears from Hunter's living room, Hunter and McCall follow a trail of intrigue, adultery and murder.

episodes:4652.name: The Beautiful & the Dead (2)
episodes:4652.summary: Hunter and McCall's continued investigation into adultery and homicide pits them against a group of Russian spies.

episodes:4652.name: The Return of Typhoon Thompson
episodes:4652.summary: Typhoon Thompson leaves prison after eight years and seeks the person who framed him for murder.

episodes:4652.name: Saturday Night Special
episodes:4652.summary: A series of murders on skid row smash across the headlines. But when Hunter and McCall dig into the case, they discover a witness who swears the killer is a reporter covering the story.

episodes:4652.name: Overnight Sensation
episodes:4652.summary: After killing a fleeing suspect, Hunter becomes the target of an ambitious TV news reporter's campaign against police brutality.

episodes:4652.name: Change Partners and Dance
episodes:4652.summary: Detectives Hunter and McCall must work individually to investigate the killing of a police officer after they are separated as partners by their new precinct leader.

episodes:4652.name: Crime of Passion
episodes:4652.summary: McCall falls in love with an architect who is suspected of slaying a beautiful interior decorator.

episodes:4652.name: The Castro Connection
episodes:4652.summary: Hunter and McCall attempt to break a cocaine syndicate apparently being run by one of Hunter's most trusted ex-partners.

episodes:4652.name: High Noon in L.A.
episodes:4652.summary: The brother of the diplomat who raped McCall comes to Los Angeles to exact revenge against Hunter for killing his brother.

episodes:4652.name: From San Francisco with Love
episodes:4652.summary: A beautiful San Francisco police detective aids Hunter and McCall in solving a series of puzzling murders apparently connected to the estate of a deceased millionaire.

episodes:4652.name: True Confessions
episodes:4652.summary: After a teenage girl dies from a drug overdose during a party and the boys who drugged her are released on a technicality, the girl's sister is considered a suspect when the boys start getting killed.

episodes:4652.name: Love, Hate and Sporty James
episodes:4652.summary: Hunter and McCall try to protect their informant, Sporty James, from his own greed after he blackmails a ruthless cocaine dealer who's responsible for a murder.

episodes:4652.name: The Contract
episodes:4652.summary: A wealthy woman's gardener is killed when he attempts to save her from a kidnapping, putting Hunter's and McCall's suspicions on high alert when her husband quickly pays the ransom and attempts to avoid an investigation after her safe return.

episodes:4652.name: The Cradle Will Rock
episodes:4652.summary: Dee Dee poses as a rock singer to help solve a drug related murder.

episodes:4652.name: Bad Company
episodes:4652.summary: Facing off against a gang of Neo-Nazis responsible for a deadly robbery, Hunter and McCall get help from an unlikely ally in their attempt to escape the violent terrorists.

episodes:4652.name: Down and Under
episodes:4652.summary: Hunter travels to Sydney, Australia in an attempt to find clues regarding both the murder of an elderly woman and the disappearance of an old flame three years ago.

episodes:4652.name: Straight to the Heart
episodes:4652.summary: Hunter goes on an enforced vacation and falls for a beautiful model staying at his hotel, unaware that she was actually sent to kill him.

episodes:4652.name: Requiem for Sergeant McCall
episodes:4652.summary: McCall opposes the parole of an inmate who shot and killed her husband five years before. Against her judgement, he is released and she begins to tail him hoping to gather more evidence against him for a different crime that he possibly committed, but the plan backfires when she is set up similar to that of her late husband.

episodes:4652.name: Double Exposure
episodes:4652.summary: McCall goes undercover as a fashion model to bust a ring of thieves hitting lonely business men in their hotels. When Sporty James shows up and inadvertantly blows McCalls cover, Hunter attempts to get there in time to keep them from getting killed.

episodes:4652.name: The Girl Next Door
episodes:4652.summary: Hunter and McCall pose as husband and wife to investigate the murder of a young girl whose death exposes a Soviet plot to relocate secret agents in the United States.

episodes:4652.name: Any Second Now
episodes:4652.summary:
A fan who was convicted of attacking a pianist is released from prison and is once again a threat to the pianist. 

Note: The pianist in this episode is played by real life stalking victim Theresa Saldana, and the story is similar to her own.

episodes:4652.name: A Child Is Born
episodes:4652.summary: McCall wants to adopt a baby girl whose mother was shot and left brain dead in a case of mistaken identity.

episodes:4652.name: Crossfire
episodes:4652.summary: McCall fears that Hunter's temper will outweigh his judgement when his former girlfriend is murdered and Hunter thinks he knows the identity of the killer.

episodes:4652.name: Hot Pursuit (1)
episodes:4652.summary: Hunter and McCall are investigating a prostitution ring when McCall is shot and seriously wounded, and her informant friend is killed. The trail soon leads to a pimp named Big Jack Hemmings, who Hunter suspects ordered the hit on McCall. While McCall fights to survive as surgeons prepare to take the bullet out, Hunter confronts Hemmings.

episodes:4652.name: Hot Pursuit (2)
episodes:4652.summary: After Hunter leaves Hemmings' mansion, he's arrested by the Beverly Hills police, who are trying to pin a murder charge on Hunter for political reasons. The D.A. decides not to charge Hunter yet, and Hunter soon discovers who the real killer is. It's now a race against time, as Hunter tries to stop the killer from fleeing the country while the Beverly Hills police try to pin the crime on Hunter.

episodes:4652.name: Shades
episodes:4652.summary: Hunter is kidnapped and presumed dead after he travels to visit a sick family friend. McCall must control her frustration when she is paired up with a fashion conscious female partner.

episodes:4652.name: Not Just Another John Doe
episodes:4652.summary: When Hunter and McCall investigate the murder of an unidentified man, their interest is piqued because the victim seemingly never existed, and the killing appears to be a professional murder.

episodes:4652.name: Playing God
episodes:4652.summary: After learning the circumstances leading up to the murder of a notorious Latino crime boss, Hunter and McCall face an ethical dilemma: whether to arrest the killer or let him go free.

episodes:4652.name: The Jade Woman
episodes:4652.summary: When Hunter helps a distressed war buddy look for the kidnappers of his mail order bride, the investigation leads Hunter and McCall to murder and double-cross.

episodes:4652.name: Flashpoint
episodes:4652.summary: A Hispanic city councilman's son is killed in a botched traffic stop and he holds the LAPD responsible, citing racism.

episodes:4652.name: Night on Bald Mountain
episodes:4652.summary: When Hunter and McCall travel to a mountaintop mansion to investigate a murder, they are trapped there overnight with the victim's entire family in the midst of a massive snowstorm.

episodes:4652.name: City of Passion (1)
episodes:4652.summary: Hunter and McCall, along with Detectives Brad Navarro and Kitty O'Hearn, investigate a string of rapes committed against a certain type of female. McCall is accused of entrapment when she busts a prominent judge in a prostitution sting operation. Hunter receives a visit from a teenage prostitute who is concerned her missing friend was murdered

episodes:4652.name: City of Passion (2)
episodes:4652.summary: Hunter spends the night at McCall's house after she receives a threatening phone call from the man known as "Bigfoot," whom they were investigating for the rapes. Brad Navarro's wife kicks him out of the house and hits the LAPD with a massive and somewhat humorous lawsuit, claiming their marriage was failing because of Brad's "unusual appetite for sex" due to being paired up with attractive female partners. Hunter's investigation of a missing girl uncovers a local satanic cult, led by the very judge McCall arrested. The LAPD conduct a stakeout in an attempt to catch "Bigfoot," but he outsmarts them and nearly claims Sgt. McCall as his next victim.

episodes:4652.name: City of Passion (3)
episodes:4652.summary: McCall's fight to appeal her entrapment accusation uncovers corruption at the hands of the LAPD commander, who resigns amid the controversy. The teenage girl Hunter had been keeping tabs on is murdered by a member of Judge Unger's cult. The judge is arrested by Hunter. Kathy Navarro drops her lawsuit against the LAPD and she and Brad reconcile. Lloyd Fredericks, known as "Bigfoot," is arrested after he beats and nearly rapes Sgt. McCall; Mrs. Fredericks takes her own course of action against him.

episodes:4652.name: Turning Point
episodes:4652.summary: When Hunter and McCall investigate the alleged death of reporter Ralph Ormond they uncover an extortion plot involving George Shadwell, a wealthy industrialist who has illicit dealings with a construction firm.

episodes:4652.name: Hot Prowl
episodes:4652.summary: Hunter and McCall become suspicious when a Bel Air housewife refuses to identify the man who robbed her of a million dollar necklace.

episodes:4652.name: Allegra
episodes:4652.summary: Hunter and McCall investigate the mysterious death of Allegra, Hunter's former girlfriend, to determine if the beautiful young heiress jumped or was pushed from a skyscraper window.

episodes:4652.name: Renegade
episodes:4652.summary: When Hunter investigates a drug ring, his ex-partner, Frank Garriman, becomes a suspect in the murder of the dealers.

episodes:4652.name: The Black Dahlia
episodes:4652.summary: Hunter & McCall post a (fictitious) conclusion to the Black Dahlia murder case, the most famous unsolved murder in the history of the LAPD.

episodes:4652.name: Naked Justice (1)
episodes:4652.summary: Hunter and McCall investigate the mysterious death of a famous movie actress and encounter a surviving sister hungry for the inheritance.

episodes:4652.name: Naked Justice (2)
episodes:4652.summary: Hunter, investigating the murder of a famous movie actress, follows a contract killer to Mexico and learns why the C.I.A. is interested in the killing.

episodes:4652.name: Girl on the Beach
episodes:4652.summary: Hunter must try to keep Charlie Devane on the right side of the law after his ex-wife is mysteriously murdered after a minor fender bender.

episodes:4652.name: The Bogota Million
episodes:4652.summary: The mobsters are pursuing Sporty James because they think he stole a million dollars from them. The police are pursuing him because they think he killed one of the mobsters.

episodes:4652.name: Death Signs
episodes:4652.summary: Hunter is assisted in a murder investigation by a sign language interpreter when the murder victim is a deaf man.

episodes:4652.name: Boomerang
episodes:4652.summary: The wife of a businessman who was killed in an explosion on his yacht becomes the prime suspect when Hunter and McCall discover that she was recently removed from his will.

episodes:4652.name: The Fourth Man
episodes:4652.summary: Hunter and McCall investigate the whereabouts of four million dollars still missing from a six year old drug bust that implicates the police, and Hunter, in criminal activity.

episodes:4652.name: Murder He Wrote
episodes:4652.summary: Hunter and McCall have dinner with a millionaire who thinks that his heirs are plotting his murder.

episodes:4652.name: Silver Bullet
episodes:4652.summary: The only clue in a series of murders is a trail of police-issued ammunition that leads Hunter and McCall to suspect a colleague as the killer.

episodes:4652.name: Heir of Neglect
episodes:4652.summary: Hunter investigates the case of a teenage boy who mistakenly shot his parents during what he claimed was a home invasion.

episodes:4652.name: The Baby Game
episodes:4652.summary: Hunter and McCall enter the world of baby brokering when they find the murdered body of an expensive call girl, and a two year old toddler left unharmed in front of the woman's television set.

episodes:4652.name: Dead on Target (1)
episodes:4652.summary: While investigating the apparent suicide of Hunter's friend from the Vietnam War, Hunter and McCall uncover a 20 year old betrayal that is still killing people today.

episodes:4652.name: Dead on Target (2)
episodes:4652.summary: Convinced his buddy was murdered, Hunter investigates other war pals and uncovers ties to gem smuggling.

episodes:4652.name: Presumed Guilty
episodes:4652.summary: McCall's current boyfriend disagrees with Hunter's belief that a suspect is guilty of burglary but not murder.

episodes:4652.name: No Good Deed Ever Goes Unpunished
episodes:4652.summary: Mysterious tape recordings accusing a powerful company of illegally dumping toxic waste seem like a prank--until Hunter and McCall find that someone is willing to kill to conceal the truth.

episodes:4652.name: Honorable Profession
episodes:4652.summary: Hunter puts his job on the line when he defends a female officer, critically wounded in the line of duty, against accusations of employing improper procedures during a Chinatown shooting.

episodes:4652.name: Payback
episodes:4652.summary: Hunter and McCall try to solve a bank robbery and murder, while attempting to cope with the double and triple-crossing schemes of a small time criminal who once saved Hunter's life and won't let him forget it.

episodes:4652.name: Partners
episodes:4652.summary: When the husband of a policewoman is murdered, evidence of wife abuse makes Hunter and McCall suspect the woman's patrol partner who knew about the beatings.

episodes:4652.name: The Pit
episodes:4652.summary: A police dispatcher is pressured to assist robbers because his son is indebted to loan sharks due to his gambling.

episodes:4652.name: City Under Siege (1)
episodes:4652.summary: An escaped death row inmate seeks revenge on Hunter, while McCall poses as a teacher to probe links between the convict and a teacher's murder.

episodes:4652.name: City Under Siege (2)
episodes:4652.summary: The escaped murderer continues to stalk Hunter; a vigilante desperately tries to stop crime in his neighborhood.

episodes:4652.name: City Under Siege (3)
episodes:4652.summary: The death of a neighborhood vigilante helps Hunter track down the escaped murderer; McCall works to bust the leader of a high school pornography film operation.

episodes:4652.name: Me, Myself & Die
episodes:4652.summary: A woman is the prime suspect in a brutal murder case after she stops taking her experimental medication.

episodes:4652.name: Informant
episodes:4652.summary: When a convicted murderer is let out on bail pending a new trial in which he intends to defend himself, Hunter puts his career at risk to protect the identity of the informant to whom he had promised anonymity seven years earlier.

episodes:4652.name: Blood Line
episodes:4652.summary: Hunter and McCall find a web of vengeance and fraud when they investigate the killing of a thoroughbred racehorse.

episodes:4652.name: Shoot to Kill
episodes:4652.summary: McCall is suspected of having shot an innocent man during a shootout in an alley and fights to clear her name with help from Hunter and Sporty James. While helping McCall, they discover a ring of jewel thieves.

episodes:4652.name: Code 3
episodes:4652.summary: When a nurse she recently befriended is killed in a car accident related to alcohol just a few days later, McCall suspects foul play. She is even more convinced of that after learning the nurse was pregnant, and would not have mixed alcohol with the morning sickness medication she was taking.

episodes:4652.name: Ring of Honor
episodes:4652.summary: Boxing turns deadly when the manager of promising fighter Sonny Ruiz and a doctor are both murdered. Hunter penetrates the world of prizefighting with the help of a trainer named Benny Shaffer.

episodes:4652.name: Teen Dreams
episodes:4652.summary: Prostitutes are being murdered by a man who lures them disguised as a police officer. When McCall's friend Debbie Small returns to the profession, she may be the next target.

episodes:4652.name: Last Run
episodes:4652.summary: After a series of arson murders, Hunter learns the the case involves the kidnapping of an undercover agent. Another cop interferes with the investigation.

episodes:4652.name: Return of White Cloud
episodes:4652.summary: Hunter and McCall investigate the murder of an art gallery owner involved in illegal sales of Indian artifacts and find themselves drawn into a mysterious world of native American politics.

episodes:4652.name: On Air
episodes:4652.summary: Hunter poses as a radio talk show host's lover to solve a series of murders involving her ex-boyfriends.

episodes:4652.name: Shillelagh
episodes:4652.summary: Hunter and McCall are assigned to protect the Irish patriot brother of Devane's new lady friend, but find the man is the assassin instead of the intended victim.

episodes:4652.name: Investment in Death
episodes:4652.summary: After leaving a gang, the former member is the victim of a drive-by shooting.

episodes:4652.name: A Girl Named Hunter
episodes:4652.summary: Hunter delivers a baby for Cheryl Donavan, a runaway from San Diego, who decides to name her girl after him. When Cheryl winds up dead, Hunter uncovers a baby breeding operation that sells infants as though they were property.

episodes:4652.name: The Legion (1)
episodes:4652.summary: Hunter and McCall must track down the leader of the White Supremacists after he escapes from prison. Problems arise when a friend of McCall's, her former training officer, tries to help and is charged with obstruction of justice. McCall tries to help him overcome his depression over his loneliness, but she is not able to help in time.

episodes:4652.name: The Legion (2)
episodes:4652.summary: Overcome with guilt over the suicide of her training officer, McCall quits the force and is kidnapped by white supremacists. Hunter sets out to rescue her before it's too late.

episodes:4652.name: Yesterday's Child
episodes:4652.summary: Hunter receives a life altering shock when he is asked to take the case of a Vietnamese teenager who is accused of murdering a car salesman.

episodes:4652.name: Shield of Honor
episodes:4652.summary: Hunter's murder investigation is complicated when he is assigned to train the incompetent son of his old training officer.

episodes:4652.name: The Fifth Victim
episodes:4652.summary: Hunter and McCall track down a departmental leak in the investigation of a serial killer targeting homosexuals. A local painter confesses to committing all but one of the murders.

episodes:4652.name: Brotherly Love
episodes:4652.summary: A young drug user who accidentally murders his pusher and then steals $200,000 in mob money from him is pursued by the pushers' drug supplier; the user's brother tries to save him.

episodes:4652.name: The Nightmare
episodes:4652.summary: Hunter and McCall pursue the killer of McCall's cleaning woman, a ruthless Central American doctor who brutally tortured the woman and her family many years before.

episodes:4652.name: Broken Dreams
episodes:4652.summary: Hunter attempts to protect his high school sweetheart after she witnesses a murder. Her unemployed husband convinces her to take part in blackmail instead of cooperating with Hunter.

episodes:4652.name: Son and Heir
episodes:4652.summary: Hunter's investigation of a murdered cop reveals that the victim was the illegitimate son of a Mafia boss and that the killer was the man's brother.

episodes:4652.name: Unacceptable Loss
episodes:4652.summary: A child is dead after inhaling fumes from illegally dumped cyanide, and Hunter and McCall work to charge a chemical company with second degree murder.

episodes:4652.name: Unfinished Business
episodes:4652.summary: Hunter and McCall have unresolved issues with regard to their previous love affair when Hunter's former co-worker is assigned to help with the investigation of a robber turned murderer.

episodes:4652.name: Lullaby
episodes:4652.summary: A Scotland Yard inspector comes to town when the murder of a British prostitute resembles a string of similar murders in the U.K.

episodes:4652.name: Final Confession
episodes:4652.summary: Hunter and McCall suspect that two murders were committed as an act of revenge by a man who was recently paroled. They become frustrated when they discover that a Catholic priest knows the identity of the killer, but refuses to break his vow of confession and tell them who it is.

episodes:4652.name: Blind Ambition
episodes:4652.summary: When a young, convicted murderer commits suicide, his vengeful brother holds McCall and the judge she's dating captive, forcing McCall to discover the truth of the case.

episodes:4652.name: Sudden Withdrawal
episodes:4652.summary: Hunter and McCall search for a beautiful woman whose numerous liaisons are linked to a series of bank robberies.

episodes:4652.name: Second Sight
episodes:4652.summary: A man claims to have seen two murders in psychic visions. Hunter and McCall are skeptical until he proclaims that McCall is the next victim.

episodes:4652.name: Street Wise (1)
episodes:4652.summary: As McCall rekindles an old romance, Hunter insinuates himself into a case involving the mysterious theft of a vagrant's Medal of Honor.

episodes:4652.name: Street Wise (2)
episodes:4652.summary: As an investigation into an elaborate fencing operation leads Hunter to the killer of a fellow officer and friend, McCall weighs the decision to marry and quit the force.

episodes:4652.name: Deadly Encounters (1)
episodes:4652.summary: Hunter teams with two Metro officers, one of whom is a former adversary, to locate the missing profits of a murdered black marketeer, as Devane considers a post in Metro.

episodes:4652.name: Deadly Encounters (2)
episodes:4652.summary: Hunter and Molenski officially become partners in the Metro Division following completion of their first case together.

episodes:4652.name: Where Echoes End
episodes:4652.summary: A late report made by an undercover officer who witnesses the murder of a Treasury Agent arouses suspicion.

episodes:4652.name: Kill Zone
episodes:4652.summary: Molenski is reminded of painful events while investigating a series of murder cases in which the victims were also raped.

episodes:4652.name: The Incident
episodes:4652.summary: An innocent African American teenager is beaten when vigilante crimes cause friction between the police, the press, and a neighborhood watch group.

episodes:4652.name: A Snitch'll Break Your Heart
episodes:4652.summary: Molenski battles with the department to protect the identity of an informant as Hunter investigates the death of an adopted boy.

episodes:4652.name: Oh, the Shark Bites!
episodes:4652.summary: Charlie Devane risks his career to protect his father's reputation after his father's name turns up on a murdered mob accountant's "debtors" list.

episodes:4652.name: The Usual Suspects
episodes:4652.summary: Hunter leads a massive police operation to find dozens of prisoners set free by a computer operator who wants one of them to kill her husband.

episodes:4652.name: This Is My Gun
episodes:4652.summary: While investigating a series of art thefts, Molenski's gun is stolen and used in a fatal robbery.

episodes:4652.name: La Familia
episodes:4652.summary: A mobster is pressured by his father to remain in the family business after he returns home from prison.

episodes:4652.name: Acapulco Holiday
episodes:4652.summary: During the investigation of a series of robberies, Hunter clashes with an opportunistic lawyer when he arrests the wrong suspect.

episodes:4652.name: Fatal Obsession (1)
episodes:4652.summary: A former girlfriend complicates Hunter's investigation of a string of campus murders while Molenski becomes the target of a cop killer.

episodes:4652.name: Fatal Obsession (2)
episodes:4652.summary: Joanne Molenski has been killed and serial murder expert Chris Novak agrees to further postpone her leave of absence in order to help Hunter track the killer, who appears to be tied to the murders of police officers in six other cities.

episodes:4652.name: Under Suspicion
episodes:4652.summary: Hunter searches for a missing witness while Novak seeks assistance from a computer expert to locate burglars.

episodes:4652.name: The Reporter
episodes:4652.summary: Novak is pleased when old friend and national newspaper reporter Amy Rivers comes to Los Angeles to do a story on police work, until Amy's enthusiasm impedes an armed robbery investigation. Novak is puzzled by her friend's insensitive attitude until she learns of Amy's recently acquired cocaine dependence.

episodes:4652.name: Room Service
episodes:4652.summary: Old passions and jealousies flare when Hunter is forced to work with Chris Novak's ex-husband to solve a series of airport robberies while Chris tries to find an escaped prisoner she once arrested.

episodes:4652.name: Shadows of the Past
episodes:4652.summary: When Chris Novak's estranged father returns to her life, it's not to rekindle their relationship but to find and kill the only man who can expose his involvement in a drug ring.

episodes:4652.name: The Grab
episodes:4652.summary: Chris' daughter is kidnapped to prevent her father from providing Hunter and Chris with vital information on a killer and a counterfeit ring.

episodes:4652.name: All That Glitters
episodes:4652.summary: Hunter searches for the killer of several coin dealers while Novak is concerned about the arrest of a teenaged mugger who victimized her neighbor.

episodes:4652.name: Cries of Silence
episodes:4652.summary: Novak helps a deaf woman search for her runaway daughter; Hunter investigates murder linked to a weapons cartel.

episodes:4652.name: Ex Marks the Spot
episodes:4652.summary: A series of cleaning store robberies exposes the chain's owner as the decoy for a money laundering conspiracy and causes suspicion from his very dangerous partners.

episodes:4652.name: Little Man with a Big Reputation
episodes:4652.summary: Devane becomes entangled in the life of an ex-convict who disappears shortly before his wedding.

show:the elephant man.name: The Elephant Man
show:the elephant man.summary: The Elephant Man follows the compelling and extraordinary life of Joseph Merrick from his working-class beginnings in Leicestershire, through the work-houses, music halls and freak shows that punctuated 19th Century culture and society; to his time at the London Hospital and his vital friendship with Dr Frederick Treves. Starting with his birth and ending with his death, McKay's adaptation covers the true events of Merrick's personal odyssey, his extreme courage, determination and human dignity despite challenges arising from his disability. It explores the mysteries that surround Merrick and the man behind the myth.

show:gotham comedy live.name: Gotham Comedy Live
show:gotham comedy live.summary: AXS TV dives deep into the world of comedy with Gotham Comedy Live. Another round of great live standup comes your way starting May 16! Tune in each Thursday as some of the funniest comics in America perform live from the Legendary Gotham Comedy Club in New York.

Best of Season One: The Wrath of Com
Best of Season Two: New York's Finest
Best of Season Two: Return of the Zings
Best of Season Two: Ladies of the Night
New York: The City that Never Bleeps
Ellen Cleghorne

episodes:5374.name: Flex Alexander
episodes:5374.summary: Get ready for a night of outrageous, off-the-wall comedy with One On One and Snakes on a Plane star Flex Alexander and four of America's funniest up and coming comics. Join Flex, Mike Young Taylor Tomlinson, Tanael Joachim and Matt McClowry as they perform LIVE and UNCENSORED from New York's legendary Gotham Comedy Club.

episodes:5374.name: Kathleen Madigan
episodes:5374.summary: Don't miss Kathleen Madigan as she hosts an all-new hour of LIVE and UNCENSORED standup from New York's Gotham Comedy Club. Join Kathleen, Taylor Ketchum and Royale Watkins for a night of laugh-out-loud jokes that will have you rolling off the couch.

episodes:5374.name: Michael Che
episodes:5374.summary: Saturday Night Live's Michael Che will have you gasping for air as he hosts an outrageous hour of LIVE and UNCENSORED comedy from New York's Gotham Comedy Club. Don't miss the Weekend Update anchor along with America's funniest up and coming comics Ed Hill, Kelly MacFarland and Mark Poolos.

episodes:5374.name: Sandra Bernhard
episodes:5374.summary: 2 Broke Girls and Roseanne's Sandra Bernhard will knock you off the couch laughing with an outrageous hour of LIVE and UNCENSORED comedy from New York's Gotham Comedy Club. Don't miss the woman Comedy Central calls one of the "Greatest Standup Comedians of All Time" along with Theo Von, Julie Goldman and Juston McKinney.

episodes:5374.name: Bill Engvall
episodes:5374.summary: It's Hee Haw on steroids when Blue Collar Comedy Tour's Bill Engvall takes the stage for an outrageous hour of LIVE standup comedy from New York's legendary Gotham Comedy Club. Don't miss the Sharknado 3 star along with four of America's funniest comics: Jason Lawhead, Brad Zimmerman, Jen Murphy and Beth Stelling.

episodes:5374.name: Lewis Black
episodes:5374.summary: Cover your ears for the loudest night of comedy on TV when the "king of the rant', Lewis Black, hosts an outrageous hour of LIVE and UNCENSORED standup from New York's Gotham Comedy Club. Don't miss this comic legend as he goes off on all the hypocrisy he sees around him along with Jim Colliton, Erin Foley and more.

episodes:5374.name: 100th Episode
episodes:5374.summary: Gotham Comedy Live celebrates its 100th episode with LIVE and UNCENSORED performances by Artie Lange, Gilbert Gottfried, Jackie "The Joke Man" Martling, Mario Cantone and Orlando Jones.

episodes:5374.name: Best of Season 5: Straight Outta Comicton
episodes:5374.summary: Funnyman Jim Florentine hosts this latest edition of the Best of Gotham Comedy Live. This hilarious show includes comics like Christopher Titus, Aries Spears, Sinbad, Harland Williams, Margaret Cho and many more joking about current topics.

episodes:5374.name: Ahmed Ahmed
episodes:5374.summary: Sullivan and Son's Ahmed Ahmed hosts an outrageous hour of LIVE and UNCENSORED standup from New York's legendary Gotham Comedy Club.

episodes:5374.name: Ari Shaffir
episodes:5374.summary: Comedian Ari Shaffir ("This Is Not Happening") hosts and performs on AXS TV's original stand-up series GOTHAM COMEDY LIVE. The series airs live from the Gotham Comedy Club in New York City.

episodes:5374.name: Brad Garrett
episodes:5374.summary: Comedian Brad Garrett ("Everybody Loves Raymond") hosts and performs on AXS TV's original stand-up series GOTHAM COMEDY LIVE for the first time. The series airs live from the Gotham Comedy Club in New York City.

episodes:5374.name: Norm Macdonald
episodes:5374.summary: Saturday Night Live legend Norm Macdonald hosts and performs on AXS TV's original stand-up series GOTHAM COMEDY LIVE. The series airs live from the Gotham Comedy Club in New York City.

episodes:5374.name: Cheech Marin
episodes:5374.summary: Stoner comedy legend Cheech Marin hosts and performs on AXS TV's original stand-up series GOTHAM COMEDY LIVE. The series airs live from the Gotham Comedy Club in New York City.

episodes:5374.name: Cheri Oteri
episodes:5374.summary: Saturday Night Live alum Cheri Oteri hosts and performs on AXS TV's original stand-up series GOTHAM COMEDY LIVE. The series airs live from the Gotham Comedy Club in New York City.

episodes:5374.name: Jay Pharoah
episodes:5374.summary: Saturday Night Live master impressionist Jay Pharoah hosts an all new LIVE and UNCENSORED hour of standup from New York's Gotham Comedy Club.

episodes:5374.name: Chris D'Elia
episodes:5374.summary: Undateable and Whitney star Chris D'Elia hosts an outrageous hour of LIVE and UNCENSORED standup from New York's Gotham Comedy Club.

episodes:5374.name: Cheech & Chong
episodes:5374.summary: Legendary duo Cheech & Chong light up the stage - literally - in this once in a lifetime performance from New York's Gotham Comedy Club.

episodes:5374.name: William Shatner
episodes:5374.summary: Gotham Comedy Live goes where no man has gone before when "Star Trek" legend William Shatner takes the stage with his first ever standup comedy performance. Don't miss this one and only chance to see the "T.J. Hooker" star's brilliant comedic mind along with Ryan Schutt, Jocelyn Chia, Fen G. and Daniel Tirado.

episodes:5374.name: Fran Drescher
episodes:5374.summary: The one, the only, the original Nanny, Fran Drescher hosts an all new live and uncensored hour of standup from New York's Gotham Comedy Club. Don't miss the Happily Divorced star's hilarious set about her own crazy life as she's joined by Mike Cannon, Dan Harumi, Larry Beyah and Rich Aronovitch.

episodes:5374.name: Pete Davidson
episodes:5374.summary: "Saturday Night Live" standout Pete Davidson hosts this week's episode of GOTHAM COMEDY LIVE. The weekly stand-up comedy series highlights some of the nation's top stand-up comedians, as emerging talent and established favorites take the stage at the world-famous Gotham Comedy Club in New York City.

episodes:5374.name: Sherri Shepherd
episodes:5374.summary: Actress and comedian Sherri Shepherd hosts this week's episode of GOTHAM COMEDY LIVE. The weekly stand-up comedy series highlights some of the nation's top stand-up comedians, as emerging talent and established favorites take the stage at the world-famous Gotham Comedy Club in New York City.

episodes:5374.name: John Fugelsang
episodes:5374.summary: VH1's John Fugelsang hosts a hilarious hour of standup from New York's legendary Gotham Comedy Club. Don't miss the Politically Incorrect regular along with Cameran Hebb, Mike Yard, Brendan Eyre and Tom McTiernan, live, uncensored and unrestrained!

episodes:5374.name: Judy Tenuta
episodes:5374.summary: Self-proclaimed "Love Goddess" Judy Tenuta hosts an all new hour of standup from New York's Gotham Comedy Club. Join in on the insanity with Judy and four of America's funniest comics, Dan Crohn, Sal Calanni, Del Harrison and Anthony Devito for a night of non-stop, uncensored comedy.

episodes:38307.name: The Fight
episodes:38307.summary: When the gang's resident tough guy Ashley is drugged during a bare-knuckle fight against a fighter from a rival family of travellers, Vinnie steps up to fight a rematch in his stead, thereby convincing everyone he'll get himself killed. As he puts in the hours training, local gangster Terence McCann closes in, still upset over the Shetland pony debacle. The question is, who's going to kill Vinnie first?

episodes:38307.name: The Fish
episodes:38307.summary: Scrambling to pay back gangster Terence McCann, Vinnie and the lads accept some fast cash from a disgruntled housewife who hires them to kill her ex-husband's prized koi carp collection.

episodes:38307.name: Ronnie's Out
episodes:38307.summary: A raid on a weed farm goes wrong when Erin's brother turns up and someone accidentally gets kidnapped.

episodes:38307.name: Stolen Antiques
episodes:38307.summary: Vinnie nicks a car containing McCann's stolen antiques and must find the thief or face dismemberment.

episodes:38307.name: The Circus
episodes:38307.summary: Vinnie has been hiding out in his weed shed since faking his own death to escape from local gangster Terrance McCann. Tommo and Erin need his help and try to lure him out of hiding with a new business proposition and together with the lads they plot to rob a travelling circus. With the help of a disgruntled clown, Mr Popov played by John Thomson, the gang aim to make this theft a ‘roaring' success...

episodes:38307.name: A Nice Day Out
episodes:38307.summary: Vinnie strikes a deal with McCann and has to collect a guy called Tony Tillerton, but what seems like a simple task is hit by catastrophe when a high-speed car chase goes wrong.

episodes:38307.name: Antique Hunters
episodes:38307.summary: Erin attends a disastrous dinner party with Jake's family, while Tommo plans to steal some erotic furniture for the Rat & Cutter.

episodes:38307.name: The Intruder
episodes:38307.summary: Suffering from insomnia, Vinnie goes to the local pub, but things take a sinister turn when a stranger breaks in.

episodes:38307.name: The Festival
episodes:38307.summary: Ordered by McCann to sell all the weed they have grown, the lads decide to throw a music festival in Jim's field.

episodes:38307.name: Stealing a Wedding
episodes:38307.summary: When a friend gets engaged, Vinnie wants to throw them the best wedding he can. So he tries to steal one.

episodes:38307.name: The Great Bull Semen Heist
episodes:38307.summary: Vinnie finally gets released from prison and with the newly promoted Detective Carl Slater watching his every move, he is doing his best to lie low.

episodes:38307.name: Gideon's Mum's Funeral
episodes:38307.summary: Vinnie's friend Gideon calls to say his mother has passed away, and asks Vin to help him honour her final wishes with a dignified farewell.

episodes:38307.name: The Ransom
episodes:38307.summary: Vinnie is called to be the bag drop man when Ashley's cousin is kidnapped for ransom. But when the boys lose the money, a backup plan is needed - quickly.

episodes:38307.name: Classic Cars
episodes:38307.summary: Mr and Mrs Bishop are back and the gang are again caught up in their bitter divorce battle, as Mr Bishop asks Vinnie to nick his prized classic cars.

episodes:38307.name: Parenthood
episodes:38307.summary: When Ashley decides that he wants to track down his real father, Vinnie and the gang promise to do everything they can to help find him.

episodes:38307.name: The Keithy Problem
episodes:38307.summary: Erin reluctantly convinces Farmer Jim to house her repentant brother when he arrives in town, but it's not long until he's causing havoc.

episodes:38307.name: Bees
episodes:38307.summary: The gang are in a buzz when Vinnie is tasked by Chinese Dan to steal some beehives. Erin presents a repayment plan to McCann.

episodes:38307.name: The Shack
episodes:38307.summary: The gang come together to help as a reckless Vinnie and a worried Erin find themselves cornered by McCann.

episodes:38307.name: Getting There
episodes:38307.summary: The gang heads to Wales for Ringo and Babs' wedding, while Vinnie gets wind of Erin's hiding place and uses the road trip as an excuse to go and get her. A car crash, a tense encounter with the MacDonagh brothers and a dinner of roadkill with a creepy farmer keep one half of the gang busy, while the other half attempt to babysit an out-of-control Babs.

episodes:38307.name: Day at the Dogs
episodes:38307.summary: Chinese Dan agrees to give his retired racing greyhound to Cardi, and the gang sees a cash opportunity and hatches a plan to get the dog racing again. However, training is interrupted when the dog runs off into the woods and returns with a human foot.

episodes:38307.name: Lost in the Woods
episodes:38307.summary: What should have been a fun, lads-only camping trip turns into a nightmare when the gang end up horrendously lost.

episodes:38307.name: Exotic Zoo
episodes:38307.summary: When Manolito, Davey MacDonagh's eccentric distributor, offends Vinnie, the gang decide to get revenge by raiding his exotic zoo.

episodes:38307.name: Amy
episodes:38307.summary: A young woman claims to be Erin's half-sister, but is she telling the truth? The gang attempt to steal a rare and valuable rose.

episodes:38307.name: Saint Erin (Murder Mystery)
episodes:38307.summary: The gang join a posh murder mystery in order to steal some valuable vintage wine, but problems arise when they get a little too drawn into the game...

episodes:38307.name: An Unexpected Guest
episodes:38307.summary: Vinnie befriends an elderly woman who is hiding from Davey MacDonagh. Can the gang get their new friend to safety without Davey finding out?

episodes:38307.name: Finale
episodes:38307.summary: With the MacDonaghs on the war path and a deal with Manolito in the balance, the gang must break into Davey's house...

episodes:38307.name: Eddie
episodes:38307.summary: A chaotic 24 hours as the gang takes an unlikely hostage and escorts him on his bizarre round of errands.

episodes:38307.name: The Missing Body
episodes:38307.summary: A catastrophic encounter with an old land mine lands the gang in trouble with the MacDonaghs again.

episodes:38307.name: Hans
episodes:38307.summary: Tommo gets the surprise of his life when a young German man comes to town.

episodes:38307.name: Sweet Sixteen
episodes:38307.summary: Erin's dad dies, leaving her with a debt to the local honchos, so the gang do what they do best to get the money - some cheeky thievery.

episodes:38307.name: Ratcatcher
episodes:38307.summary: A ratcatcher is hired to help with Jim's rat problem, but it is soon clear it's him who needs help.

episodes:38307.name: Caravan of Courage
episodes:38307.summary: A caravan with some precious cargo goes missing and the gang are tasked with getting it back.

episodes:38307.name: Albert
episodes:38307.summary: A giant bunny, a crocodile and a golf buggy chase - Cardi goes on a mission that'll truly test his mettle.

episodes:38307.name: The Manolito Problem
episodes:38307.summary: In their biggest heist yet, the gang steals some rare Lowry paintings.

episodes:38307.name: Stolen FA Cup
episodes:38307.summary: Vinnie and the gang realise there are only two ways to lift the FA Cup - win the final or steal the trophy.

episodes:38307.name: That Night
episodes:38307.summary: We jump back in time to the cliff-hanger at the end of last season and finally find out what happened that night with Manolito. As the gang attempt to sweep the whole thing under the rug with the aid of Lola the crocodile, Davey MacDonagh makes moves on Manolito's turf, while Erin decides enough is enough, and sets her eyes on Blackpool.

episodes:38307.name: Blast from the Past
episodes:38307.summary: Farmer Jim is forced on a bumpy trip down memory lane when an old flame pops up in Hawley. This remarkable woman once saw something in the old git that hasn't been seen since, can she reignite the spark? Also – JJ is back! With the help of Jim's saucy ex, the gang come up with an elaborate scheme to clear JJ's name and get a confession out of his backstabbing cousin, Sarim.

episodes:38307.name: Naked Cult
episodes:38307.summary: Gideon has found his people; the only problem is they're all naked and it's a cult. It's up to the gang to rescue him. They pose as cult members to get close, but before long they're in dangerously deep and need rescuing themselves. Elsewhere Tommo teams up with a one-time dance arcade champion to bring down a rival club. The kid gave up on his dream long ago, until Tommo inspires him to get his groove back.

episodes:38307.name: Heartbreak
episodes:38307.summary: Wedding bells are ringing in Hawley, and it's a nightmare. Cardi's mum returns after being AWOL for years with a new fiancé in tow. She's getting married for the fourth time and is demanding Cardi organise it ... in 48 hours. At the same time a mystery man from Carol's past shows up and threatens to destroy everything. Carol and Cardi's marriage is put to the ultimate test - can our golden couple survive this?

episodes:38307.name: The Mark
episodes:38307.summary: Ashley is on a mission to reinstate his reputation as 'the muscle' of the group. As he gears up for a fight that could make or break him, a dodgy agent attempts to make things dirtier than they have to be. Meanwhile the gang are distracted by Erin's visit to Hawley and the promise of a big pay day. Her new dickhead bosses claim to own a priceless historical relic. Only Erin's been set up and the job isn't exactly what it seems.

episodes:38307.name: Two Funerals and a Wedding
episodes:38307.summary: The gang now must plan another event, one they never wanted to see happen. But a goat, some middle-aged cheerleaders and a hell of a lot of weed makes this a classic Brassic finale. This group of friends know how to bring the joy, even at the saddest moments. Meanwhile Davey deals with the McCann problem once and for all.

episodes:38307.name: The Bishops
episodes:38307.summary: Vinnie is trying to lay low, until a new, younger gang are spotted and appear to be rivalling his crew in local dodgy dealings.

episodes:38307.name: Germany
episodes:38307.summary: Tommo sets off on a journey to Germany to land an investment. Meanwhile, back in Hawley, Davey needs Vinnie's help.

episodes:38307.name: Skool Reunion
episodes:38307.summary: A school reunion transports the gang back to their past, where Ronnie faces an old bully, Erin springs into action, and Vinnie accompanies Davey to a peace meeting with Joey Kittens.

episodes:38307.name: The Wizard of E
episodes:38307.summary: Curtis Plum revives his DJ persona for a dying man - can the gang find his right-hand man before time runs out?

episodes:38307.name: Halloween Heist
episodes:38307.summary: It's Halloween and an old enemy of the MacDonagh's has died. Davey refuses to let him rest in peace and ropes the gang into stealing his corpse before the funeral. They dress the corpse up as a mummy to get it out undetected.

episodes:38307.name: The Carvery
episodes:38307.summary: Snowed in at an all-you-can-eat carvery with Davey on the warpath, things can't get much worse, until they do.

show:midsomer murders.name: Midsomer Murders
show:midsomer murders.summary: Based originally on the books by Caroline Graham, each self-contained episode of two hours is a classic whodunit revolving around Detective Chief Inspector Barnaby and his partner, and their efforts to solve the numerous gruesome murders which take place in the picturesque countryside of Midsomer County.

episodes:328.name: Written in Blood
episodes:328.summary: The secretary of the Midsomer Worthy's writers' circle is found brutally murdered after objecting to a visit from a best-selling novelist.

episodes:328.name: Death of a Hollow Man
episodes:328.summary: In the quiet rural village of Ferne Basset, an elderly resident is inexplicably found drowned after a violet attack and Barnaby and Troy are sent to investigate. Meanwhile, a local amateur dramatic production of Amadeus reveals a hitherto hidden backstage world of intrigue, passion and gossip, and a whole new meaning to corpsing.

episodes:328.name: Faithful Unto Death
episodes:328.summary: Community spirit is running high in the village of Morton Fendle as many villagers have invested in the local craft centre, Morton Mill, owned by Alan Hollingsworth. However, the project is in financial ruin and DCI Barnaby is brought in to investigate, in what turns out to be a much more sinister case; Hollingsworth's wife has disappeared, a neighbour is murdered, and the vigilantes in the village want their money back.

episodes:328.name: Death in Disguise
episodes:328.summary: When May Cuttle, from the Lodge of the Golden Windhorse interrupts DCI Barnaby during preparations for Sunday lunch, little does he realise the intrigue that is to follow. The home for 'travellers' at the Lodge becomes the scene of Barney and Troy's investigations when the founder of the new-age commune, accidentally falls down the stairs to his death. But when the other founder is murdered in front of a roomful of people, the first death starts to look as if it may have not been an accident at all.

episodes:328.name: Death's Shadow
episodes:328.summary: Plans by Barnaby to renew his wedding vows in Badger's Drift, are quickly put on hold when the body of a local property developer is found decapitated in his own home. The detective is left mystified as to why anyone would kill a man who only had weeks to live, after being recently diagnosed with a brain tumour. As he and Troy attempt to find out, they soon encounter a hotbed of local corruption and property feuding within the village as the body count rises and the mystery deepens.

episodes:328.name: Strangler's Wood
episodes:328.summary: Spurred into action by the discovery of a woman's body in Midsomer Worthy's Raven's Wood, Barnaby and Troy re-examine three similar unsolved murders in the same village, hoping to get a lead before the killer strikes again. As they dig deeper into the clandestine world of the community, they find themselves embroiled in a sinister web of deceit, violence, and mystery.

episodes:328.name: Dead Man's Eleven
episodes:328.summary: Fletcher's Cross is preparing itself for the annual cricket match against neighbouring village Midsomer Worthy, when tragedy strikes and Tara Cavendish the wife of a wealthy local landowner is found bludgeoned to death with a cricket bat. Barnaby and Troy are soon enmeshed in a succession of calculating murders, and nobody is above suspicion.

episodes:328.name: Blood Will Out
episodes:328.summary: When Orville Tudway arrives in the village of Martyr Warren and is swiftly joined by his old arch enemy the Smith clan, the two groups of travellers quickly threaten to shatter the serene peace of the village. Although Barnaby and Troy are initially called to the local manor house to investigate the disappearance of a goose, events take a more macabre turn when the local magistrate owner and antagoniser of the travellers is found dead at his opulent home.

episodes:328.name: Death of a Stranger
episodes:328.summary: When a tramp is found murdered in the woods near the village of Marshwood, Superintendent Ronald Pringle quickly arrests a local poacher for the crime and retires in a blaze of glory. However, Barnaby suspects an innocent man has been arrested, and when a second body is found under suspicious circumstances, it starts to look like Superintendent Pringle has rushed to judgement.

episodes:328.name: Blue Herrings
episodes:328.summary: A visit to his convalescent aunt prompts Barnaby to investigate a series of suspicious deaths at the nursing home where she is staying.

episodes:328.name: Judgement Day
episodes:328.summary: The residents of Midsomer Mallow fear for their chances in The Perfect Village competition when Peter Drinkwater, a local thief and womaniser, is brutally killed with a pitchfork.

episodes:328.name: Beyond the Grave
episodes:328.summary: The slashing of a 17th century painting in the Aspen Tallow museum appears to herald the beginning of a series of ghostly goings-on. Is someone attempting to communicate beyond the grave or is something more sinister afoot?

episodes:328.name: Garden of Death
episodes:328.summary: When the arrogant aristocratic family of Inkpen Manor decide to develop a memorial garden into a commercial tea shop, the Midsomer Deverell villagers are up in arms. However, when two members of the Inkpen family are then murdered, Troy and Barnaby must weed through the townspeople's sordid lives to uncover the culprit.

episodes:328.name: Destroying Angel
episodes:328.summary: When the owner of Midsomer's Easterly Grange hotel dies, he leaves his property to be divided equally between several of the hotel's employees. However, when a series of murders also appear to have also been triggered by his death, Barnaby and Troy are called to investigate.

episodes:328.name: The Electric Vendetta
episodes:328.summary: When a man's naked body is discovered in the centre of a crop circle in Midsomer Parva, DCI Tom Barnaby laughs off tales of alien abduction. But as more corpses are discovered - each bearing peculiar injuries - it's up to him to uncover who is responsible, or if extra-terrestrial powers are truly at work in Midsomer.

episodes:328.name: Who Killed Cock Robin?
episodes:328.summary: The disappearance of a horse whisperer in Newton Magna brings Barnaby face to face with old adversary Melvyn Stockard, now reinvented as the village squire. But when a villager's body is pulled out of the well, Barnaby becomes convinced Stockard is somehow involved.

episodes:328.name: Dark Autumn
episodes:328.summary: The brutal murder of a village postman leads Barnaby to a hotbed of adultery within the remote hamlet of Goodman's Land. As more murders rock the tiny hamlet, can community WPC Jay Nash help untangle the web of sexual liaisons to find the killer?

episodes:328.name: Tainted Fruit
episodes:328.summary: When Barnaby and Troy discover the dead body of arrogant,beautiful, and spoilt daughter of the manor, Melissa Townsend, by a swimming pool at her house in Midsomer Malham, their investigation uncovers a seedy world of adultery and deceit within the affluent rural community.

episodes:328.name: Market for Murder
episodes:328.summary: When the founder of the women's reading club is found murdered with her own walking stick, it soon becomes clear to Barnaby and Troy that the wealthy village of Midsomer Market is not the genteel and cultural seat it appears.

episodes:328.name: A Worm in the Bud
episodes:328.summary: The ancient Setwale Wood has provided remedies for the people of Midsomer Abbey for many decades, now it is the subject of court action by villagers to prevent the impecunious owner of Abbey Farm, James Harrington, from cutting it down. However, when the body of Susan Bartlett is food in the woods, Barnaby and Troy are sent to investigate what at first appears to be suicide, but smells suspiciously like murder.

episodes:328.name: Ring Out Your Dead
episodes:328.summary: The church bell ringers at Midsomer Wellow are being picked off one by one by a gun-toting assassin the week before a big bell-ringing competition. Before he can crack the case, DCI Barnaby has to unravel the significance of a killing in 1840, when the Midsomer Wellow Vicar of the day was murdered and thrown down a well.

episodes:328.name: Murder on St. Malley's Day
episodes:328.summary: The village of Midsomer Parva is dominated by the imposing and exclusive Devington School. So when the college's Pudding Club sets off a murderous chain of events, ranks begin to close against Barnaby and Troy. Without access to inside information, catching a killer who is obsessed by loyalty, finding the school's hidden secrets puts the two detectives to the test.

episodes:328.name: A Talent for Life
episodes:328.summary: The murder of a glamorous and feisty former socialite with a young lover uncovers a series of illicit affairs between prominent Malham Bridge residents.

episodes:328.name: Death and Dreams
episodes:328.summary: The apparent suicide of a local ne'er-do-well arouses suspicions due to the complexity of his death. As DCI Barnaby investigates, he is reunited with an old friend, Dr. Jane Moore, who insists the man wouldn't have committed suicide even though he had a history of depression.

episodes:328.name: Painted in Blood
episodes:328.summary: Mysteries abound when Joyce Barnaby discovers the body of a middle-aged watercolour artist in Midsomer Florey, and DCI Barnaby is forced to back away from the case when the National Intelligence Squad arrive in Midsomer. However, when something doesn't sit right, Barnaby and Troy start investigating on their own.

episodes:328.name: A Tale of Two Hamlets
episodes:328.summary: A long and vicious feud between two Midsomer villages, Upper and Lower Warden, erupts when three murders take place in a prominent family.

episodes:328.name: Birds of Prey
episodes:328.summary: While Sgt. Troy assists an attractive wildlife liaison officer with an investigation into the illegal sale of protected bird eggs, DCI Barnaby travels to Midsomer Magna to investigate a sudden death that could be either suicide or murder. However, it isn't long before the two detectives realise their investigations all lead back to the same source.

episodes:328.name: The Green Man
episodes:328.summary: When the Midsomer canal tunnel collapses during a restoration project, DCI Barnaby is tasked with identifying the skeletal remains that may have been bricked up inside a wall for decades. Meanwhile, Sergeant Troy is promoted to Inspector, but his celebrations are short lived when he's called out to Midsomer Worthy where a local homeless man has been attacked by a gang of youths.

episodes:328.name: Bad Tidings
episodes:328.summary: DCI Barnaby's new partner, Sgt. Dan Scott, arrives in Midsomer and is thrown straight into the mysterious murders of two members of the Midsomer Mallow Residents Association. But when the death toll unexpectedly rises, Barnaby becomes concerned for Cully, who is in the midst of organising a 10-year reunion with her old school friends.

episodes:328.name: The Fisher King
episodes:328.summary: DCI Barnaby and Sgt Scott find themselves investigating the bizarre murder of a young, wealthy landowner, Gareth Heldman, whose body turns up with an unusual stab wound to the thigh.

episodes:328.name: Sins of Commission
episodes:328.summary: Midsomer's highbrow literary community is turned upside down when one of their prize-winning young authors, Richard Rackham, is mysteriously murdered on the eve of the 12th Annual Midsomer St. Michael Literary Festival.

episodes:328.name: The Maid in Splendour
episodes:328.summary: When one of the bartenders from local village pub, The Maid in Splendour, is found dead in the woods, Barnaby and Scott's investigation uncovers a myriad of secret business dealings, culture clashes, and passionate love affairs.

episodes:328.name: The Straw Woman
episodes:328.summary: When the community of Midsomer Parva revives the Straw Woman bonfire festival, tragedy strikes when the local curate Alex Dakin, trapped in a giant straw effigy, is burnt alive.

episodes:328.name: Things That Go Bump in the Night
episodes:328.summary: After the murder of the Fletcher's Cross undertaker, Patrick Pennyman, DCI Barnaby and Sgt. Scott investigate the local spiritualist church which has divided the opinion of local residents.

episodes:328.name: Dead in the Water
episodes:328.summary: The Barnaby's peaceful day at the Midsomer Regatta is interrupted by the discovery of the body of the Midsomer Rowing club chariman in the river. As Barnaby and Scott dig into the luxury lifestyles of the regatta set, they discover hidden money problems and sexual jealousy are rife.

episodes:328.name: Orchis Fatalis
episodes:328.summary: When one of the world's rarest orchids is smuggled illegally into Midsomer Malham it releases the heady scents of passion, jealousy, and death. Barnaby and Scott must root out who is prepared to spend hundreds of thousands of pounds, and commit murder, just to get their hands on it.

episodes:328.name: Bantling Boy
episodes:328.summary: DCI Barnaby and Sgt. Scott enter the world of horse racing when the trainer of a thoroughbred racehorse is brutally murdered. Investigating the four member syndicate that owns the racehorse in question, the detectives must unravel hidden secrets at the aristocratic Bantling Hall to uncover the killer.

episodes:328.name: Second Sight
episodes:328.summary: DCI Barnaby and Sgt. Scott investigate when John Ransom is found murdered with suspicious burn marks to his head. The investigation leads to two feuding families of Midsomer Mere, one with the ability of second sight, and the battle between faith and science.

episodes:328.name: Hidden Depths
episodes:328.summary: When troubled local solicitor Nick Turner falls to his death from the roof of his house in Midsomer Magna, DCI Barnaby and Sgt. Scott must discover if it is suicide or murder.

episodes:328.name: Sauce for the Goose
episodes:328.summary: When the naked body of Dexter Lockwood, a rival executive at Fieldway Foods, is found in the Plummer & Son factory bottle steriliser, DCI Barnaby and Sgt. Scott's investigation uncovers a multitude of secrets and lies among the entire Plummer family.

episodes:328.name: Midsomer Rhapsody
episodes:328.summary: When retired music teacher Arthur Leggott is battered to death with a torch in his home, DCI Barnaby and Sgt. Scott investigate a tangled web of family feuds and long lost love affairs to discover the truth.

episodes:328.name: The House in the Woods
episodes:328.summary: With the help of PC Ben Jones, DCI Barnaby investigates the garrotting of a husband and wife outside a reportedly haunted cottage near Midsomer Newton. Barnaby and Jones must separate truth from fiction as they navigate overenthusiastic villagers, shady property developers, and fanatical conservationists alike as they attempt catch the killer.

episodes:328.name: Dead Letters
episodes:328.summary: When Marion Slade is found dead on the first day of Midsomer Barton's Oak Apple Week, DCI Barnaby and DC Jones investigate, but was it suicide or murder? As the investigation progresses, Barnaby is shaken by the appearance of two villagers who look just like murder victims from his past.

episodes:328.name: Vixen's Run
episodes:328.summary: DCI Barnaby and DC Jones unravel some unsavoury truths, sinister secrets, and hidden treasures among the extended family of eccentric aristocrat Sir Freddy Butler who unexpectedly dies during a special dinner presentation.

episodes:328.name: Down Among the Dead Men
episodes:328.summary: When council clerk Martin Barrett is murdered, DCI Barnaby and DS Jones soon discover that their victim was a notorious blackmailer. With no shortage of suspects, but no real evidence either, Barnaby finds himself investigating beyond the borders of Midsomer for answers.

episodes:328.name: Death in Chorus
episodes:328.summary: When Connor Simpson, a member of the Midsomer Worthy choir is mysteriously murdered during the run-up to a heated singing competition, the rest of the choir members, including Joyce Barnaby are terrified for their lives.

episodes:328.name: Country Matters
episodes:328.summary: Controversial plans to build a supermarket in Elverton-cum-Latterly lead to murder when a man is stabbed to death.

episodes:328.name: Last Year's Model
episodes:328.summary: Despite being the original arresting officer, DCI Barnaby begins to question the presumed guilt of a Midsomer Malham woman who is currently standing trial for the murder of her best friend.

episodes:328.name: Four Funerals and a Wedding
episodes:328.summary: DCI Barnaby and DC Jones investigate when a battle of the sexes, which has raged in the village of Broughton since World War I, comes to a head when aging feminist Mildred Danvers is found dead after returning to her childhood home.

episodes:328.name: Dance with the Dead
episodes:328.summary: DCI Barnaby and DS Jones investigate when the body of Simon Bright is found inside a disused World War II hanger at Cooper's Cross Airfield and begin a search for his missing girlfriend, Laura Sharp. Barnaby is convinced that one of Laura's ex-lovers is responsible but given her rather active life, the question becomes, which one?

episodes:328.name: The Animal Within
episodes:328.summary: Mischievous trickster, Rex Masters, finally gets his comeuppance when his body is found floating below the weir in Midsomer Deverell. As DCI Barnaby and DS Jones investigate, the extent of Rex's double life starts to emerge when three family friends and a long-lost niece each produce wills claiming his fortune. Does Rex's collection of erotic photographs from the 1960s hold the key to the tangled relationships and feuds blighting the Masters family?

episodes:328.name: King's Crystal
episodes:328.summary: When a family glassware business collapses following the death of one of its partners, DCI Barnaby investigates allegations of financial irregularities, love triangles, and a string of murders. Lapsed Freemason DS Jones uses his inside knowledge to explore the ceremonial aspects of two killings, but it is Cully's production of Hamlet that gives Tom the key to the mystery.

episodes:328.name: The Axeman Cometh
episodes:328.summary: Barnaby is delighted that his heroes, Hired Gun, are reuniting to play at the Midsomer Rocks festival - minus their drummer, who disappeared 30 years ago after driving his car into a quarry. However, a string of bizarre warnings convinces the paranoid lead singer that someone is trying to stop the reunion, and his fears are confirmed when the backing singer drops dead on stage.

episodes:328.name: Death and Dust
episodes:328.summary: When prominent Midsomer Market doctor, Alan Delaney, is killed by a hit-and-run driver while in charge of his business partner's new car, DCI Barnaby and DS Jones soon begin to wonder if Dr. Delaney was the real target or if a more sinister plot is afoot.

episodes:328.name: Picture of Innocence
episodes:328.summary: A photographer is murdered shortly after exhibiting a compromising picture of Barnaby - who becomes a suspect in the ensuing investigation. Joyce concludes that someone is trying to frame him, and is stunned when he admits to a previous relationship with the murdered man's wife. Jones is forced to work with the irritating DI Martin Spellman to solve the case.

episodes:328.name: They Seek Him Here
episodes:328.summary: When director Nick Cheyney is found beheaded by a guillotine on the set of his latest film, a low-budget production of The Scarlett Pimpernel being filmed at Magna Manor, DCI Barnaby and DS Jones are left with no shortage of suspects. Unfortunately for our detectives, Cheyney was on poor terms with just about everybody, including the mother of his child, an actor who blamed him for ruining his career, and the tight-fisted producer determined to see the film finished at all costs.

episodes:328.name: Death in a Chocolate Box
episodes:328.summary: DCI Barnaby's former colleague Jack Colby left the force under a cloud following a sex scandal involving villagers and officers at Causton police station. Now retrained as a probation officer, Jack is working at a halfway house for reformed criminals run by Lord Holm, an aristocrat who once served a prison sentence for killing his wife. However, when Jack is bludgeoned to death, Barnaby sets out to discover who murdered the man he once considered a friend.

episodes:328.name: Shot at Dawn
episodes:328.summary: An old feud between the Hammond and Hicks families appears to have escalated to murder when the grandfather of the Hammonds is executed in Midsomer Parva.

episodes:328.name: Blood Wedding
episodes:328.summary: DCI Barnaby becomes an unwelcome guest at a society wedding after the maid of honour is found skewered to a wardrobe in one of the hotel bedrooms. However, with his own daughter Cully about to get married, will Barnaby be able to solve the grisly murder in time to walk her down the aisle?

episodes:328.name: Left for Dead
episodes:328.summary: DS Ben Jones returns home to the village of Dunstan when an elderly couple are found dead in their home. Although initial signs point to a botched burglary, DCI Barnaby begins to suspect that the deaths may be connected to Ben's group of childhood friends, and a mysterious disappearance that occurred years earlier.

episodes:328.name: Midsomer Life
episodes:328.summary: DCI Barnaby and DS Jones investigate the death of Charlie Finleyson, who is found dead in the wood after being missing for two weeks. As the investigation progresses, Barnaby discovers connections between Finleyson and Guy Sandys, the publisher of the Midsomer Life magazine known for his scathing reviews of local hotels and restaurants.

episodes:328.name: The Magician's Nephew
episodes:328.summary: DCI Barnaby and DS Jones investigate the traditions of a local pagan cult in Midsomer, the Temple of Thoth, when a magician's assistant dies on stage during a children's magic show.

episodes:328.name: Talking to the Dead
episodes:328.summary: DCI Barnaby and DS Jones investigate when two couples mysteriously vanish from the village of Monks Barton amid rumours of witchcraft and haunted woods. As the body count rises, flamboyant psychic Cyrus LeVanu clashes with the pompous cleric, Reverend Wallace Stone, while other villagers seem to be caught up in a stolen antiques racket.

episodes:328.name: The Dogleg Murders
episodes:328.summary: A prestigious golf club is the setting for murder when a player is bludgeoned to death on the 13th hole. Barnaby and Jones discover gambling, illegal money-lending, and assault are rife among the snobbish members, who are also dismissive of the local villagers and only allow them on the course for a few hours a week. Before long, another body turns up, making the detectives doubly determined to catch this terror of the fairways.

episodes:328.name: The Black Book
episodes:328.summary: The sale of a previously unknown painting by an esteemed Midsomer painter from the 18th century sends DCI Barnaby into an investigation of murder, art forgery, and theft.

episodes:328.name: Secrets and Spies
episodes:328.summary: DCI Barnaby and DS Jones come face to face with MI6 when a number of murders near a government safe house in Midsomer Parva appear to be connected to a group of British spies stationed in East Berlin during the Cold War.

episodes:328.name: The Glitch
episodes:328.summary: An outspoken scientific genius and inventor stirs up resentment at the local university with murderous consequences.

episodes:328.name: Small Mercies
episodes:328.summary: DCI Barnaby and DS Jones investigate when the body of a local troublemaker is found in Little Worthing's model village tied to the ground like Gulliver from Gulliver's Travels.

episodes:328.name: The Creeper
episodes:328.summary: Local aristocrats Sir William and Lady Isobel Chettham have a secret to hide, which proves difficult when their alcoholic friend threatens to write a "tell-all" book about them and then turns up dead. Meanwhile, a daring cat burglar is on the loose and is breaking into the wealthy estates of Midsomer.

episodes:328.name: The Great and the Good
