episodes:328.summary: The village schoolteacher insists there is an intruder visiting her house at night, but why can no intruder ever be found? And why have two dead bodies been found in her garden?

episodes:328.name: The Sword of Guillaume
episodes:328.summary: During a visit to Brighton, a hated property developer is beheaded at a funfair and historical swords go missing. With the help of his cousin DCI John Barnaby, can DCI Tom Barnaby unearth the truth?

episodes:328.name: The Made-to-Measure Murders
episodes:328.summary: DCI Barnaby and DS Jones investigate the murder of Sonia Woodley, owner of a local bespoke tailoring business, who is found dead in the churchyard at Milton Cross. Sonia's unusual wounds perplex Dr. Bullard and Barnaby finds himself investigating a village living under a cloud of fear, grief, and guilt.

episodes:328.name: Blood on the Saddle
episodes:328.summary: DCI Barnaby and DS Jones investigate when a Wild West show in the village of Ford Florey leads to murder and mayhem.

episodes:328.name: The Silent Land
episodes:328.summary: On a dark night in the village of March Magna, Joyce Barnaby narrowly misses hitting a shadowy figure in the road with her car. But the next day a body is found in the old cemetery. Did Joyce hit someone after all or was the victim, who seems to have plenty of enemies, killed by one of the villagers? DCI Barnaby and DS Jones have their work cut out as all the villagers seem to be hiding something – but is it murder?

episodes:328.name: Master Class
episodes:328.summary: When gifted piano student Zoe Stock witnesses a woman jump from a bridge and disappear underwater in the grounds of her prestigious music school, DCI Barnaby and DS Jones start investigating. As they discover unsavoury connections to the past that could still prove lethal, Barnaby is struck by the similarities to an almost identical case at the same spot years earlier.

episodes:328.name: The Noble Art
episodes:328.summary: When Midsomer Morchard's very own boxer John Kinsella becomes the light-heavyweight boxing champion of the world in New York, the success stirs up hidden passions among the villagers. Betrayal, infidelity, and blackmail all fester as plans to re-enact a Victorian prize-fight turn nasty and bodies start piling up.

episodes:328.name: Not in My Back Yard
episodes:328.summary: A planning dispute turns to murder after a leading light in the Midsomer Conservation Society suspects her neighbours are involved in a money-making development scam. Political wrangling, burglaries, and sexual liaisons abound in picturesque Great Pelfe - but why has someone been driven to start killing?

episodes:328.name: Fit for Murder
episodes:328.summary: DCI Tom Barnaby reluctantly accompanies Joyce on a spa weekend to upmarket Swavely Manor, a country house offering treatments to soothe the body and spirit. But as he attempts to de-stress, a woman is found dead in the flotation chamber.

episodes:328.name: Death in the Slow Lane
episodes:328.summary: DCI John Barnaby arrives in Midsomer and is bemused by the quaint villages and their quirky residents. But when a local DJ is killed by the hand crank of a vintage automobile at a traditional girls' boarding school, he soon discovers that murder and deception are never far away.

episodes:328.name: Dark Secrets
episodes:328.summary: The reclusive lives of elderly eccentrics William and Mary Bingham comes under police scrutiny when a social services investigator is murdered. DCI Barnaby and DS Jones must unearth generations of family secrets and decipher astronomical charts to find the killer. Meanwhile, Barnaby's wife Sarah arrives in Midsomer.

episodes:328.name: Echoes of the Dead
episodes:328.summary: When a young woman is dressed like a bride and drowned in a bath, it triggers a spate of ghoulish wedding-themed murders in Great Worthy. The case takes DCI Barnaby and DS Jones to a donkey sanctuary, a heritage steam railway, and a pub run by an ex-copper and a former brothel madam. With a serial killer still at large, could history be repeating itself?

episodes:328.name: The Oblong Murders
episodes:328.summary: DS Jones goes undercover at the Oblong Foundation after one of the cult's young female members disappears suddenly. But he and DCI Barnaby soon start digging into an old case involving the death of a couple in a boat explosion.

episodes:328.name: The Sleeper Under the Hill
episodes:328.summary: After the gruesome discovery of a farmer's eviscerated body in an ancient stone circle in Midsomer Mow just days before the spring equinox, it's not long before suspicion falls upon the local Druids, even though there's no direct evidence linking them to any crimes.

episodes:328.name: The Night of the Stag
episodes:328.summary: When a missing VAT inspector turns up dead in a vat of cider, DCI Barnaby and DS Jones must hunt for a 'giant' killer within a Midsomer village steeped in bizarre local traditions.

episodes:328.name: A Sacred Trust
episodes:328.summary: DCI Barnaby and DS Jones investigate the cloistered world of Midsomer Priory when a nun is strangled to death. The detectives uncover a complex mystery involving holy orders, teenage romantic liaisons, African art, and missing antique silver as the community is forced to open its doors to 21st-century policing.

episodes:328.name: A Rare Bird
episodes:328.summary: A row between keen birdwatchers in Midsomer-in-the-Marsh turns nasty when their president is killed. Patrick Morgan met his death while hoping to sight a rare bird, but is his obsession with ornithology to blame – or something more sinister?

episodes:328.name: The Dark Rider
episodes:328.summary: When Bentham DeQuetteville falls to his death from the roof of Quitewell Hall after seeing a headless horseman, his aristocratic family seem more concerned about their forthcoming Civil War re-enactment than the incident. As DCI Barnaby and DS Jones try to find out the truth behind the ghostly figure, their investigation uncovers shocking secrets about the DeQuettevilles.

episodes:328.name: Murder of Innocence
episodes:328.summary: When a barrister is killed in Midsomer, suspicion falls on convicted murderer Grady Felton who was just released from prison. But Grady has a solid alibi. DCI Barnaby suspects he may be working with an accomplice - until Grady himself is targeted in an arson attack.

episodes:328.name: Written in the Stars
episodes:328.summary: DCI Barnaby and DS Jones investigate the murder of amateur astronomer Jeremy Harper, who was struck on the head with a piece of meteorite on an outing on Moonstone Ridge with the Midsomer Stanton Astronomical Society to observe a total eclipse of the sun.

episodes:328.name: Death and the Divas
episodes:328.summary: The murder of a journalist has chilling echoes of a 1960s horror film starring Midsomer's own Stella Harris. When Stella's more famous sister returns after a 40-year family rift, the killings escalate, each reminiscent of a movie plot.

episodes:328.name: The Sicilian Defence
episodes:328.summary: Harriet Farmer wakes up after having been in a coma since the night she tried to elope, and her boyfriend Finn Robson has been missing since the couple tried to run away together a year before. But when a killer starts targeting members of a chess club shortly after Harriet wakes up, DCI Barnaby begins to wonder if the two cases are connected.

episodes:328.name: Schooled in Murder
episodes:328.summary: When Debbie Moffett is crushed to death with a giant round of cheese at the home of the world-famous Midsomer Blue, secret and controversial plans to modernise the dairy are revealed while rumours about private lives of the parents cause a row at the prestigious Midsomer Pastures Prep School. As other people linked to the dairy meet agonising deaths, long-held secrets start to emerge.

episodes:328.name: The Christmas Haunting
episodes:328.summary: DCI Barnaby and the newly arrived DS Charlie Nelson investigate the fatal stabbing of a man with an antique sword during a ghost-hunting party at a manor house in Morton Shallows. Is the ghost of young Rose Wilton seeking revenge from the beyond the grave, or can Barnaby and Nelson find a more earthly motive behind the murder and trap the killer?

episodes:328.name: Let Us Prey
episodes:328.summary: A series of murders in Midsomer St. Claire seem to be inspired by macabre images on a medieval fresco recently discovered in the church crypt. As the village prepares for storms and flooding it appears that someone is using ancient torture methods to punish modern-day sinners. But who is responsible and why?

episodes:328.name: Wild Harvest
episodes:328.summary: When Martin Strickland, a local farmer is found dead in his own woods; covered by truffle oil and mauled to death by a wild boar, the investigation leads DCI Barnaby to Wyvern House, a posh picturesque country house restaurant run by a tyrannical celebrity chef, Ruth Cameron. But soon, another murder occurs and this time, the poison spreads further than the intended target.

episodes:328.name: The Flying Club
episodes:328.summary: When the owner of Finchmere Airfield is dropped from a plane to meet a gruesome death, DCI Barnaby and DS Nelson find the exciting world of stunt pilots and military heroes hides many dark secrets.

episodes:328.name: The Killings of Copenhagen
episodes:328.summary: DCI Barnaby and DS Nelson join forces with two female Danish police detectives when the boss of Calder's Biscuit Company is poisoned in Copenhagen after opening an empty tin of his company's famous Golden Clusters.

episodes:328.name: The Dagger Club
episodes:328.summary: The unveiling of a newly-discovered novel by deceased Midsomer crime-writer George Summersbee at the Luxton Deeping Crime Festival is jeopardised when the manuscript is stolen and a woman is fatally electrocuted by a booby-trapped roulette wheel.Can new dad DCI Barnaby untangle a web of jealousy and obsession to find the killer?

episodes:328.name: Murder by Magic
episodes:328.summary: When a pub landlady is killed whilst assisting illusionist Gideon Latimer at a charity show in Midsomer Oaks, DCI Barnaby and DS Nelson uncover conflict between the village church and ancient pagan traditions.

episodes:328.name: The Ballad of Midsomer County
episodes:328.summary: DCI Barnaby and DS Jones investigate when organiser Toby Winning is found dead on the day of the Little Crosby Folk Festival, drowned in a bowl of eggs and live eels. Could a ballad made famous by late, lamented folk singer Johnny Carver be an inspiration for murder? Did someone want to kill Toby for threatening to take the festival away from Midsomer – or is the true motive something hidden for 20 years?

episodes:328.name: A Vintage Murder
episodes:328.summary: The fizz goes out of a sparkling wine launch when the glasses are laced with slug poison. Who is targeting the Midsomer Vinae Winery and what does the attack have to do with the death of a child in a hit-and-run accident?

episodes:328.name: Habeas Corpus
episodes:328.summary: When wealthy landowner Gregory Lancaster's body goes missing on the night of his death, an intricate web of secrets and lies is exposed in the village of Little Malton. DCI Barnaby, DS Nelson, and new Forensic Pathologist Dr. Kam Karimore are drawn into a macabre world of body-snatching as they seek to identify the villain.

episodes:328.name: The Incident at Cooper Hill
episodes:328.summary: After mysterious lights appear over UFO hot-spot Cooper Hill, forest ranger Felicity Ford is found dead and wrapped in black ooze. DCI Barnaby and DS Nelson unearth suspicions, betrayals, and secrets in the search for what's really happened.

episodes:328.name: Breaking the Chain
episodes:328.summary: An international cycling competition goes through the village of Burwood Mantle and after the race leader is murdered, DCI Barnaby and DS Nelson find themselves involved in a competitive world of blackmail, bribery, and bloodshed where winning matters at any cost.

episodes:328.name: A Dying Art
episodes:328.summary: Art comes to the picturesque Midsomer village of Angel's Rise with the opening of a new Sculpture Park. But when its launch is marred by murder, DCI Barnaby and DS Nelson have to get creative to crack a case where art imitates death, and everything has a deeper meaning.

episodes:328.name: Saints and Sinners
episodes:328.summary: The discovery of a Saint's bones at an archaeological dig causes a stir in the village of Midsomer Cicely. But when the leader of the dig is murdered, DCI Barnaby and DS Nelson soon realise that it's not only skeletons that have been long buried in the hallowed ground.

episodes:328.name: Harvest of Souls
episodes:328.summary: The annual harvest fair and the daredevil riders of the Wall of Death come to Midsomer village Whitcombe Mallet. When the owner of an equestrian centre is trampled by his horse DCI Barnaby and DS Nelson have to unravel a complex feud from the past, where nothing is what it seems.

episodes:328.name: The Village That Rose from the Dead
episodes:328.summary: The village of Little Auburn has stood abandoned since World War Two but plans are afoot to restore it to its former glory. However, the grand reopening takes a grisly turn when a man is murdered. DCI Barnaby and his new partner, DS Jamie Winter, are soon on the case, and must unravel a web of lies connecting past and present to bring the killer to justice.

episodes:328.name: Crime and Punishment
episodes:328.summary: The Bleakridge Watch patrols the streets of their remote village, exposing anyone who steps outside the law. When one of their members dies, DCI Barnaby and DS Winter uncover just how far some people will go for power.

episodes:328.name: Last Man Out
episodes:328.summary: Tensions run high in Lower Pampling as a new type of cricket threatens a century of tradition. When a star cricketer dies during a tournament, DCI Barnaby and DS Winter's investigation draws them into a dangerous game with a surprise visitor from Barnaby's past.

episodes:328.name: Red in Tooth & Claw
episodes:328.summary: When DCI Barnaby and DS Winter discover a dead body covered in live rabbits it reveals a sinister side to the annual summer pet show at Bellville Hall. Is this a rivalry taken too far or is the killer driven by something darker?

episodes:328.name: Death by Persuasion
episodes:328.summary: When a young girl slips away from a Jane Austen weekend dressed in period attire, and is found stabbed in the woods, apparently with a Goose feather quill, DCI Barnaby and DS Winter need to look back in time to find the killer.

episodes:328.name: The Curse of the Ninth
episodes:328.summary: DCI Barnaby and DS Winter uncover multiple motives when the winner of a fought-after music award is found strangled with a violin string moments before a performance, including rivalry over the prize, disagreements about the music festival business, and a missing Stradivarius violin.

episodes:328.name: The Ghost of Causton Abbey
episodes:328.summary: Causton is buzzing at the opening of a new brewery on the site of a famously cursed abbey. But excitement turns to fear when a man is found boiled to death in one of the vats. DCI Barnaby and DS Winter are puzzled, could this really be about beer?

episodes:328.name: Death of the Small Coppers
episodes:328.summary: When Mahesh Sidana - butterfly collector and founding member of an elite IQ society - is found murdered, pinned to a wall in a manner akin to his treasured butterfly specimens, DCI Barnaby and DS Winter are thrust into a crime that impacts not only on their community, but internationally. With the help of an old friend, can they catch the culprit before another victim is found?

episodes:328.name: Drawing Dead
episodes:328.summary: Carver Valley's comic festival is in full swing when the village is shocked by the murder of a former supermodel. With a scathing comic shaming several villagers as the only lead, DCI Barnaby and DS Winter are left trying to separate fact from fiction.

episodes:328.name: The Lions of Causton
episodes:328.summary: DCI Barnaby gets to relive his former days of sporting glory when a death at the local Rugby Club sends Barnaby and DS Winter into a muddle of rucks, old grudges, romance… and artisanal chocolates?

episodes:328.name: Till Death Do Us Part
episodes:328.summary: DCI Barnaby is less than impressed when Sarah drags him to a family friend's wedding. But things soon go from bad to worse when tragedy strikes, and Barnaby is called into action to catch a murderer with an apparent penchant for local brides.

episodes:328.name: Send in the Clowns
episodes:328.summary: Things take a gruesome turn when Ferrabees Circus comes to town, bringing with it a chain of sinister clown sightings, threatening notes, and deathly dangerous circus acts.

episodes:328.name: The Point of Balance
episodes:328.summary: The setting is the annual Paramount Dance Extravaganza. Barnaby and Winter are trying to remain balanced, as they follow some shocking red herrings, and a fractured family until they solve the case.

episodes:328.name: The Miniature Murders
episodes:328.summary: A shady real estate agent is shockingly murdered at the unveiling of a house collection, in front of a crowd of witnesses! The victim has a long list of people who would like nothing more than to see them dead. Add to it, Fleur is closely connected to a couple of the suspects.

episodes:328.name: The Sting of Death
episodes:328.summary: There is a murderer on the loose at an aristocratic family's medicinal beekeeping business. Barnaby attempts yoga again, and stretching his mind to solve this case.

episodes:328.name: With Baited Breath
episodes:328.summary: There is a murder at a Midsomer mud run. Marathon participant Winter is paired up with a local officer, as they help Barnaby uncover who the murderer is!

episodes:328.name: The Wolf Hunter of Little Worthy
episodes:328.summary: After a local photographer wins an urban myth competition with his creation of The Wolf Hunter, it unexpectedly gains a cult following. However, when a man is killed, Barnaby and Winter must investigate if this myth has become murderous reality

episodes:328.name: The Stitcher Society
episodes:328.summary: A local outcast, controversially acquitted of murder in the past, joins a post-operative heart rehab club. Then club members start dying prematurely.

episodes:328.name: Happy Families
episodes:328.summary: Victor Karras, a manufacturer of exclusive board games, dies after falling down the stairs. It turns out he was poisoned, and his death is the start of a murder mystery weekend. When another person is found murdered, Barnaby and Winter have to find out if the victims knew something about the murderer, that would have revealed the person's true identity.

episodes:328.name: Scarecrow Murders
episodes:328.summary: The annual Midsomer Scarecrow Festival takes a grisly turn as bodies begin appearing on poles displayed alongside their straw creations. The investigation reveals rivalries that run deep and shows people will do just about anything to win.

episodes:328.name: For Death Prepare
episodes:328.summary: The Midsomer Mummers, a company for amateur opera, is in the middle of rehearsals for a charity concert when a dead body is found at the theatre. The aim of the inquiry is to find out which person wants to be at the centre of attention.

episodes:328.name: The Witches of Angel's Rise
episodes:328.summary: Each year, the village of Angel's Rise hosts the Psychic Fayre. Founded by the Saint-Stephens family in memory of their late daughter, the event attracts mediums, psychics, and followers of the occult. When a body is found surrounded by ritual symbols on the eve of the festival, Barnaby must step into the spiritual world to find the killer.

episodes:328.name: The Blacktrees Prophecy
episodes:328.summary: Deep in Blacktrees Forest is a bombproof shelter built by a man named Warren Kaine. His extreme paranoia has drawn other survivalists to the village, and now a doomsday prepper group meets weekly. But after the controversial ousting of a member, Warren has a target on his back. Preaching survival at any cost comes back to haunt him as the Blacktrees Prophecy claims its first--but not last--victim.

episodes:328.name: The Debt of Lies
episodes:328.summary: Challis Court seems to be a tight-knit community for retired police officers, but hierarchies from the force have remained--and resentments. When a new arrival is found dead, the other residents regard a murder on their doorstep as an affront and a challenge. Since Challis is a gated estate, Barnaby realizes that the killer is likely a resident… and therefore an ex-police officer.

episodes:328.name: A Grain of Truth
episodes:328.summary: The beautiful, historic watermill in Lower Blissingham is home to award-winning artisan baker Tom Larkton and his wife, pastry chef Chrissie. The mill has been in Chrissie"s family for centuries, and the couple have restored it and turned it into a thriving business with an online following. But their popularity has overshadowed Lower Blissingham, and many of the villagers are not happy about it….

episodes:328.name: Dressed to Kill
episodes:328.summary: Each year, the more traditional residents of Elverton-Cum-Latterly do battle in a dominoes competition that pits village teams against each other and dates back decades. But when the event occurs the same night as a drag queen fundraiser for a terminally ill teenager, the resulting clash of cultures is epic--and deadly.

episodes:328.name: The Devil's Work
episodes:328.summary: The demise of the Shirewell patriarch sparks a vicious inheritance dispute when eldest son Lucian announces plans to break up an estate that's been in the family for centuries.

episodes:328.name: Book of the Dead
episodes:328.summary: When the author of a book that sparked a nationwide treasure hunt is found dead, Barnaby and Winter must unravel the cryptic clues to find the killer among a group of dedicated seekers.

episodes:328.name: Claws Out
episodes:328.summary: After a pet detective turns up dead inside the kennel of a dog he was searching for, Barnaby and Winter are drawn into the world of dognapping, cat seduction, and animal investigation.

episodes:328.name: A Climate of Death
episodes:328.summary: Sleepy Goodman's Land is known as "the Greenest Village in Midsomer." But when the entire village is bought by a Texas oilman, a string of grisly murders ensues. To what lengths will the locals go to retain their title?

episodes:328.name: Treasures of Darkness
episodes:328.summary: After a series of death threats by a group of rival mudlarkers, Barnaby and Winter are drawn into a complex murder investigation. A jar containing human remains points to a heated treasure hunt dispute that turned deadly.

episodes:328.name: Lawn of the Dead
episodes:328.summary: Barnaby and Winter investigate when Wilf, a groundsman and referee for Midsomer Deverell's lawn bowling club, is found murdered after a close contest. The detectives uncover deadly rivalries, forbidden romances, and daring village secrets.

episodes:328.name: Death Strikes Three
episodes:328.summary: When a booby-trapped cuckoo clock kills a guest at Godley Manor's engagement party and turns the celebration into chaos, Barnaby and Winter must uncover a web of hidden pasts, family feuds, and ticking secrets before the killer strikes again.

episodes:328.name: Top of the Class
episodes:328.summary: After a strict headteacher is brutally murdered during a PTA meeting, Barnaby and Winter dig into the case. To catch the killer, the detectives must sift through school scandals and witnesses with deadly secrets.

show:the real mccoys.name: The Real McCoys
show:the real mccoys.summary: Led by patriarch Grandpa Amos McCoy, the McCoy family moves from Virginia to the San Fernando Valley in California to run a new farm that he inherited. Upon their arrival, Amos quickly starts giving advice to his grandson Luke and his new bride Kate, other family members, and to their neighbors - whether it was solicited or not.

episodes:14947.name: You Can't Cheat an Honest Man
Once There Was a Traveling Saleswoman
When a Fellow Needs a Friend
You Can't Always Be a Hero
The Town Councilman
episodes:14947.summary: In a race for town councilman, Grampa manages George's campaign and ends up helping the opposition.

episodes:14947.name: A Man of Influence (a.k.a.) Amos McCoy, Leading Citizen
You're as Young as You Feel
Uncle Rightly and the Musical Milker
Up to Their Ears in Corn
How're You Gonna Keep 'Em Down on the Farm?
The Other Side of the Fence

show:wycliffe.name: Wycliffe
show:wycliffe.summary: Detective Superintendent Wycliffe heads an investigating team of officers brought in to solve the most intriguing of murder cases on the magnificent and windswept Cornish coast in the far South-West of England.

episodes:8080.name: Seen a Ghost
episodes:8080.summary: A dark family secret comes to light when a girl deliberately runs over a woman.

episodes:8080.name: Feeding the Rat
episodes:8080.summary: When a climber is killed in a fall, an informant claims he was pushed.

episodes:8080.name: Scope
episodes:8080.summary: Wycliffe investigates the killing of a policeman, the chief suspect being another officer.

episodes:8080.name: Land's End
episodes:8080.summary: Lane finds herself in charge of an investigation involving the death of two drug dealers.

show:young dracula.name: Young Dracula
show:young dracula.summary: Fitting in is hard enough, but when your dad is Count Dracula, things go from hard to worse! Follow the comic misadventures of Vlad and Ingrid as they move from Transylvania to Britain with their narcissistic single dad, the Count.

episodes:890.name: When You're a Stranger
episodes:890.summary: Having been chased out of Transylvania by revolting peasants the Dracula family are forced to leave and start a new life in Stokely. Once they've arrived at the castle the Count lays down the law to his two children Vlad and Ingrid – there is to be no mixing with the locals. His law is soon broken when a boy from the village, Robin, breaks into the castle & discovers that his neighbours are vampires.

episodes:890.name: First Day of School
episodes:890.summary: The Count insists that his children will not go to school. Vlad is gutted, all he wants to do is go to school and be normal but his father is adamant – that is until the Headmistress turns up and insists that they go to school or the Count will be in serious trouble. Vlad is thrilled but the Count is determined to find out who dobbed him in. At the school we meet the Van Helsing's – Van H is immediately suspicious of Robin who he's convinced is a vampire. By the end of the episode however his attention is turned to Vlad...and so it begins.

episodes:890.name: Mummy Returns
episodes:890.summary: Vlad & Ingrid's evil mother Magda turns up at the castle after her relationship with Patrick the werewolf hits the rocks. Vlad isn't pleased to see her as he knows she's just going to leave them and break his heart – again. Van H breaks into the castle – but Vlad and his trusted friends ensure that the Count is safe from the local slayer. Shame they can't protect him from Magda as well.

episodes:890.name: Slaytime TV
episodes:890.summary: When the Count buys a TV he becomes obsessed with daytime TV & decides to make his own TV programme in the castle. Robin thinks that he was swapped with Vlad at birth & after a diet of ridiculous daytime TV plotlines the Count believes him. With Chloe's help Vlad has to find a way to convince the Count that he's his true son.

episodes:890.name: Home Education
episodes:890.summary: Vlad and Robin get suspended after taking the blame for one of Ingrid's evil pranks. The Count has to tutor the boys from the castle and a hypnotism lesson goes horribly wrong when Vlad gets carried away and changes his dad into Count Normal and the Branaghs into blood thirsty vampires.

episodes:890.name: Toothache
episodes:890.summary: Vlad thinks his fangs are coming through and is in a foul mood – this means that he really is turning into a vampire. When the Count tries to marry Ingrid off on her 15th birthday Robin pretends to be her vampire boyfriend to save her being sent off to live with a spotty vampire husband in Trans-siberia. Vlad thinks he has bitten Chloe when she stays the night and Chloe thinks she has turned into a vampire.

episodes:890.name: Parent's Night
episodes:890.summary: It is Parent's Evening and the Count leaves the castle for the first time – not to take an interest in his children's education but to avenge a slur Mr Van Helsing has made about him - and in doing so he stumbles straight into Van Helsing's lair. But this is the least of the Vlad's worries - a rotting Mummy called Chandu is out to get revenge on the Count for a chess game they played hundreds of years ago.

episodes:890.name: 13th Birthday
episodes:890.summary: It is Vlad's 13th birthday and he is really excited about having his first ‘normal' birthday. However his plans fly out of the window when his Grandparents fly in the window. They've come to force their useless Grandson into early vampire-hood. Is it time up for Vlad being normal? Van Helsing thinks all his Christmases have come at once when he gets his hands on an unconscious Zoltan.

episodes:890.name: Living with the Branaghs
episodes:890.summary: The Branagh house becomes overrun with cockroaches (Renfield's missing dinner ingredients) and they are forced to evacuate their home. The Count invites them to stay at the castle. He's hungry and Mrs B looks tasty. Vlad knows this spells disaster. Elizabeth does her best to adopt Transylvanian customs and cooks the Count a full Transylvanian feast. The Count decides to make Elizabeth a bride of Dracula and the kids have their hands full trying to stop him.

episodes:890.name: Rugby
episodes:890.summary: Vlad wants to try out for the school rugby team but the Count won't let him – unless he cheats. Ingrid decides she needs to find a husband in order to be free of the Count's tyranny – she tries out the twins to see who is most suitable. Van Helsing breaks into the castle in drag – Renfield is smitten.

episodes:890.name: Father's Day
episodes:890.summary: In true Father's Day fashion Graham is taking Robin and Chloe camping. They invite Vlad and the Count along much to Vlad's excitement and the Count's horror. The Count's bad mood induces an almighty thunderstorm and they are forced to camp in the castle. Fatherly competitiveness comes to a head when Graham and the Count decide to settle their differences with a duel. Van H has found a girlfriend and Jonathan is determined to give their relationship a good start – until he finds out that she is weirder than his dad. Ingrid uses Jonathan to sabotage the date.

episodes:890.name: Halloscream
episodes:890.summary: Vlad is forced to ensure that no one screams at Halloween so that a ‘curse' will be imposed on his family – a curse of normality. If anyone screams the family will remain vampires. But being Halloween, frights and screams abound. Vlad goes out of his way to keep the peace so that the curse will be imposed. Robin on the other hand tries his best to make everyone scream. Jonathan locks Van Helsing up in the caravan – this is a night when his slaying instincts are all over the shop.

episodes:890.name: The Blood Test
episodes:890.summary: Vlad has to sit a vampire exam, his first ever ‘Blood Test'. While he doesn't want to pass because it means that he's one step closer to becoming a vampire, he doesn't want to fail because the Count has said that he will never be able to see his friends again if he does. Robin has a crisis of confidence and turns normal – which means that Vlad is undecided whether to pass the test or not. Jonathan abandons Van Helsing at the castle after Van Helsing breaks his promise to give up slaying.

episodes:890.name: Countdown
episodes:890.summary: The Count holds a hunt ball to find a new wife and Van Helsing uses it as an opportunity to infiltrate the castle. Jonathan finds out that vampires really do exist and Vlad has to pull out all the stops to save the Count from Van Helsing. The Branaghs are invited to the ball – not as guests but as the hunt victims. The Count finally discovers that there is a slayer in town and the series ends with a showdown between the Count and Van Helsing.

episodes:890.name: Kidnipped
episodes:890.summary: Vlad wants peace between vampires and slayers, but no-one else agrees with him. The Count kidnaps Jonno to lure the slayer in, but Van Helsing has had the same idea and kidnapped Vlad and Ingrid.

episodes:890.name: The Yanks Are Coming
episodes:890.summary: The Count is looking forward to a visit from his brother and his family, but is shocked to discover that Ivan the Bloodthirsty is now living blood-free and calling himself Harvey. Meanwhile, Vlad meets his weedy 15-year-old cousin Boris, who is about to undergo the "vampire transformation".

episodes:890.name: Mirror Mirror
episodes:890.summary: Boris and Vlad discover that there may be a cure for vampirism. Jonno and Van Helsing plant clues about the Blood Mirror, which will return the whole family to their mortal state if it is smashed.

episodes:890.name: Bad Reflection
episodes:890.summary: Shy, clumsy Boris faces his destiny and becomes a powerful vampire. Despite Vlad's hopes that he won't become evil, the new, stronger Boris uses the Blood Mirror to drain his father and the Count of their powers.

episodes:890.name: Dad's Back
episodes:890.summary: When he learns that Renfield's father invented a potion to cure vampirism, Vlad puts his alchemy lessons to use and resurrects the old man. But Renfield Senior is more interested in getting his revenge on the Count.

episodes:890.name: Baby Dracula
episodes:890.summary: Vlad's mother is back and she's pregnant. The Count decides that the new vampire baby should replace Vlad as his son and heir, but Vlad suspects that the father may actually be Magda's werewolf boyfriend, Patrick.

episodes:890.name: Insomnia
episodes:890.summary: Vlad suffers from a recurring nightmare in which the Branagh family are trying to slay him. In the dream world, he meets the Grand High Vampire who tells him that he is the Chosen One and must embrace his destiny.

episodes:890.name: Love Bites
episodes:890.summary: It's Valentine's Day and the Count brews up a love potion, Ingrid is horrified to discover she's falling in love with a breather, while Vlad and Robin compete for the affections of the new girl at school.

episodes:890.name: Bodyswap
episodes:890.summary: Vlad and Robin visit the Stokley Museum to find the Staff of Carpathia which they believe can cure vampirism. The Count leaves his body to sneak past a security guard, but accidentally ends up in Van Helsing's body.

episodes:890.name: Sweet Sixteen
episodes:890.summary: On her sixteenth birthday, Ingrid is looking forward to facing the Blood Mirror for her transformation, but has second thoughts when she finds that her reflection is even more evil than she is and wants to kill Will, her human boyfriend. Meanwhile, Mr. Van Helsing's wife forces him to destroy all his vampire fighting gear.

episodes:890.name: Eclipse
episodes:890.summary: When the police arrive at the castle asking about a missing man, Vlad fears the worst and sets about trying to make his vampire father look innocent. Meanwhile, Ingrid takes advantage of a total eclipse to sneak out to the cinema with Will.

episodes:890.name: When Vampires Go Bad
episodes:890.summary: The Grand High Vampire accuses the Count of breaking Vampire Law. If found guilty, he will be sentenced to death. Things get even worse when the Grand High Vampire is murdered and it looks as if the Count may be responsible.

episodes:890.name: The Chosen One
episodes:890.summary: Vampires gather at the castle to select a new Grand High Vampire, but when the first candidates crumble to dust, thoughts turn to an ancient prophecy stating that when the bloodlines weaken, only the Chosen One can wear the crown.

episodes:890.name: Hide and Seek
episodes:890.summary: In the third season premiere, Ingrid finds herself on the run from slayers. With his powers as the Chosen One increasing, Vlad has visions of his sister's plight and decides to help her and bring her to their new home.

episodes:890.name: The Enemy Within
episodes:890.summary: Vlad invites Erin to stay at the school, unaware that she is an undercover slayer out to avenge her brother. When Bertrand arrives, Vlad must prove he is the Chosen One by opening an ancient book that will give him power over all vampires.

episodes:890.name: Faustian Slip
episodes:890.summary: Vlad sees a chance to get out of his father's over-strict training regime and appoints his mother as Regent. But he's been tricked and must find a way to get out of it before Magda's desire for publicity leads the slayers to them.

episodes:890.name: Fangs for the Memories
episodes:890.summary: Still believing that Erin is a half-fang struggling to come to terms with being a vampire, Vlad tries to comfort her by sharing memories of his childhood and explains his hope that vampires and breathers can live together in peace.

episodes:890.name: Carpathian Feast
episodes:890.summary: When Vlad accidentally humiliates his father by demonstrating his powers, he agrees to make amends by throwing a feast, but must find a way to stop it when he learns that the Count plans to kill Erin at the end of the party.

episodes:890.name: Blood Thief
episodes:890.summary: Believing she is distracting Vlad, Bertrand devises a plan to get rid of Erin and make it look like an accident. Meanwhile, Renfield plays detective to find out who has been stealing the Count's blood.

episodes:890.name: Bad to the Bones
episodes:890.summary: Powerful vampire Ramanga arrives, expecting the Praedictum Impaver to be opened and demanding to see the Chosen One. But Vlad has been summoned by the Blood Mirror and must face not just one but a thousand evil reflections.

episodes:890.name: Bad Vlad
episodes:890.summary: With his evil reflection taking over, Vlad is out of control. More powerful than ever, Vlad turns against his family and Erin and they are unable to stop him.

episodes:890.name: Therapy
episodes:890.summary: Emotionally ruined after Vlad tried to kill her, Ingrid talks to a psychologist and examines memories of her life. Erin hopes that the Praedictum Impaver may have a cure for her brother.

episodes:890.name: The Return
episodes:890.summary: Vlad's back and wants to learn more about the clan leaders so he can control them when he takes power. But Jonno and Mina Van Helsing unexpectedly turn up at the school and Vlad must test if their mind-wipes are still in place.

episodes:890.name: Hit Chicks
episodes:890.summary: Ingrid turns a visiting netball team into vampires and sends them out to kill Vlad, but the inexperienced girls fail miserably.

episodes:890.name: Blood Loyalties
episodes:890.summary: Unsure whether or not to trust Erin's warning about the coming slayer attack, Vlad and the Count visit the Slayers' Guild where they find and destroy a powerful weapon, but Jonno is not convinced by Vlad's desire for peace.

episodes:890.name: All for One
episodes:890.summary: Bertrand believes if he reads the last words of the Praedictum Impaver, all the power within the book goes to him. Ryan sees Bertrand stealing the book and follows him. He discovers a kidnapped Erin and learns that breather blood creates text in the book. Ryan steals the book for Ingrid. Vlad senses Erin is in danger and when he gets to her she tells him about Bertrand, Ryan and the book.

episodes:890.name: The Good, the Bad and the Undead
episodes:890.summary: Vlad and his gang have 48 hours to ensure that all Vampires are off the street and are prepared to abide by peaceful co-existence between the Vampires and the Slayers. There are plenty of people who are hoping and plotting for Vlad's initiative to fail. Not least the Count who is secretively in cahoots with Vampire High Council Member, Ramanga and High Council wannabe Ingrid, to bring the peaceful co-existence to it's knees, that when he's not fantasizing about his beloved Miss McCauley. In a last ditch attempt to prove his plan can succeed, Vlad and Jonno arrange a Vampires Vs Slayers football tournament. What can possibly go wrong?

episodes:890.name: Revamped
episodes:890.summary: Vlad's peace initiative hangs in the balance but with a lot of help from Jonno, Bertrand and Erin they manage to persuade all the lawless ferals, including the charismatic new boy Malik, and bad ass Ryan to turn up to SCRAP school at Garside. The school will help them wean off biting and onto a breather friendly alternative – soya blood. A victory as far as Vlad is concerned until the Count bowls a googly: To win favour with the High Council and the ancient vampire clans, Vlad must marry Adze Ramanga's daughter.

episodes:890.name: Storm in a Blood Cup
episodes:890.summary: Adze arrives at Garside and much to Erin's chagrin, she is beautiful. Vlad doesn't appear to notice, as he's too busy scheming on how he can get out of the arrangement. However, Ramanga and Adze are plotting to get rid of the only person who might put a spoke in the wheel - Erin. A direct assault would be too provocative so they plan a smear campaign centring on Ryan. It backfires and opportunes Vlad with a moment of reprise.

episodes:890.name: The Crown of Ludlaw Erant
episodes:890.summary: Malik is secretly meeting with a mystery being and his loyalty to the Dracula's is not so clear cut. Ingrid strikes a deal with Ramanga. She will give spy on Vlad and Erin in return for Ramanga's support in her bid to be the first woman on the High Council. Vlad is under duress not just because he has to find a way out of his forthcoming marriage to Adze but also because finding enough blood to supply his SCRAP vampires is not as easy he and Jonno initially thought. And as if Vlad didn't have enough to worry about the Count has agreed to Ms McCauley's suggestion that they elect a member of the SCRAPs onto Garside school's senate. When the reluctant Ryan wins, instead of Malik it begins to look like it was a fit up – this escalates to down right suspicion when Ryan collapses and dies after being crowned with Mortar board.

episodes:890.name: Murderer in the Midst
episodes:890.summary: Bertrand is put in charge of finding Ryan's murderer. The problem is everyone has a motive, but he begins to suspect that someone as yet unknown has them running round in circles, especially when his proof miraculously disappears. Vlad is impatient and wants hard proof. Erin is becoming increasingly isolated and worried that rather than letting Vlad get on with his peaceful co-existence initiative he is being distracted and made vulnerable by her presence. She makes a decision to leave, as it is the only way for Vlad's vision for breather and biters to succeed. Vlad is torn.

episodes:890.name: Bloodbound
episodes:890.summary: The day of the bloodbinding arrives. A reluctant and nervous Vlad prepares to stand by his word and marry Adze. Ramanga proposes to an astonished Ingrid but soon wishes he hasn't and Bertrand uncovers Ramanga's secret gift to Adze's – Erin. Vlad and Bertrand rush to her aid but Adze uses the dark magic and Erin is fatally wounded.

episodes:890.name: Do the Bite Thing
episodes:890.summary: Erin's life hangs in the balance and Vlad keeps a vigil at her bedside. Despite everyone's advice Vlad bites Erin as a means of stopping her dying. Will she be grateful for her eternal life? The Count and Malik seek revenge on Ramanga for threatening Vlad and trying to overturn the House of Dracula. Malik reveals to the Count that he is his son.

episodes:890.name: Loyalty's for Breathers
episodes:890.summary: The Count decides to challenge his sons to fight for their position as his rightful heir. Reluctantly Vlad agrees.

episodes:890.name: Sun and Heir
episodes:890.summary: Bertrand is convinced the Shapeshifter is linked to Malik. In retaliation the Shapeshifter creates chaos by manipulating the Dracula clan; First she engineers a near death situation for the Count and Malik in the hope that it will provide the impetus to bond as father and son. Then she impersonates Bertrand and invites Adze and Mina to Garside. Their meeting degenerates into a confrontation and Mina dusts Adze. Believing that Bertrand is undermining him and is responsible for Adze's death. Vlad stakes Bertrand. The peaceful coexistence is teetering on a knife edge and Vlad has never felt so alone.

episodes:890.name: Whatever It Takes
episodes:890.summary: Vlad's problems appear to escalate even though he's dusted Bertrand. The Slayers Guild anticipating an end to the ceasefire are planning to attack, the only way they will deviate from their plan is if Vlad sacrifices Erin who is still biting. Ingrid unaware of the Slayers conditions is preparing for all out war and is galvanising her troops at Garside. The Count is a little distracted by a new teacher who has the attention of his beloved McCauley.

episodes:890.name: Bootiful Breathers
episodes:890.summary: Vlad is still in denial about Bertrand's death and is lying to everyone about the mind wipe of the slayers. Ingrid's bid for a position on the Vampire High Council fails an outsider, George Lansley beats her hands down. His surprise win infuriates Ingrid and she suspects fowl play. With the help of Renfield she finds out the truth – Lansley has a blood farm. Ingrid reveals the farm to Vlad. Horrified at what vampires are capable of, if left to un-policed by the slayers – he dusts Lansley. With no rival Ingrid is accepted onto the High Council. Vlad resolves to reverse the mind wipe. Malik helps the Count to get rid of his love rival.

episodes:890.name: Cuckoo in the Nest
episodes:890.summary: Vlad decides that he must make amends for the bad decisions he has recently made. However, when the Count finds out his actions, he disinherits Vlad and formally makes Malik the Dracula heir. Vlad comes face-to-face with the Shapeshifter.

episodes:890.name: Kiss of Death
episodes:890.summary: Vlad and Ingrid join forces to capture the Shapeshifter, but since she can assume the physical appearance of anybody, they are initially at a loss as to know who she is. They capture and torture Malik as bait and lure Elizabeta into the open. Vlad and Elizabeta go head to head and appear evenly matches until Vlad manages to pull her into the Ancient Dracula Blood mirror, where she is unable to Shapeshift and he zones her. Renfield frantically tries to find an antidote to save the dying Count.

episodes:890.name: Fight or Flight
episodes:890.summary: The Count resorts to bribery when he learns Vlad is only planning a brief stopover back home during his world travels. When Vlad starts to feel ill, Renfield's search for a cure uncovers a surprising family secret.

episodes:890.name: Who's the Daddy?
episodes:890.summary: Vlad is angry to discover the secret his father has been hiding from him for 18 years. Meanwhile Ingrid is trying to climb the ladder at the VHC by dusting her competition!

episodes:890.name: Flesh and Blood
episodes:890.summary: When the Count converts Garside into a vampire-themed hotel, Vlad invites his breather mother to stay without revealing his true identity.

episodes:890.name: Once Bitten, Twice Shy
episodes:890.summary: Vlad persuades Sally and George to stay a little while at Garside, as he'd like to get to know them better; despite his pleas for his vampire family to pretend to be normal, Ingrid can't help herself and chaos soon descends.

episodes:890.name: Warning Shadows
episodes:890.summary: A mysterious new visitor at Garside warns the Draculas that they are the next target of Ramanga's fearsome Shadow Warriors.

episodes:890.name: The Enemy Within
episodes:890.summary: The Count revels in a victory over the Shadow Warriors. An 'Unordinary' bat appears at the castle, and, at the same time, every biter bat gets infected with a strange green moss.

episodes:890.name: Nemsis Rising
episodes:890.summary: Malik finds a surprising ally in his mission to rescue his mother from The Blood Mirror; Vlad is delighted when a friend he met traveling pays him a visit, but wonders what she will think of his breather houseguests.

episodes:890.name: Open House
episodes:890.summary: Renfield arranges an open house viewing to sell Garside but thanks to Ramangas children, there are a few surprises in store for the Draculas and their potential breather buyers.

episodes:890.name: The Bodyguard
episodes:890.summary: When the VHC appoint a bodyguard to protect Vlad from the Bounty Hunters, he's worried that his secret of being half human will be discovered.

episodes:890.name: Blood Match
episodes:890.summary: The family's routine becomes chaotic when they are set upon by enemies. Renfield will be sweeping up the dust of at least one fallen vampire before the end of the night.

episodes:890.name: Bite Me
episodes:890.summary: The Count, already paranoid after the recent attacks on Garside, is beside himself when he, Vlad and Talitha are beset by a string of garlic bombs! A brave Renfield comes to the rescue but gets very little gratitude from The Count who refuses to bring forward his bite-by-date. After all the drama Ingrid casually suggests that they hire a security expert and put Garside on lockdown.

episodes:890.name: The Darkest Hour, Part 1
episodes:890.summary: It's Vlad's 18th birthday and he doesn't know if he'll get the chance to decide whether to be human or vampire; the combined forces of the vengeful Ramangas, the VHC and the powerful Magister Maleficorum could wipe out the Draculas forever.

episodes:890.name: The Darkest Hour, Part 2
episodes:890.summary: As the sun rises on his 18th birthday, Vlad wonders if he'll be granted his biggest wish and become human; with the Blood Seed flourishing and his family under attack, it's certainly not going to be an easy decision to make.

show:last night out.name: Last Night Out
show:last night out.summary:
Last Night Out reveals the chilling stories of the final night of fun for those whose evenings end in tragedy. We meet the under 35s who go out to have a good time but a terrible turn in events leads to their murders.

This UK series uses intimate, down-the-lens interviews with family members, friends, and key figures from the investigation team to tell the stories of these tragic deaths. Blending CCTV footage, social media posts and home movies, each episode forensically pieces together the narrative of their last night out.

episodes:85660.name: Samantha Josephson
episodes:85660.summary: Samantha orders a rideshare after a night out but finds herself in the wrong vehicle.

episodes:85660.name: Nadine Lott
episodes:85660.summary: Out celebrating her aunt's birthday at a pub in Arklow, Nadine returns home to her ex where he beats her to the point where she's barely recognisable.

episodes:85660.name: Monica Hoffa
episodes:85660.summary: Pregnant Monica finishes her shift at work and goes to meet a friend, but is shot three times on her way there. Two days later, her body is found.

episodes:85660.name: Loren Leslie
episodes:85660.summary: Teenager Loren sneaks out to see a boy she's been chatting with online, who went on to become Canada's youngest serial killer.

episodes:85660.name: Erin Jones
episodes:85660.summary: A newly single woman heads out to a basketball game with her best friend. A tornado hits Kansas that night but it's Erin's murder that destroys her family.

episodes:85660.name: Crystal Turner & Kylen Schulte
episodes:85660.summary: Newlyweds Kylen and Crystal play pool with friends but worry about a strange man who had howled at them near their campsite days before.

episodes:85660.name: Sarah Henshaw
episodes:85660.summary: A night at a concert turns tragic when a woman is attacked and killed by her boyfriend.

episodes:85660.name: Shane Gilmer
episodes:85660.summary: Shane and his pregnant partner Laura have a cosy night out. But their neighbour, Anthony Lawrence, is hiding in their attic with a crossbow.

episodes:85660.name: Erin Castro
episodes:85660.summary: A 19-year-old goes out with friends. Later, she gets in a car with her boyfriend. By 11:45 PM, she texts her mother a cry for help before he attacks and leaves her.

episodes:85660.name: Jessie Blodgett
episodes:85660.summary: After a night out, Jessie Blodgett is killed by her ex, who once tried to murder another woman. He comforts her family until police close in.

episodes:85660.name: Sade Robinson
episodes:85660.summary: A first date ends in a disappearance, leading police to burned evidence and recovered remains.

episodes:85660.name: Sabina Nessa
episodes:85660.summary: Investigators search for Sabina Nessa, who goes missing after walking to meet a friend on a Friday night.

episodes:85660.name: Leslie Reeves
episodes:85660.summary: Leslie Reeves' first date ends in a deadly shooting after her former partner tracks her down.

episodes:85660.name: Lauren Giddings
episodes:85660.summary: A talented young law graduate disappears just weeks before a major milestone. As detectives search for answers, a troubling picture begins to emerge.

episodes:85660.name: Carla Walker
episodes:85660.summary: A look at the 1974 abduction and murder of Carla Walker after she attended a Valentine's Day highschool dance in Fort Worth, Texas.

show:roseanne.name: Roseanne
show:roseanne.summary: A groundbreaking American television sitcom, following the fortunes of the down-to-earth, blue collar Conner family in the small town of Lanford, Illinois.

episodes:690.name: Life and Stuff
episodes:690.summary: Roseanne and Dan, parents of a low income family, deal with the trials and tribulations of suburban domesticity. Roseanne must keep her sanity while keeping her family together and dealing with her troubling daughter, Darlene.

episodes:690.name: We're in the Money
episodes:690.summary: Although Dan and Roseanne agree not to spend any of Dan's $500 advance on themselves, neither can resist the temptation.

episodes:690.name: D-I-V-O-R-C-E
episodes:690.summary: Jackie babysits while Roseanne and Dan go out to a formal restaurant dinner -- at which they see a recently divorced friend.

episodes:690.name: Language Lessons
episodes:690.summary: A body language test reveals Dan's innermost feelings about his sister-in-law; Darlene has a bone to pick with D.J.

episodes:690.name: Radio Days
episodes:690.summary: A songwriting contest unleashes creativity in Dan and Roseanne, while Booker unleashes uncontrolled impulses in Jackie.

episodes:690.name: Lovers' Lanes
episodes:690.summary: Roseanne sees Becky and her first boyfriend at a bowling alley. Jackie and Booker make a bet, if Booker wins, Jackie has to spend the night with him.

episodes:690.name: The Memory Game
episodes:690.summary: Roseanne discovers that Dan had a one-night stand with her high-school nemesis years ago.

episodes:690.name: Here's to Good Friends
episodes:690.summary: Roseanne and Jackie help Crystal drown her sorrows over breaking up with her lover by taking her to the Lobo Lounge for a few pink squirrels and a pep talk.

episodes:690.name: Dan's Birthday Bash
episodes:690.summary: Dan's birthday bash at the Lobo Lounge is interrupted by a bully who picks a fight with Dan at the pool table.

episodes:690.name: Saturday
episodes:690.summary: Roseanne bets Dan he'll never finish repairing his truck.

episodes:690.name: Canoga Time
episodes:690.summary: Dan can't bear to part with the "junk" Roseanne wants to donate to a rummage sale; Darlene forges a passing grade on her report card.

episodes:690.name: The Monday Through Friday Show
episodes:690.summary: Dan and Roseanne disagree about where to spend a romantic 15th anniversary; Becky refuses to dissect a frog in biology class; Darlene finds her paper route more than she can handle.

episodes:690.name: Bridge Over Troubled Sonny
episodes:690.summary: Crystal struggles to cope with the death of her husband; Darlene decides it's cool to smoke.

episodes:690.name: Father's Day
episodes:690.summary: Roseanne steps in to referee when Dan's visiting father pontificates about Dan wasting time working as a contractor.

episodes:690.name: Nightmare on Oak Street
episodes:690.summary: Darlene's bad dreams aren't due to the scary movies she's been watching.

episodes:690.name: Mall Story
episodes:690.summary: Roseanne takes her reluctant family on a shopping spree at the Lanford mall.

episodes:690.name: Becky's Choice
episodes:690.summary: Becky is eager for the dinner party with Chip and his parents to come to an end.

episodes:690.name: The Slice of Life
episodes:690.summary: Darlene's emergency appendectormy makes Roseanne anxious and guilty over having yelled at Darlene earlier.

episodes:690.name: Workin' Overtime
episodes:690.summary: After two weeks of overtime at work and chaos at home, Roseanne takes refuge at a diner.

episodes:690.name: Toto, We're Not in Kansas Anymore
episodes:690.summary: As a tornado spins through Lanford, a storm is brewing inside the Conner house over the whereabouts of Jackie who hasn't returned from her trip to the market.

episodes:690.name: Death and Stuff
episodes:690.summary: The Conners have a corpse in their kitchen, which interferes with Dan's attempts to repair the refrigerator.

episodes:690.name: Dear Mom and Dad
episodes:690.summary: An unannounced visit by Roseanne's parents has the Conner house in an uproar.

episodes:690.name: Let's Call It Quits
episodes:690.summary: Roseanne has difficulty accepting new rules from a tough new supervisor at the factory.

episodes:690.name: Inherit the Wind
episodes:690.summary: Roseanne tries her hand at telephone solicitation while trying to console Becky who had an embarrassing accident in front of the school council.

episodes:690.name: The Little Sister
episodes:690.summary: Jackie takes umbrage at Roseanne's remarks about her career ambitions when she reveals that she has enrolled in police academy; Becky gets caught reading Dan's girlie magazine.

episodes:690.name: Guilt by Disassociation
episodes:690.summary: Inexperienced Roseanne is hired for -- and subsequently fired from -- a job requiring computer experience.

episodes:690.name: Somebody Stole My Gal
episodes:690.summary: After a lonely architect who works with Dan has dinner at the Conners', he attempts to buy their friendship.

episodes:690.name: House of Grown-Ups
episodes:690.summary: Roseanne begins to feel the empty-nest syndrome when Jackie departs for police training, Becky dates a 17-year-old and Darlene goes to a co-ed party.

episodes:690.name: Five of a Kind
episodes:690.summary: A kiss is just a kiss, but it could mean trouble when the kisser is Dan's buddy Arnie, and the kissee is Roseanne.

episodes:690.name: BOO!
episodes:690.summary: The Conner family terrify each other out of their wits on Halloween night.

episodes:690.name: Sweet Dreams
episodes:690.summary: Roseanne tries to get a few minutes of relaxation in the bathtub, but she ends up getting constant interruptions from her family--and a fantasy about two hunks.

episodes:690.name: We Gather Together
episodes:690.summary: On Thanksgiving Day, Jackie finally spills the news of her new job to her mother; and Dan's dad butters up Crystal.

episodes:690.name: Brain-Dead Poets Society
episodes:690.summary: Darlene refuses to read her prize-winning poem on Culture Night at her school, preferring to stay home to watch a ballgame with Dan, until Roseanne lays down the law.

episodes:690.name: Lobocop
episodes:690.summary: When Roseanne takes a second job, her hectic work schedule takes a bite out of her romantic schedule with Dan. Dan disguises himself in an attempt to win back Roseanne's affections.

episodes:690.name: No Talking
episodes:690.summary: Becky wages a teenage war of silence against Roseanne.

episodes:690.name: Chicken Hearts
episodes:690.summary: Roseanne strains to treat her 17-year-old boss with respect so she can have weekends off to be with her family.

episodes:690.name: One for the Road
episodes:690.summary: When the parents are away, Becky and her friend Dana play with a little help from the liquor cabinet.

episodes:690.name: An Officer and a Gentleman
episodes:690.summary: When Roseanne is called away, Jackie impresses Dan and the kids with her homemaking skills.

episodes:690.name: Born to Be Wild
episodes:690.summary: Roseanne and Dan get a blast from the blast when old pal Ziggy cruises into Lanford on a motorcycle, prompting the Conners to resurrect their old bike.

episodes:690.name: Hair
episodes:690.summary: Roseanne applies for a job at a beauty salon doing the same domestic chores that she does at home.

episodes:690.name: I'm Hungry
episodes:690.summary: Dan is persuaded to join Roseanne in a weight-loss program that involves exercise.

episodes:690.name: All of Me
episodes:690.summary: Roseanne doesn't share Jackie's enthusiasm for the exciting new man in her life.

episodes:690.name: To Tell the Truth
episodes:690.summary: Roseanne's meddling results in silence between the sisters, but Jackie has exciting news to share.

episodes:690.name: Fender Bender
episodes:690.summary: Roseanne's station wagon is hit by a luxury car that belongs to the rich Mrs. Wellman.

episodes:690.name: April Fool's Day
episodes:690.summary: On April 15th, Dan and Roseanne offer the kids a frantic lesson in family accounting; and in despair finally visit the local IRS office.

episodes:690.name: Fathers and Daughters
episodes:690.summary: In an attempt to bond with their daughters, Dan goes clothes shopping with Becky, and Roseanne watches basketball with Darlene.

episodes:690.name: Happy Birthday
episodes:690.summary: Roseanne finally has a place to write when Dan builds her an office for her birthday -- but she's stricken with a case of writer's block.

episodes:690.name: The Test
episodes:690.summary: Becky is eager to practice for her driving test, and the rest of the family awaits the results of Roseanne's pregnancy test.

episodes:690.name: Friends and Relatives
episodes:690.summary: Lending money to pal Arnie comes easily for Dan, but he believes that borrowing from family only adds up to disaster.

episodes:690.name: Like, a Virgin
episodes:690.summary: Roseanne decides it's time to give Becky "the talk" unaware that it's Darlene who needs it more.

episodes:690.name: Like, a New Job
episodes:690.summary: Despite her misgivings, Roseanne, working late as a coffee-shop waitress, leaves Dan in charge of the kids.

episodes:690.name: Goodbye, Mr. Right
episodes:690.summary: After Police Officer Jackie gets slightly injured, Gary says he's tired of always worrying about her and wants her to quit her job as a Police Woman. Meanwhile, Becky and Darlene find something disturbing under DJ's bed that makes them believe he's a complete psycho.

episodes:690.name: Becky, Beds and Boys
episodes:690.summary: Becky's folks pressure her to stop dating a boy.

episodes:690.name: Trick or Treat
episodes:690.summary: Roseanne, mistaken for a guy in her lumberjack Halloween costume, plays along with some braggarts and learns about machismo.

episodes:690.name: PMS, I Love You
episodes:690.summary: Roseanne's PMS day and Dan's birthday are on a collision course.

episodes:690.name: Bird is the Word
episodes:690.summary: Becky is suspended for allegedly making an obscene gesture in her class photo – which makes her suddenly popular at school – but Roseanne is the one called into the principal's office.

episodes:690.name: Dream Lover
episodes:690.summary: Dan ill-advisedly tells Roseanne he's having dreams of a mysterious, and oddly homely, other woman.

episodes:690.name: Do You Know Where Your Parents Are?
episodes:690.summary: Since the girls continually break curfew, Dan and Roseanne celebrate the anniversary of their first lovemaking by revisiting the restaurant/hotel – and staying out very, very late, hoping to teach the girls a lesson, with the help of Officer Jackie.

episodes:690.name: Confessions
episodes:690.summary: An angry and deflated Roseanne discovered that her mother always thought sister Jackie had more potential.

episodes:690.name: The Courtship of Eddie, Dan's Father (1)
episodes:690.summary: Dan's visiting father astonishes everyone by announcing his plans to marry Crystal.

episodes:690.name: The Wedding (2)
episodes:690.summary: Against Dan's wishes, Roseanne forges ahead with wedding preparations, with Crystal revealing she's pregnant with Ed's child.

episodes:690.name: Becky Doesn't Live Here Anymore
episodes:690.summary: Becky runs away from home to live with Jackie.

episodes:690.name: Home-Ec
episodes:690.summary: Darlene is embarrassed when Roseanne gives Darlene's home economics class a supermarket lesson in real-life family budgeting; D.J. has to deal with a bully.

episodes:690.name: Valentine's Day
episodes:690.summary: Roseanne is mad at Dan for forgetting Valentine's Day, so he winds up full-figure lingerie shopping; and Darlene's upset when a boy she likes asks out Becky instead.

episodes:690.name: Communicable Theater
episodes:690.summary: Roseanne is torn between taking care of her flu-stricken husband and helping Jackie learn lines for her play.

episodes:690.name: Vegas Interruptus
episodes:690.summary: Roseanne may lose her job if she and Dan go on their long-awaited trip to see Wayne Newton perform in Las Vegas.

episodes:690.name: Her Boyfriend's Back
episodes:690.summary: Frustrated because her parents can't afford the car she wants, Becky and her boyfriend Mark borrow Dan's treasured motorcycle against his orders.

episodes:690.name: Troubles with the Rubbles
episodes:690.summary: The new wife next door, Kathy Bowman, looks down on Roseanne and complains that D.J. is a bad influence on her son Todd.

episodes:690.name: Second Time Around
episodes:690.summary: Roseanne helps Crystal with her Lamaze classes; Dan's near-fatal accident at work makes D.J. follow him obsessively; Dan and Roseanne sit up all night doing their wills, and Jackie is offended that she doesn't get custody of the kids.

episodes:690.name: Dances with Darlene
episodes:690.summary: Roseanne tries to convince Darlene to wear something feminine to a big school dance -- but she'd rather attract attention for her softball skills.

episodes:690.name: Scenes from a Barbecue
episodes:690.summary: The Connors celebrate Mother's Day with a barbecue with Roseanne's feisty grandmother.

episodes:690.name: The Pied Piper of Lanford
episodes:690.summary: Dan and Roseanne commit to opening a motorcycle shop with a free-spirited old friend who gets cold feet at the last minute.

episodes:690.name: A Bitter Pill to Swallow
episodes:690.summary: Roseanne is stunned when Becky asks for advice about birth control.

episodes:690.name: Take My Bike ... Please!
episodes:690.summary: Roseanne and Dan open up shop at Lanford Custom Cycle, but selling a bike proves an exhausting challenge, as does keeping the household fine-tuned with Becky in charge.

episodes:690.name: Why Jackie Becomes a Trucker
episodes:690.summary: Jackie awakens and is horrified to find that she has slept with Arnie; Dan invites Leon home for the weekly poker game; DJ trades his comics for a dog.

episodes:690.name: Darlene Fades to Black
episodes:690.summary: Darlene slips into a depressive state, wanting to wear only black, watch TV and be left alone; Becky wants a motorcycle.

episodes:690.name: Tolerate Thy Neighbor
episodes:690.summary: Roseanne's new neighbors the Bowmans are burgled while they are out of town -- and hold Roseanne responsible.

episodes:690.name: Trick Me Up, Trick Me Down
episodes:690.summary: Roseanne is convinced that Kathy Bowman will take revenge for the Hallowe'en prank she played on her; Jackie flirts with a moose at the Lodge costume party only to discover that it's former boyfriend Booker (in his last appearance).

episodes:690.name: Vegas (1)
episodes:690.summary: Arnie decides to wed Nancy in Las Vegas, inviting Dan and Roseanne to stand up for them.

episodes:690.name: Vegas, Vegas (2)
episodes:690.summary: The Conners risk getting thrown out of a Vegas nightclub, and visit a wedding chapel with Arnie and Nancy.

episodes:690.name: Stressed to Kill
episodes:690.summary: Becky gets into hot water for helping Darlene with a school assignment; trying to stop smoking cold-turkey has Roseanne frazzled, as does working two jobs.

episodes:690.name: Thanksgiving '91
episodes:690.summary: Thanksgiving brings four generations together to cope with a surprise announcement from Bev.

episodes:690.name: Kansas City, Here We Come
episodes:690.summary: Roseanne and Jackie go to Kansas City to visit their father's mistress; Dan intends to beat up Becky's obnoxious boss.

episodes:690.name: Santa Claus
episodes:690.summary: Roseanne talks Leon into letting her play Santa Claus at the mall -- and hears something she wishes she hadn't from one of the kids' mothers, who turns out to be Darlene's new friend and confidante.

episodes:690.name: Bingo
episodes:690.summary: It is Crystal's choice to choose where the gals' night out will be. Crystal chooses bingo and they all hate it. After Roseanne wins $50 playing bingo, she gets hooked on it. Becky and Darlene baby-sit Little Ed, but when Dan comes home its D.J. and Dan that end up taking care of the baby. Roseanne and Crystal get into a fight, but at the end they make up and Roseanne learn that Crystal is pregnant again.

episodes:690.name: The Bowling Show
episodes:690.summary: When Dan and Arnie struggle to bring their bowling team out of last place, some unexpected competition arises. Meanwhile, Roseanne feels shut out of Jackie's new friendship with Nancy.

episodes:690.name: The Back Story
episodes:690.summary: After Roseanne throws her back out, Bev arrives to help out -- and to spoil her grandchildren.

episodes:690.name: Less is More
episodes:690.summary: A doctor recommends that Roseanne undergo breast reduction surgery for her back problems.

episodes:690.name: Breakin' Up is Hard to Do
episodes:690.summary: Roseanne and Dan breathe a sigh of relief when Becky breaks up with Mark.

episodes:690.name: This Old House
episodes:690.summary: On a last visit to their childhood home, Roseanne and Jackie recall their adolescent years, causing Roseanne to reconsider a punishment for Darlene, who skipped school with David to attend a comic-book convention in Chicago.

episodes:690.name: The Commercial Show
episodes:690.summary: The Conners are sitting pretty for a TV ad for Rodbell's Luncheonette, but at home things get ugly between D.J. and Todd. Leon and Steven break up, and the Bowmans move back to Chicago.

episodes:690.name: Therapy
episodes:690.summary: Roseanne accompanies Jackie to her therapist after she chooses the ideal man for Jackie -- dull tax accountant Art; Darlene mouths off once too often about a female school bully.

episodes:690.name: Lies
episodes:690.summary: Roseanne freaks out when she learns that Rodbell's employees must take a lie detector test to find out who has been stealing from the restaurant; Darlene bypasses Roseanne for advice about her beau.

episodes:690.name: Deliverance
episodes:690.summary: A pregnant Crystal snaps at everyone in sight, then goes into labour with Dan coaching her in the delivery room; Roseanne and Bonnie feud over who should replace Leon as the new manager of the coffee shop; and Darlene delivers a message to David to quit crowding her.

episodes:690.name: Secrets
episodes:690.summary: Mark turns to alcohol to solve his problems with Becky, and Dan lies to Roseanne about the boy's drunken, reckless evening at the Lobo Lounge to cover both their tracks.

episodes:690.name: Don't Make Me Over
episodes:690.summary: The girls take Roseanne to the Beauty Box for Mother's Day in hopes of convincing her to let them attend a weekend rock concert.

episodes:690.name: Aliens
episodes:690.summary: As the luncheonette closes and the bike shop folds, D.J.'s scholastic achievement is the only light on the Conners' dim horizon.

episodes:690.name: Terms of Estrangement (1)
episodes:690.summary: Roseanne supports the family after Dan's motorcycle shop goes under; Becky considers moving to Minneapolis with Mark.

episodes:690.name: Terms of Estrangement (2)
episodes:690.summary: Becky and Mark return to say goodbye before moving away.

episodes:690.name: The Dark Ages
episodes:690.summary: The power company cuts off the Conners' power. Dan and Roseanne must look at Darlene in a new light after David spends the night in her room.

episodes:690.name: Mommy Nearest
episodes:690.summary: Roseanne and Jackie are stunned when their mother announces she is moving to Lanford; Jackie agonizes over dating Fisher, a perfect but much, much younger man.

episodes:690.name: Pretty in Black
episodes:690.summary: Roseanne mortifies Darlene with a sweet sixteen party, then sends her off to her friends while the adults enjoy the festivities, which include a game of Truth or Dare; the Tildens move in next door; Darlene dyes her hair black to make Roseanne mad, but is shocked when Roseanne reacts differently.

episodes:690.name: Looking for Loans in All the Wrong Places
episodes:690.summary: Denied a loan to open the restaurant, Roseanne must turn to her mother; Darlene catches D.J. peeping at neighbor Molly.

episodes:690.name: Halloween IV
episodes:690.summary: Roseanne sends everyone to a party while she stays home -- and is visited by the ghosts of Halloween past, present, and future.

episodes:690.name: Ladies' Choice
episodes:690.summary: Nancy takes Roseanne and Jackie by surprise with the announcement that she and Marla are gay lovers; Bev announces she is moving into a Lanford retirement centre, which leaves Roseanne feeling over the hill.

episodes:690.name: Stand on Your Man
episodes:690.summary: The Lunch Box welcomes its first customers, including a weirdo whose presence sends the gals to a self-defense class. Meanwhile, Arnie questions his own manhood after hearing that Nancy is gay.

episodes:690.name: Good Girls, Bad Girls
episodes:690.summary: Roseanne reluctantly allows Darlene to go to a rock concert in nearby Rockford with Molly -- who abandons her.

episodes:690.name: Of Ice and Men
episodes:690.summary: D.J. decides to take up hockey and becomes the terror of the rink; Roseanne meddles to reunite Jackie and Fisher.

episodes:690.name: It's No Place Like Home for the Holidays
episodes:690.summary: A Christmas Eve snowstorm scatters the Connors, with Roseanne and Jackie trapped at the Lunch Box with Bev and Nana Mary, while Darlene takes shelter at David's and learns the truth about his home life.

episodes:690.name: Crime and Punishment (1)
episodes:690.summary: Dan disciplines D.J. for taking offensive reading material to school-- Darlene's comic book. Dan reacts strongly when Roseanne discovers that Fisher has beaten Jackie.

episodes:690.name: War and Peace (2)
episodes:690.summary: Dan returns home to rampart rumors about his behavior, while Roseanne urges a dazed Jackie to leave her abusive boyfriend.

episodes:690.name: Lanford Daze
episodes:690.summary: Darlene does NOT serve meat at the counter. She is forced to work there by Roseanne, but out of principal, will not serve the meat. That was her whole point.

episodes:690.name: Wait Till Your Father Gets Home
episodes:690.summary: The death of their father finds Jackie blubbering, but Roseanny angry -- and sharing a drink with the "other woman" in his life.

episodes:690.name: First Cousin, Twice Removed
episodes:690.summary: A wealthy and successful cousin whom Roseanne hasn't seen in 25 years comes to bury the hachet, and encourages Darlene to leave home.

episodes:690.name: Lose a Job, Winnebago
episodes:690.summary: The Conners and the Tildens travel to California in a motor home, with Dan pondering his future and Ty contemplating Jackie.

episodes:690.name: It's a Boy!
episodes:690.summary: Roseanne wants Darlene's boyfriend David to move in with them, but Dan refuses to allow it.

episodes:690.name: It Was Twenty Years Ago Today
episodes:690.summary: For their anniversary, Roseanne poses in a sexy photo for Dan, while he moonlights at a big-and-tall men's store to pay for his present for her.

episodes:690.name: Playing with Matches
episodes:690.summary: Darlene wants nothing to do with David after Molly kisses him; and a new friend puts a smile on Bev's face.

episodes:690.name: Promises, Promises
episodes:690.summary: Darlene springs a prom-night surprise on David: she has rented a motel room. Meanwhile, Dan is reluctant to share with Roseanne his plans for a new business.

episodes:690.name: Glengarry, Glen Rosey
episodes:690.summary: Roseanne and Dan fear a financial crisis when they cannot sell the house they refurbished and their new partner Roger skips town.

episodes:690.name: Tooth or Consequences
episodes:690.summary: Dan realizes that he needs a steady job to take care of his family when he accidentally knocks out one of Roseanne's teeth on the day she is to meet with a health inspector (who turns out to be Leon); Darlene is accepted to art school – but David is rejected.

episodes:690.name: Daughters and Other Strangers
episodes:690.summary: Roseanne worries that Darlene may be planning to run away from home; new neighbor George befriends D.J.

episodes:690.name: Two Down, One to Go
episodes:690.summary: Roseanne is suffering from empty-nest syndrome as Darlene heads for school. But after Darlene gets settled into her dorm, the two have a revealing mother-daughter chat, and Roseanne returns home with a plan.

episodes:690.name: The Mommy's Curse
episodes:690.summary: Brutally honest Roseanne suffers the consequences after telling Bev that she's had her fill of her at the Lunch Box. Meanwhile, Jackie jumps back into the dating arena.

episodes:690.name: Party Politics
episodes:690.summary: Roseanne attempts to enlist Darlene's aid in taming a rebellious D.J., while scheming to reunite her with David.

episodes:690.name: A Stash from the Past
episodes:690.summary: Foreman Dan feels lower than low for getting tough with his employees at work, while Roseanne lectures David for getting high after she finds a stash of pot in the house -- then realizes it is hers from decades ago.

episodes:690.name: Be My Baby
episodes:690.summary: After months of trying to get pregnant, Roseanne learns that Jackie is expecting -- and Fred is the unknowing father.

episodes:690.name: Halloween V
episodes:690.summary: Hallowe'en at the diner becomes complicated when Nancy complains that Dan doesn't like her, and Roseanne discovers that Darlene and David are each dating others.

episodes:690.name: Homeward Bound
episodes:690.summary: Darlene visits, making David realize how much he misses her; Roseanne urges Dan to have a man-to-man chat with D. J. after they discover he's been spending too much time behind locked doors.

episodes:690.name: Guilt by Imagination
episodes:690.summary: Dan has a hard time concealing the fact that he had lunch with an old flame.

episodes:690.name: Homecoming
episodes:690.summary: Becky and Mark return home for Dan's high school football team's 20th anniversary party. It soon becomes apparent that there's trouble in paradise, so Roseanne schemes to break them up.

episodes:690.name: Thanksgiving '93
episodes:690.summary: The Connors' dysfunctional-family Thanksgiving finds Becky preparing the bird, Dan and Mark duking it out, and an absent-minded Nana Mary revealing Bev's secret about her marriage.
