episodes:690.name: The Driver's Seat
episodes:690.summary: Leon convinces Jackie and Nancy to open the restaurant for breakfast, causing Roseanne to fear he is planning to force her out. Roseanne's car is stolen -- by DJ, and her violent reaction frightens her that she may repeat the pattern of her own abuse as a child, while Dan blames her anger on work stress.

episodes:690.name: White Trash Christmas
episodes:690.summary: Roseanne and Dan snub the neighborhood association by putting up gaudy Xmas decorations, and become furious with Becky when she gives the cheque they have given her for college to Mark and takes a job as a waitress in a tacky bar.

episodes:690.name: Suck Up or Shut Up
episodes:690.summary: Roseanne joins a women's club in hopes of establishing useful contacts, leaving DJ high and dry with a weird classmate whose mother also belongs; meanwhile Mark drops a bombshell on Becky when Dan discovers that he has dropped out of school.

episodes:690.name: Busted
episodes:690.summary: Dan and Roseanne try to talk Mark into coming back to Becky; meanwhile, Roseanne finds out that David is living with Darlene and heads for Chicago to confront them.

episodes:690.name: David vs. Goliath
episodes:690.summary: Guilt and Roseanne's slavedriving push David to confess to Dan that he was living with Darlene in Chicago, and Dan throws him out; Jackie refuses to take money for the baby from Fred; Roseanne and Becky try to pressure Dan to hire Mark.

episodes:690.name: Everyone Comes to Jackie's
episodes:690.summary: Jackie's house buzzes with activity as Roseanne tries to hide David from Dan.

episodes:690.name: Don't Make Room for Daddy
episodes:690.summary: Roseanne becomes involved in a family feud as Fred sues Jackie for custody of their unborn child; Mark and D.J. tease David for being unmanly.

episodes:690.name: Don't Ask, Don't Tell
episodes:690.summary: Roseanne is the life of the party at a gay bar, until Nancy's new girlfriend plants a disturbing kiss on her; meanwhile, back home, Becky's old flame gives Mark reason to distrust Becky.

episodes:690.name: Labor Day
episodes:690.summary: Jackie is due to give birth, and has to choose between Fred and Roseanne to accompany her to the delivery room.

episodes:690.name: Past Imperfect
episodes:690.summary: When Dan's father misses an alimony payment, Dan and Roseanne argue about covering it; meanwhile, Fred becomes concerned about Jackie's sexual past.

episodes:690.name: Lies My Father Told Me
episodes:690.summary: Roseanne helps Dan understand his dad's lying about his mom's mental state.

episodes:690.name: I Pray the Lord My Stove to Keep
episodes:690.summary: Darlene discovers that D.J. has been sneaking off after to school to attend church; D.J. gives Roseanne a hard time about morals when she accepts a mistaken delivery of a second stove at the diner.

episodes:690.name: Body by Jake
episodes:690.summary: Bev moves in after breaking her pelvis at the retirement home, blaming Dan for not safeproofing her shower; then Roseanne discovers that it happened while Bev and Jake were having sex.

episodes:690.name: Isn't It Romantic?
episodes:690.summary: Fred asks Roseanne how to propose to Jackie, then uses hints from Jackie's favourite soap opera; an enraged Roseanne demands romance from Dan, then turns to fantasy; Mark and David struggle with the concepts of feminism.

episodes:690.name: Altar Egos
episodes:690.summary: Egos clash when Jackie and Fred can't make a decision about their marriage. Fred is having what Dan calls "the moment of clarity" – a case of the jitters that affects some men just before the big day. But what's really bothering Fred is his belief that Jackie has feelings for someone she sees almost every day and whom she is always "asking to come over and fix stuff" – none other than Dan.

episodes:690.name: Nine is Enough
episodes:690.summary: Space limitations prompt Dan and Roseanne to boot Becky and Mark; Dan must shave his armpits to treat a cyst, and Roseanne finds his new look sexually appealing. Jackie moves out when Fred accuses her of smothering the baby; and Roseanne reveals that she has not caught Mark's flu.

episodes:690.name: Two for One
episodes:690.summary: Dan is anxious at the thought of Roseanne having another child; Roseanne is upset to discover that Darlene is seeing a college student and that David has accepted it.

episodes:690.name: Snoop Davey Dave
episodes:690.summary: Smarting over being dumped by Darlene, David tells her parents that she has been experimenting with drugs at college.

episodes:690.name: Girl Talk
episodes:690.summary: Dan, Mark and Fred indulge in a little "girl talk" and are horrified to discover what their respective wives have told each other about the men's sexual preferences – and disfunctions.

episodes:690.name: Sleeper
episodes:690.summary: David has to move in with D.J. when the basement is flooded; David hesitantly admits to Becky that he had an erotic dream; she assumes it was about her; D.J. tells Mark, who tries to beat up David; then David confesses the dream was really about Roseanne.

episodes:690.name: Skeleton in the Closet
episodes:690.summary: Leon outdoes himself hosting a Halloween soirée with the Lunch Box clan and a bevy of his gay friends, many of whom seem to know Fred – intimately. Meanwhile, Jackie and Roseanne visit Bev's hairdresser and become convinced that she wears a wig.

episodes:690.name: Follow the Son
episodes:690.summary: D.J. wants out of his busboy job at the Lunch Box, and David wants to put the kibosh on Darlene's moving in with her new squeeze Jimmy -- who misinterprets David's obsessive interest in him.

episodes:690.name: Punch and Jimmy
episodes:690.summary: An impromptu visit to Darlene's apartment gives Roseanne a clear picture of what Jimmy is all about; meanwhile at home, Dan finds himself a bit fuzzy on parenting skills: D.J. is being beaten up by a bully, and taking it out on David.

episodes:690.name: White Men Can't Kiss
episodes:690.summary: D.J.'s refusal to kiss a black student in the school play brings Dan and Roseanne face to face with their own racial prejudices.

episodes:690.name: Thanksgiving '94
episodes:690.summary: Thanksgiving is a real turkey at the Conner household when Roseanne gets alarming medical news she can't confirm with the pre-natal clinic, and Nana Mary arrives with a feeble husband on her arm -- then upsets Bev by discussing the two abortions Nana Mary had years ago.

episodes:690.name: Maybe Baby
episodes:690.summary: Roseanne is warring with Dan and in a dither over her upcoming second medical test, which may require a difficult decision -- one she believes is hers alone to make.

episodes:690.name: The Parenting Trap
episodes:690.summary: Dan takes the bull by the horns after he learns that D.J. isn't performing well in school; meanwhile, to Roseanne's horror, Darlene seems genuinely impressed with David's dimwitted new girlfriend.

episodes:690.name: Rear Window
episodes:690.summary: The Connors get an eyeful from a new elderly neighbor couple who enjoy nudity in their home but are all too visible from Roseanne and Dan's bedroom. Meanwhile, Mark is so convinced that he is losing Becky to David that he asks Darlene for help.

episodes:690.name: My Name is Bev
episodes:690.summary: After Bev is charged with drunken driving, Jackie and Roseanne accompany her to a compulsory AA seminar. Her new resolve of sobriety on Super Bowl Sunday wreaks havoc with Dan's keg party.

episodes:690.name: Bed and Bored
episodes:690.summary: Roseanne feigns illness to get some rest, but grows bored instead; Jackie confronts Bev about having been a rotten mother to her.

episodes:690.name: Sisters
episodes:690.summary: Sibling rivalries fester when Jackie complains to Roseanne about D.J.'s annoying visits, and Roseanne lures Darlene home.

episodes:690.name: Lost Youth
episodes:690.summary: Jealousies mount between David and Mark over vulnerable Lunch Box waitress Stacy, whom David asks to pose for a wall mural in the diner; Jackie complains to Fred that their lovemaking needs a shot in the arm, even though he likes it just the way it is.

episodes:690.name: Single Married Female
episodes:690.summary: In Roseanne's absence, Dan gets unexpected advice from David after discovering a scandalous secret concerning Jackie.

episodes:690.name: The Clip Show: All About Rosey (1)
episodes:690.summary: Youngsters Roseanne and Jackie visit a fortuneteller who gives them a peek into their futures via his crystal ball; in the future, Jackie takes an adult, autistic D.J. to see a psychiatrist.

episodes:690.name: The Clip Show: All About Rosey (2)
episodes:690.summary: The "Sitcom Moms Welcome Wagon" visits Roseanne.

episodes:690.name: Husbands and Wives
episodes:690.summary: Just as Fred gets ready to cave in and return home, Roseanne comes to regret sticking her nose in where it doesn't belong by trying to reunite him with Jackie.

episodes:690.name: Happy Trailers
episodes:690.summary: Becky and Mark finally leave the Conner nest to move into a tacky trailer park, but when Roseanne and Dan try to help out financially, their offers are met with a wall of resistance. Meanwhile, a tipsy neighbor drops by to put out the trailer park welcome mat.

episodes:690.name: The Blaming of the Shrew
episodes:690.summary: Dan puts his foot down when D.J. allows a pushy vixen to boss him around; and Jackie gets a few things off her chest when she and Fred visit a therapist to save their marriage.

episodes:690.name: The Birds and the Frozen Bees
episodes:690.summary: Roseanne has a bee in her bonnet over the possibility that David may like another girl better than Darlene -- who risks losing him if she doesn't take her mom's advice and act fast.

episodes:690.name: Couch Potatoes
episodes:690.summary: Because the Conners have been selected as a Neilsen family, Roseanne decrees that their household viewing habits must change.

episodes:690.name: Sherwood Schwartz: A Loving Tribute
episodes:690.summary: A Gilligan's Island fantasy plays into the season finale, which finds Dan torn between pleasing Roseanne and building a boat for a future adventure. Dan becomes the Skipper, Leon becomes Mr Howell, Bev becomes Mrs Howell, Jackie becomes Gilligan, Darlene becomes Maryanne, and Roseanne becomes Ginger.

episodes:690.name: Shower the People You Love with Stuff
episodes:690.summary: Hostesses Becky and Darlene disagree over Roseanne's baby shower.

episodes:690.name: Let Them Eat Junk
episodes:690.summary: Jackie chews out Roseanne for feeding baby Andy junk food; D.J. spends a picture-perfect day observing what makes Dan tick after Dan becomes upset to discover D.J.'s only photo of him shows him sitting drinking beer -- pretty much what makes him tick.

episodes:690.name: Roseanne in the Hood
episodes:690.summary: Roseanne will stop at nothing to crush the competition when a new, more posh eatery -- complete with a salad bar and a drive-through window -- opens up across from the Lunch Box.

episodes:690.name: The Last Date
episodes:690.summary: The temptation to crash a stranger's bar mitzvah at a local hotel is too much for Roseanne as she drags Dan out on the town for a "last hurrah" before the baby is born.

episodes:690.name: Halloween: the Final Chapter
episodes:690.summary: Roseanne reigns as "Queen of the Gypsies, consort of wizards and seer of souls" on Halloween, when an Ouija board sending a message from "The Dead" portends an unexpected event: she's in labour.

episodes:690.name: The Fifties Show
episodes:690.summary: The Conners find themselves going back in time in this spoof of 1950s sitcoms (shot mostly in black and white): Roseanne's a fussy hausfrau, Dan is a hapless businessman stewing over "the Anderson account," and Jackie's the wacky neighbor.

episodes:690.name: The Getaway, Almost
episodes:690.summary: Roseanne and Jackie's shopping trip with the baby becomes an outing a la Thelma and Louise after they give a lift to a rebellious teen, then force a trucker off the road.

episodes:690.name: The Last Thursday in November
episodes:690.summary: When D.J.'s teacher gives his students free rein, the class Thanksgiving pageant takes on a decidedly modern, Pulp Fiction twist-- and offends many of the parents, but not the Conners.

episodes:690.name: Of Mice and Dan
episodes:690.summary: With his old band mate performing in town, Dan's got the blues. Seems he regrets giving up his youthful dreams to settle down with Roseanne.

episodes:690.name: Direct to Video
episodes:690.summary: While Roseanne narrates a video time capsule for her unborn child, Becky and Darlene find old love letters of Dan and Roseanne's; D.J. gets upset when he finds his parents did not fill out his baby book; and Mark cooks dinner for the Conner clan.

episodes:690.name: December Bride
episodes:690.summary: Christmas for the Conners bring more than the usual holiday cheer and festivities, it also brings a wedding -- for Leon and Scott.

episodes:690.name: The Thrilla Near the Vanilla Extract
episodes:690.summary: Did someone say food fight? That's what Roseanne and Jackie's stint offering samples at a supermarket turns into when Jackie outsells her sister.

episodes:690.name: The White Sheep of the Family
episodes:690.summary: D.J. inherits $500 in his great aunt Harriet's will (because he was the only member of the family she never met) and blows half of it on a trombone to impress a girl who plays tuba in the school band. Meanwhile, Darlene alienates everyone by mentioning that she has turned down a $500/week job in advertising, an entry level position that would pay her more than both her parents earn.

episodes:690.name: Becky Howser, M.D.
episodes:690.summary: Roseanne advises an unhappy Becky to change her life -- not realizing that Mark doesn't share his wife's eagerness for change, so Becky intends to change her marriage.

episodes:690.name: Out of the Past
episodes:690.summary: While Nana Mary amuses Roseanne and Jackie with a box of their childhood treasures, Dan and his pals reluctantly play poker with Leon and Scott.

episodes:690.name: Construction Junction
episodes:690.summary: Dan weighs the merits of giving up his boring garage job for a new construction endeavor with his pals; Jackie surfs the Internet and becomes addicted.

episodes:690.name: We're Going to Disney World (1)
episodes:690.summary: The family goes hog wild with excitement -- and with plans to travel to Disney World -- when Dan brings home his final paycheck from the Lanford City Garage.

episodes:690.name: Disney World War II (2)
episodes:690.summary: Fireworks and fanfare accompany the Conners on a whirlwind tour of the magical kingdom of Disney World, when Darlene finds she's actually happy in the presence of Winnie the Pooh.

episodes:690.name: Springtime for David
episodes:690.summary: David moves out after getting a job at a theme park known as "the happiest place in Illinois," where he's soon transformed into an ultra-perky worker with an eerie smile.

episodes:690.name: Another Mouth to Shut Up
episodes:690.summary: Just weeks after their hot night in Disney World, Darlene drops a proposal -- and a surprise announcement: she's pregnant -- on David, whose major life changes seem to be happening all in one day.

episodes:690.name: Morning Becomes Obnoxious
episodes:690.summary: After an improptu interview at the diner goes spectacularly well, Roseanne prepares to "Wake Up Chicago" on a morning TV talk show as a news commentator with a unique and "opinionated blue-collar outlook" -- and with Jackie as her manager.

episodes:690.name: Ballroom Blitz
episodes:690.summary: Bev's smitten with her passionate ballroom-dance instructor -- until a drama unfolds on the dance floor when he starts flirting with the newly divorced Jackie.

episodes:690.name: The Wedding
episodes:690.summary: Darlene's wedding day brings unexpected tears, joy and tenderness as Dan is finally able to express his love to Darlene and the young couple's wedding vows bring Roseanne to tears.

episodes:690.name: Heart & Soul
episodes:690.summary: Roseanne's brave and witty front masks her fears after Dan suffers a heart attack during Darlene's wedding reception.

episodes:690.name: Fights and Stuff
episodes:690.summary: Dan returns home from hospital with orders from the doctor for a new diet regime -- and strict orders from Roseanne about changing his lifestyle.

episodes:690.name: Call Waiting
episodes:690.summary: Roseanne goes on a spiritual odyssey in front of the TV. After walking out on Dan in the heat of anger, Roseanne is now holed up at Jackie's, mesmerized by the sitcom couples she grew up with on That Girl, The Mary Tyler Moore Show and I Dream of Jeannie. Meanwhile, back at the Conner house, Dan is listlessly puttering around fixing things -- but he'd rather "fix things" in his marriage. And, much like the TV couples occupying Roseanne's thoughts, Dan and Roseanne just might discover that they're better off together than apart. In the coda, Jackie realizes that they have won $108 million in the state lottery.

episodes:690.name: Millions from Heaven
episodes:690.summary:
After finding out they won the Illinois State Lottery, the Conners and family imagine how to spend their new-found wealth. Kathleen Sullivan and Robin Leach interview Dan and Roseanne in their home. Throwing a party in their home proves that people really do come out of the woodwork to help celebrate wealth. Dan and Roseanne vow to not let money change who they are.

Written by Lynne Boris Johnston

episodes:690.name: What a Day for a Daydream
episodes:690.summary: Newly wealthy Roseanne indulges in daydreams involving Hugh Hefner and an appearance on the Jerry Springer Show in which she imagines her dreams – and even some of her nightmares – coming true thanks to the lottery winnings.

episodes:690.name: Honor Thy Mother
episodes:690.summary: While Roseanne and Jackie anticipate indulging themselves to unlock their "divine female essence" at a luxury spa, Dan is just plain morose -- and finally admits why: nagging worries about a family member, his institutionalized mother.

episodes:690.name: Someday My Prince Will Come
episodes:690.summary: A Moldavian prince descends on Lanford with one purpose in mind: to romance Jackie. It seems he's developed a royal crush on her after seeing her briefly on TV.

episodes:690.name: Pampered to a Pulp
episodes:690.summary: Roseanne and Jackie fight the battle of the bulge during their sojourn at a luxury spa, where past-life regression therapy brings out the imagined warrior in Roseanne.

episodes:690.name: Satan, Darling
episodes:690.summary: Absolutely Fabulous glam gals Jennifer Saunders and Joanna Lumley (in character as Edina and Patsy) are among the few down-to-earth participants in Roseanne's outrageous Halloween outing. They're guests at an Upper West Side soirée, where new multimillionaires Roseanne and Jackie have gained entrée into New York society. But for grandmother-to-be Roseanne, a witches' coven soon comes into play — a la Rosemary's Baby — and bizarre happenings begin to involve a very pregnant Darlene.

episodes:690.name: Hoi Polloi Meets Hoiti Toiti
episodes:690.summary: A visit with the wealthy Wentworths on Martha's Vineyard gives the Conners a glimpse into new friend Astrid's dysfunctional family. And before long, the Conners are teaching the snobby elitists some truths about real life.

episodes:690.name: Roseambo
episodes:690.summary: Roseanne battles a group of women-hating terrorists who hold her family and a foreign diplomat hostage on a train to Washington, D.C.

episodes:690.name: Home is Where the Afghan Is
episodes:690.summary: The absence of Dan, a series of family squabbles, and a shocking revelation by Bev mar the Conners' first Thanksgiving as a rich and famous family, and they start to realize that money does not necessarily buy happiness.

episodes:690.name: Mothers and Other Strangers
episodes:690.summary: Bev pays a visit to her free-spirited mom in search of answers, while Roseanne awaits Dan's return with trepidation, fearing he might not recognize the place -- or her new look.

episodes:690.name: Home for the Holidays
episodes:690.summary: After a long stay in California with his mother, Dan returns home for Christmas and he, Roseanne and the rest of the family begin to realize how fortunate they are to have each other and how much they have to be thankful for as the old year ends.

episodes:690.name: Say It Ain't So
episodes:690.summary: Jackie forces Dan to reveal some devastating news to Roseanne: he's been having an affair in California with a nurse who cared for his mother. Meanwhile, D.J. wants the job of videotaping Darlene giving birth; and Jackie must face a harsh truth about her own love life.

episodes:690.name: Hit the Road, Jack
episodes:690.summary: As Dan packs his bags to leave, Roseanne drowns her sorrows in fast food while driving aimlessly around Lanford, and D.J. finds a soul mate to share his troubles.

episodes:690.name: The War Room
episodes:690.summary: When a heartbroken Roseanne locks herself in her room and won't come out, her family and friends all try in their own unique way to help her get out of her funk. Friends and family try an intervention after they're unable to rouse a listless Roseanne out of bed, where she's been for four days amid piles of junk food, depressed over Dan's affair.

episodes:690.name: Lanford's Elite (1)
episodes:690.summary: At a party at the swank Lanford Country Club, Roseanne forges a surprising bond with Edgar Wellman, Jr., the son of her hated former boss. When he reveals some shocking news about the future of Lanford, Roseanne realizes she may be the only one who can save her hometown.

episodes:690.name: Some Enchanted Merger (2)
episodes:690.summary: After they wrap up the Wellman Plastics buyout, Roseanne doesn't know what to do when she finds herself deeply attracted to Edgar Wellman, Jr., and realizes that he is equally bewitched by her.

episodes:690.name: A Second Chance
episodes:690.summary: Bothered by rumors about Roseanne and "that Wellman guy," Dan sweeps by to take Roseanne out for a ride. Roseanne and Dan begin to take the first tentative steps toward putting their marriage back together. But their reconciliation is disrupted when a frantic call comes in from Jackie: Darlene has been suddenly rushed to the hospital.

episodes:690.name: The Miracle
episodes:690.summary: When Darlene gives birth to a very premature baby, the doctors offer very little hope for the child's survival. But Roseanne sets out to prove that love, affection and human contact are better than any medicine.

episodes:690.name: Roseanne-Feld
episodes:690.summary: Jackie and Mark take in a female wrestling match; D.J. is not prepared when he realizes he may be about to have his first sexual experience when a night of watching videos with Heather turns into a night of passion; and Bev introduces Leon and Scott to her new "friend," a boozy lounge singer named Joyce.

episodes:690.name: The Truth Be Told
episodes:690.summary: Roseanne learns some truths about the price of fame when two high-powered television programmers bombard her with all sorts of bizarre ideas about how network and cable TV would tell her life story. Roseanne is appalled to learn that one wants to sanitize her life and the other wants to spice it up. At the same time, Bev is happily telling stories about Roseanne to a friendly florist, unaware that he is actually a tabloid reporter.

episodes:690.name: Arsenic and Old Mom
episodes:690.summary: Dan's eccentric mom heads straight for Lanford after she's released from hospital, claiming to be cured. Problem is, Dan thinks she's trying to kill him.

episodes:690.name: Into That Good Night (1)
episodes:690.summary: Darlene and David bring home their new baby. Roseanne's sage advice for her daughter? "The best part is when you can mold their tender little egos to fit your every whim," she says. But the baby's not the only news. When friends and family gather to celebrate the birth, Becky and Mark have a surprising secret -- and Leon and Scott make an announcement.

episodes:690.name: Into That Good Night (2)
episodes:690.summary: Roseanne fans find out much more than they thought they would.

episodes:690.name: Twenty Years to Life
episodes:690.summary: Roseanne and Dan adjust to living under the same roof with Darlene and her two children, Harris and Mark, when Darlene loses her job. Meanwhile, Becky announces she is going to be a surrogate to make extra money; and Roseanne and Jackie are at odds with one another.

episodes:690.name: Dress to Impress
episodes:690.summary: Darlene's son, Mark, gets caught with a pocket knife after being bullied on the first day of his new school. Meanwhile, Becky invites Andrea over to meet the family and is nervous to bring her home.

episodes:690.name: Roseanne Gets the Chair
episodes:690.summary: Roseanne's clash with Darlene over how she's raising her kids - especially Harris - reaches a breaking point; while Dan tries to help Roseanne with her bad knee by getting her an elevator chair, which she refuses to use because she doesn't want to admit getting old.

episodes:690.name: Eggs Over, Not Easy
episodes:690.summary: A crucial moment for Becky's surrogacy arrangement forces her and Darlene to critically assess each other's lives. Meanwhile, an animal rescue organization rejects Jackie's application to adopt a puppy; and Roseanne makes a plan to change their mind.

episodes:690.name: Darlene v. David
episodes:690.summary: David unexpectedly shows up for Harris' birthday after being absent for years, forcing Darlene to re-examine their relationship and the rest of the family. Meanwhile, Bev temporarily moves into the Conner home after an incident at the nursing home prevents her from returning.

episodes:690.name: No Country for Old Women
episodes:690.summary: After Beverly gets kicked out of the nursing home, Roseanne and Jackie fight over who will take care of their mother. Meanwhile, Mark's creative touch with building a birdhouse for Dan's customer is more than Dan can handle, but Darlene defends her son.

episodes:690.name: Go Cubs
episodes:690.summary: The Conners can't pay their Wi-Fi bill, so they befriend their new neighbors to use the internet for Mary to Skype with mom Geena, who is stationed in Afghanistan. Meanwhile, Dan loses an important job and D.J. admits post-military life has been hard, so they come up with a plan to make extra money.

episodes:690.name: Netflix & Pill
episodes:690.summary: After celebrating their 45th anniversary, Roseanne reveals to Dan a bigger problem with her bad knee. Meanwhile, Crystal announces her retirement as a waitress at the casino, and Becky and Darlene compete for the job, which has full-time benefits.

episodes:690.name: Knee Deep
episodes:690.summary: Roseanne's knee gets worse so Dan is forced to a make an important work decision; but when a major storm hits Lanford, their fortunes change for the better. Later, Darlene realizes she has to go back to her first passion, writing.

show:peak practice.name: Peak Practice
show:peak practice.summary: Peak Practice was first broadcast in 1993, the series was about a small country GP practice in the ficticious village of Cardale in the Derbyshire Dales. Having inherited the practice from her father Dr. Beth Glover (Amanda Burton) was the first Senior Partner. Along with Will Preston (Simon Shepherd) and Jack Kerruish (Kevin Whately) the three doctors ran the surgery for three series. Peak Practice follows the highs and lows of life in Cardale for these Doctors and others that followed them. The Series came to an end in 2002 after 12 succesful series.

episodes:7767.name: Sharp Practice
episodes:7767.summary: Dr Jack Kerruish starts work at a surgery in Derbyshire, where he develops a volatile relationship with fellow medic Dr Beth Glover.

episodes:7767.name: Outsiders
episodes:7767.summary: The Beeches finally becomes a paying concern - but Beth's relief at its new-found solvency is cut short by a discovery that a rival health centre is stealing her patients.

episodes:7767.name: Growing Pains
episodes:7767.summary: Jack treats an athlete whose sudden pre-race injury seems too convenient to be true.

episodes:7767.name: Roses Around the Door
episodes:7767.summary: Jack tries to help a childless couple and learns a harsh lesson.

episodes:7767.name: Impulsive Behaviour
episodes:7767.summary: Jack helps resolve a confused priest's doubts about his mental state, and begins flirting with an attractive trainee GP working at a rival centre to The Beeches.

episodes:7767.name: Hope to Die
episodes:7767.summary: Jack and Beth disagree over the treatment of a young patient with a heart defect, whilst Sarah and Will's marriage deteriorates as their financial problems mount.

episodes:7767.name: Listening Skills
episodes:7767.summary: Will desperately tries to make up with Sarah and comes up with a plan to clear their debts.

episodes:7767.name: Giddy Heights
episodes:7767.summary: Jack's mountain rescue skills are put to the test when a kidney transplant is lost during a storm, while Will tries to deal with his personal problems.

episodes:7767.name: In Good Faith
episodes:7767.summary: Jack struggles to save an asthmatic's girls life when her mother will only resort to faith healing. Meanwhile, Will has survived his breakdown and is keen to get back to work.

episodes:7767.name: Old Habits
episodes:7767.summary: The three doctors fall out when a Consultant refuses to operate on their heart patient because he is a heavy smoker. Meanwhile Will's marriage suffers another setback.

episodes:7767.name: Love Thy Neighbour
episodes:7767.summary: Jack is caught in a dilemma when he has to tell his best friends that Chloe has cancer, and his relationship with Beth continues to deteriorate.

episodes:7767.name: Act of Remembrance
episodes:7767.summary: Jack has to deal with a patient whose employer will not let her rest. Meanwhile, Isabel and Ken's romance takes a dive when their ward collapses.

episodes:7767.name: Enemy Within
episodes:7767.summary: Jack is shocked and angry when Beth is assaulted by a patient's father.

episodes:7767.name: Long Weekend
episodes:7767.summary: Jack tries to help his ex-fiancée Karen, who is an acute schizophrenic, while Kim contracts a rare infection.

episodes:7767.name: Chance Encounter
episodes:7767.summary: After secretly meeting her ex-lover, Beth comes across an accident on the moors which takes a life-threatening turn.

episodes:7767.name: Life Changes
episodes:7767.summary: Will's marriage hits rock bottom and Beth must pass on devastating news to a friend.

episodes:7767.name: A Brave Face
episodes:7767.summary: An old friend of Will's requests his help to end their life.

episodes:7767.name: Abbey
episodes:7767.summary: The village is shocked when a dead baby is discovered on the moors and a homeless teenage girl is suspected of being the mother.

episodes:7767.name: Perfect Love
episodes:7767.summary: Beth and Jack are excited about their wedding day, but their friends' idyllic marriage reveals deeper feelings which bring them down to earth.

episodes:7767.name: Power Games
episodes:7767.summary: Jack suspects a patient of malingering and Beth becomes embroiled in a family dispute when one of her patients suffers a heart attack.

episodes:7767.name: Happy Ever After
episodes:7767.summary: Alice appears in court for non-payment of Council Tax, a teenager asks Jack for tranquilisers, and interviews are held for the post of fund manager.

episodes:7767.name: Light at the End of the Tunnel
episodes:7767.summary: A group of school kids get trapped in a mine forcing Jack to face his fears as he tries to rescue them. Meanwhile, Sarah and Will finally decide to divorce.

episodes:7767.name: Tender
episodes:7767.summary: A new nurse joins the practice and Will stands as a candidate for the local council. Meanwhile, Beth comes to terms with a friend's imminent death.

episodes:7767.name: Coming Out
episodes:7767.summary: Beth treats two youngsters for an infection spread by rat urine, while Jack opposes Cardale residents trying to get a new home for ex-psychiatric patients closed down.

episodes:7767.name: Losing Out
episodes:7767.summary: Beth finds herself in the unhappy position of having to investigate her own husband's professional conduct, a predicament made worse by the grief of Isabel's funeral.

episodes:7767.name: To Have and to Hold
episodes:7767.summary: Jack feels increasingly disillusioned with life in Cardale and goes to set up a new clinic in Africa, leaving Beth hard-pressed to cope in his absence,

episodes:7767.name: Fighting Chance
episodes:7767.summary: Will tries to help a boxing champion whose blackouts are casting a shadow over his future in sport, but only succeeds in driving him into the bare-knuckle areana.

episodes:7767.name: Family Ties
episodes:7767.summary: Will's son is seriously injured on the school rugby field, while Jack returns from Africa and barely has the chance to unpack before he is called out to an attempted death.

episodes:7767.name: Ill Wind
episodes:7767.summary: A freak storm hits Cardale, and the Kerruishes work round the clock to treat casualties, saving strangers as well as close friends injured in the devastation.

episodes:7767.name: A Normal Life
episodes:7767.summary: A Cardale schoolgirl begins behaving erratically, causing concern for her parents and provoking a professional difference of opinion between Will and Beth.

episodes:7767.name: Walking Away
episodes:7767.summary: New trainee Andrew Attwood arrives at The Beeches and causes friction, falling foul of Jack and losing a valuable contract.

episodes:7767.name: Bedside Manners
episodes:7767.summary: Andrew lands himself in hot water again by failing to diagnose a patient's life-threatening condition, while Jack doubts Will's commitment to the practice.

episodes:7767.name: Giving Up
episodes:7767.summary: Pub tenants James and Chloe ask Jack for advice on how to become foster parents, and Beth is rushed to hospital with abdominal pains, leaving Andrew to handle her workload.

episodes:7767.name: Nobody's Fault
episodes:7767.summary: Andrew tries to help a distressed patient who is mutilating himself, but when the man attempts suicide the doctor realises the situation is more severe than he thought...

episodes:7767.name: Life and Soul
episodes:7767.summary: Jack considers expanding the practice, though Will voices his objections, whilst Beth links a patient's ill health to his working environment,,,

episodes:7767.name: Other Lives
episodes:7767.summary: Beth wants to move away from Cardale, but Jack doesn't share her enthusiasm. Meanwhile, Chloe and James attend an interview at the fostering agency.

episodes:7767.name: Holding It Together
episodes:7767.summary: Now that Jack and Beth have left for Africa, Will sets about finding new partners to help run The Beeches, a task made doubly difficult by new locum Erica Matthews...

episodes:7767.name: A New Life
episodes:7767.summary: Will bids a tearful farewell to the boys as they leave for Florida, while Erica is confronted by a patient suffering from delusions.

episodes:7767.name: New Horizons
episodes:7767.summary: Erica throws a house-warming party, intending to use it as an excuse to chat up Will - but he spoils her plans by turning up with a doctor from the nearby health centre,,,

episodes:7767.name: Looking Back
episodes:7767.summary: Erica clashes with Will as she struggles to deal with the emotional problems created by the arrival of old flame Dan Copeland, who has tracked her down from Manchester.

episodes:7767.name: Whipping Boy
episodes:7767.summary: Will and Andrew clash over the welfare of a boy trapped in a bitter custody battle.

episodes:7767.name: Close Ties
episodes:7767.summary: Erica intervenes in an operation, saving the patient's life and prompting Will to look favourably at her application. Kirsty begins to have doubts about her future with Andrew...

episodes:7767.name: In Safe Hands
episodes:7767.summary: Andrew secures a patient's life-saving operation, but Kirsty is still left wondering if she's doing the right thing...

episodes:7767.name: Partners
episodes:7767.summary: Will finds himself increasingly drawn to Kate - until a disagreement prompted by a multiple sclerosis sufferer's violent husband makes him have second thoughts.

episodes:7767.name: Running on Empty
episodes:7767.summary: Personal dilemmas continue to overshadow the medical agenda, as a depressed Andrew jeopardises his career and Kate agonises over Will's suggestion they move in together...

episodes:7767.name: Heart and Soul
episodes:7767.summary: Kate announces she's pregnant but intends to have an abortion, forcing Will to make an agonising personal choice.

episodes:7767.name: Eye of the Storm
episodes:7767.summary: Will is ecstatic to become a father and Andrew returns to Cardale after six months away, asking for his old job back, but finds a surprise in store for him.

episodes:7767.name: The Price
episodes:7767.summary: Will and Kate face a harrowing time as their baby's health deteriorates alarmingly.

episodes:7767.name: Innocent Blood
episodes:7767.summary: David's family join him in Cardale, but his happiness is marred by the discovery that a boy he helped deliver 11 years ago has contracted a deadly illness.

episodes:7767.name: Letting Go
episodes:7767.summary: Will says farewell to his friends and colleagues over a special lunch which ends in a big surprise for the departing doctor, while Erica battles to save Alice North's life.

episodes:7767.name: Classics
episodes:7767.summary: Andrew is seriously injured in a car crash en route to Erica's birthday party, and faces the from task of ensuring his fellow motorists make it through the night alive.

episodes:7767.name: Lost Feelings
episodes:7767.summary: David help a paraplegic friend and his wife fulfil their dearest wish to have a child, whilst Andrew investigates Erica's claims of supernatural goings-on.

episodes:7767.name: Home Truths
episodes:7767.summary: Andrew and Erica clash over the best way to treat a baby's mysterious illness,

episodes:7767.name: Running to Hide
episodes:7767.summary: Andrew's relationship with his shapely accountant goes beyond business, while David worries about his wife's erratic behaviour and the practice is sued for negligence.

episodes:7767.name: Borrowed Time
episodes:7767.summary: An old friend of Andrew arrives in Cardale with devastating news.

episodes:7767.name: Tough Love
episodes:7767.summary: Andrew bites the bullet and tells Erica he wants them to be a couple, but her reaction is not as he had hoped. Claire's extrovert behaviour causes gossip among the locals.

episodes:7767.name: State of Mind
episodes:7767.summary: Clare unwittingly endangers an older patient's life, forcing David to step back and take a long, hard look at what's causing her erratic behaviour

episodes:7767.name: Priorities
episodes:7767.summary: Erica's commitment to the Beeches is tested to the limit.

episodes:7767.name: A Change of Heart
episodes:7767.summary: Andrew's ex-wife turns up out of the blue, forcing him to re-examine his feelings for her and Erica, while Clare's mental condition takes yet another turn for the worse.

episodes:7767.name: Fight or Flight
episodes:7767.summary: David treats a pilot suffering from what seems to be vertigo, although his dizzy spells could have another cause...

episodes:7767.name: All Fall Down
episodes:7767.summary: David & Andrew strive to convince the authorities that mass inoculation is the only way to prevent a meningitis outbreak sweeping through Cardale.

episodes:7767.name: Through a Glass Darkly
episodes:7767.summary: Erica is left traumatised by a meeting with her natural father, while Andrew regrets inviting David to go house-hunting with him.

episodes:7767.name: A Matter of Principle
episodes:7767.summary: David takes on the Health Authority, outraged that they won't operate on a Down's syndrome heart patient.

episodes:7767.name: A Good Son
episodes:7767.summary: A local lad returns to Cardale after travelling the world, but it soon becomes clear he's got something to hide. A phone call from his sister shatters Andrew's happiness.

episodes:7767.name: Another Day of Life
episodes:7767.summary: New locum Nick Goodson arrives at the Beeches and Erica's role as prosecution witness in a controversial child abuse trial makes her the target of a hate campaign.

episodes:7767.name: A Change of View
episodes:7767.summary: Erica prepares to visit Andrew in Liverpool, leaving locum Nick Goodson in charge of the surgery, while David tangles with a pair of runaway pensioners in a stolen coach.

episodes:7767.name: Body and Soul
episodes:7767.summary: Andrew stops dithering and proposes to Erica, but his mind is soon distracted from romance by the plight of a priest suffering from a mystery illness.

episodes:7767.name: The Spinning Wheel
episodes:7767.summary: Andrew's terminally ill mother asks him to help end her life, while back in Cardale, the past catches up with scheming locum Dr Nick Goodson in spectacular fashion.

episodes:7767.name: Glass Houses
episodes:7767.summary: David has an unscheduled run-in with old flame Anna Bradshaw, and it isn't long before sparks are flying in more ways than one.

episodes:7767.name: The Ghost in the Machine
episodes:7767.summary: Erica makes a decision over Andrew's proposal, but while looking to the future, a dangerous legacy from the past threatens public safety elsewhere in Cardale.

episodes:7767.name: The Falling Sky
episodes:7767.summary: A woman holds a wounded Andrew and a heavily pregnant Clare at gunpoint, triggering a tense siege.

episodes:7767.name: A Child I Dreamed
episodes:7767.summary: A woman who agrees to be a surrogate mother finds her decision has far-reaching consequences.

episodes:7767.name: Two Things Stand Like Stone
episodes:7767.summary: Erica prepares for her hen night, Rob McBride's past threatens to ruin his future.

episodes:7767.name: Once in a Lifetime
episodes:7767.summary: Cardale prepares for Andrew and Erica's wedding, but a health scare tests everyone to the limit.

episodes:7767.name: Race Against Time
episodes:7767.summary: Andrew takes up rally driving in the hope it will help him forget Erica.

episodes:7767.name: The Ties That Bind
episodes:7767.summary: The race is on to find a suitable donor to save a dying leukaemia patient.

episodes:7767.name: Turn a Blind Eye
episodes:7767.summary: Joanna feels the emotional strain of general practice when one of her patients faces death.

episodes:7767.name: Comrades in Arms
episodes:7767.summary: Andrew's judgement is put on the line in a battle of prejudice and personal feeling.

episodes:7767.name: Passion
episodes:7767.summary: David gives an old friend some shocking advice, but struggles to practice what he preaches.

episodes:7767.name: Map of the Heart - Part 1
episodes:7767.summary: David tries to help a troubled teenager, but ends up risking the happiness of everyone around him.

episodes:7767.name: Map of the Heart - Part 2
episodes:7767.summary: As Cardale struggles to come to terms with David's shocking death, a destructive patient pushes Andrew's patience to the limit.

episodes:7767.name: Before the Lights Go Out
episodes:7767.summary: A new face appears at the Beeches, and Joanna's heroic efforts to arrange an operation for an Alzheimer's sufferer bring her into contact with an old flame.

episodes:7767.name: Fighting Chance
episodes:7767.summary: The staff fight to save the community hospital, finding an ally in Ronnie, who uses his experience to their advantage.

episodes:7767.name: No Bounds
episodes:7767.summary: Sam is tormented by the case of a cancer sufferer who refuses to endanger her unborn child by undergoing treatment, while the campaign to save the local hospital gets a boost...

episodes:7767.name: Take Her Back
episodes:7767.summary: Joanna is held at knifepoint by a runaway mother, some good news lifts Sam's depression over the death of a patient and romance blossoms between Andrew and Dawn...

episodes:7767.name: Single Minded
episodes:7767.summary: Dawn fears her breast cancer might return, while plucky local copper Pete Greenhalgh faces an adversary even his courage cannot protect him from.

episodes:7767.name: The Nature of Things
episodes:7767.summary: Clare Shearer returns to Cardale and wastes no time in claiming her share of the Beeches.

episodes:7767.name: Breaking Point
episodes:7767.summary: A chance encounter with a troop of soldiers plunges Joanna into a life-or-death crisis.

episodes:7767.name: Alone
episodes:7767.summary: A savage attack on Alice North shocks Cardale, and helps push Joanna back into the arms of her ex-lover Martin Henderson.

episodes:7767.name: Eskimo Roll
episodes:7767.summary: Sam learns a respected member of the community is harbouring a devastating secret and Joanna grows concerned about Alice's state of mind.

episodes:7767.name: Wood for the Trees
episodes:7767.summary: Dawn's son slips into a coma, leaving surgeons baffled. Meanwhile, estranged father Keith turns up, indicating his disapproval of his wife's involvement with Andrew...

episodes:7767.name: Buying Time
episodes:7767.summary: Sam breaks all the rules and gets emotionally involved with a patient, casting a shadow over his future at the Beeches.

episodes:7767.name: Change of Life
episodes:7767.summary: Sam makes an unusual bet with a smoker anxious to quit, while Andrew tries to help a farmer whose failing health has driven him to take desperate measures.

episodes:7767.name: Close to Heaven - Part 1
episodes:7767.summary: Tragedy looms as Andrew and Sam try to save an injured man from a fast-flowing river, only too aware that his life rests in their hands.

episodes:7767.name: Close to Heaven - Part 2
episodes:7767.summary: Sam is tormented by the thought that he could have done more to help Andrew and Joanna's teenage patient recoils from the prospect of an operation.

episodes:7767.name: The First Stone
episodes:7767.summary: Sam tries to help an overweight local woman whose efforts to slim are placing her life in jeopardy, while Joanna sparks off another health scare in Cardale.

episodes:7767.name: Dark Side of the Moon
episodes:7767.summary: Joanna is presented with an unenviable dilemma by old flame Martin Henderson, who asks her to leave Cardale and start a new life with him.

episodes:7767.name: Not Waving But Drowning
episodes:7767.summary: Sam is visited by an old friend who seems to have gone up in the world since their schooldays together, but the reunion has a tragic outcome.

episodes:7767.name: Moving On
episodes:7767.summary: Andrew tries to convince his friend Ronnie Neale that he has a serious illness, and ends up coming to blows with Dawn's estranged husband Keith over her affections.

episodes:7767.name: New Beginnings
episodes:7767.summary: Joanna breaks devastating news to a teenage gymnast, and finds herself thrust into the middle of a family crisis.

episodes:7767.name: Family Values
episodes:7767.summary: Andrew treats a man whose sister is killing him with kindness, whilst Sam encourages a grieving husband to accept responsibility for his baby daughter.

episodes:7767.name: Letting Go
episodes:7767.summary: The doctors wrestle with the concept of assisted death.

episodes:7767.name: Language of the Eye
episodes:7767.summary: A hypochondriac tries Joanna's patience with a string a fictitious illnesses, while Andrew attempts to help a girl's parents come to terms with her deafness.

episodes:7767.name: Once Too Often
episodes:7767.summary: Joanna faces dilemma on both a personal and professional level, while Sam sets his heart on a romantic goal and Andrew tries to avoid appearing deceitful.

episodes:7767.name: Truth or Dare
episodes:7767.summary: A chemical spillage outside the Black Swan plunges Cardale into a state of emergency, and it's up to Andrew and Same to save lives.

episodes:7767.name: Ghosts
episodes:7767.summary: Sam tries to reunite a family torn apart by a terrible secret, while Joanna sets off to see Tom in Scarborough - but has trouble telling him the reason for her visit.

episodes:7767.name: A Test of Faith
episodes:7767.summary: Andrew and Kate help an alcoholic woman fighting to keep custody of her children, while Mike and Liz digest some unexpected news.

episodes:7767.name: Turning Tides
episodes:7767.summary: Carol's troubled son turns up unexpectedly, Sam and Kerri expose a drugs fraud, and Andrew makes a life-changing decision.

episodes:7767.name: Faith, Hope and Love
episodes:7767.summary: Sam is forced to confront his feelings for Kerri, while Joanna discovers a patient's seemingly trivial snoring problem hides a sensitive issue.

episodes:7767.name: Last Orders
episodes:7767.summary: Joanna and Tom face tough decisions about their future, and Sam's medical bag is stolen, leading to a crisis for one of his patients.

episodes:7767.name: Hopes and Dreams
episodes:7767.summary: A feud between a local farmer and a fairground family has tragic consequences for Joanna, while Andrew learns his affair with Kate is no longer a secret.

episodes:7767.name: For the Love of the Child
episodes:7767.summary: A fresh face joins the surgery, while a patient suspected of being a paedophile is the cause of a fierce dispute between Tom and Andrew...

episodes:7767.name: Hit and Run
episodes:7767.summary: Alex tries to get to the bottom of a local policeman's aggressive behaviour and finds his dark secret, while Richard edges nearer to finding out the truth about Kate's affair...

episodes:7767.name: Skin Deep
episodes:7767.summary: Andrew feels the wrath of Richard as his affair with Kate becomes common knowledge. Tom struggles to help a teenager whose battle against anorexia is tearing her family apart.

episodes:7767.name: On a Clear Day
episodes:7767.summary: A childless woman's bid to adopt is thrown into jeopardy by ill health, and Tom seeks a nanny to look after Joe.

episodes:7767.name: Absolution
episodes:7767.summary: Andrew and Kate's relationship sails into stormy waters as Richard's life hangs in the balance, and Alex tries to persuade a patient to undergo treatment for his breast cancer.

episodes:7767.name: Lonely Hearts - Part 1
episodes:7767.summary: Andrew gains a doting fan, and Carol discovers her new male friend has an unorthodox method of pain relief.

episodes:7767.name: Lonely Hearts - Part 2
episodes:7767.summary: Andrew's career hangs in the balance as the GMC deliberates over charges of misconduct with an infatuated former patient.

episodes:7767.name: Divided We Stand
episodes:7767.summary: Will fears a patient is pressuring his younger brother into donating a kidney, while Alice makes a shocking discovery about the local TV repair man.

episodes:7767.name: Keeping Up the Act
episodes:7767.summary: Sam helps a lovestruck teenager deal with an embarrassing complaint, and pub landlord Mike Pullen pushes himself too far to impress the brewery manager.

episodes:7767.name: Playing God
episodes:7767.summary: A pregnant woman's dilemma reminds Will of a past tragedy, and Alex is forced to tackle her addiction while treating a victim of passive smoking.

episodes:7767.name: Walls of Jericho
episodes:7767.summary: Alex has to summon up the courage of her convictions to help a Down's Syndrome patient, and Will comes to the aid of a feuding couple.

episodes:7767.name: Masquerade
episodes:7767.summary: Will makes the mistake of getting emotionally attached to a patient with psychiatric problems, and a black cloud descends over Kerri and Sam's engagement party.

episodes:7767.name: Electricity
episodes:7767.summary: The Beeches partnership is suddenly thrown into a state of turmoil as fate deals a cruel blow to Sam and Kerri, leaving them fighting for their lives.

episodes:7767.name: Still Waters
episodes:7767.summary: Will's sympathy for a couple of old friends contemplating fertility treatment soon turns to irritation when they opt to take matters into their own hands.

episodes:7767.name: Flesh and Blood
episodes:7767.summary: Tom blows his top when Bridgit breaks the rules by having an affair with a haemophiliac patient, and Sam invests in a controversial new drug.

episodes:7767.name: Win Some, Lose Some
episodes:7767.summary: Tom fears cyclist Nick Pullen is being pushed beyond his limits by an overzealous trainer, while Will clashes with ex-wife Kate over an alcoholic patient.

episodes:7767.name: Trust in Me
episodes:7767.summary: Will uncovers the extent of Sam's deception as he prepares to go down the aisle with Kerri, leaving the bride with a tough decision to make.

episodes:7767.name: Together We Stand
episodes:7767.summary: Alex helps two elderly sisters against Will's orders and discovers something about herself into the bargain, wjile Tom persuades Kerri to face everyone at work.

episodes:7767.name: Prisoners of the Past
episodes:7767.summary: Will treats a nun with a broken arm and in the process finds she's dying from an incurable illness, a traumatic revelation that brings him closer to wife Kate.

episodes:7767.name: Private Lives, Public Eye
episodes:7767.summary: The Mayor of Cardale suffers severe attacks of lethargy, and Tom uncovers an affair between a local teacher and her pupil.

episodes:7767.name: Suffer the Little Children
episodes:7767.summary: Will unwittingly brings to light a family scandal, while Tom and Alex's budding relationship is jeopardised by a difference of medical opinion.

episodes:7767.name: Body Beautiful
episodes:7767.summary: Tom helps a swimming instructor come to terms with a serious bowel condition, and a meals-on-wheels driver suffers a stroke at the wheel and nearly crashes into Kate.

episodes:7767.name: Hidden Agendas
episodes:7767.summary: Alex struggles to save a boy's life after a farmer dumps dangerous chemicals in a pond, but is distracted when her estranged father turns up seeking a reconciliation.

episodes:7767.name: Crossfire
episodes:7767.summary: Will's career is thrown into turmoil when one of his patients has an epileptic fit while driving and is killed in the ensuing crash.

episodes:7767.name: Blind Spot
episodes:7767.summary: Tom is caught in a dilemma when a harassed mother requests an abortion without telling her husband. Alex faces her cancer test ordeal alone.

episodes:7767.name: Bad Medicine
episodes:7767.summary: Alex flees the practice and heads back home to York, hotly pursued by Tom, who tries to persuade her to face up to her illness.

episodes:7767.name: Episode 1
episodes:7767.summary: Sultry nurse Claire Brightwell (Eva Pope) breezes into Cardale to shake up the practice, whilst Tom is involved in a climbing accident and Will's son Tony returns.

episodes:7767.name: Episode 2
episodes:7767.summary: Newcomer Claire wastes little time in making her presence felt at the practice and tries to seduce Tom, while Will wonders how many more revelations about his son he can take.

episodes:7767.name: Episode 3
episodes:7767.summary: The outbreak of a deadly epidemic puts strain on the practice, while Claire does her wicked best to drive a wedge between Alex and Tom.

episodes:7767.name: Episode 4
episodes:7767.summary: Claire is accused of stealing from a patient, and finds support from her colleagues in short supply, while a modern-day Noah gives Will cause for concern,

episodes:7767.name: Episode 5
episodes:7767.summary: Dashing new trainee doctor Matt Kendal has a baptism of fire on his first day at the Beeches, while Will's decision to turn away all non-urgent cases has disastrous consequences.

episodes:7767.name: Episode 6
episodes:7767.summary: A weekend away turns into chaos when an Army helicopter crashes, unearthing horrifying memories of the Balkan conflict for Alex and Claire, who race to save the casualties.

episodes:7767.name: Episode 7
episodes:7767.summary: Leanne is raped and left for dead, a trauma that sends the whole community into shock. Will apologises to Carol, while Matt and Shaun step up their rivalry on the football field.

episodes:7767.name: Episode 8
episodes:7767.summary: Tom takes the law into his own hands to nail the man who assaulted Leanne, while Kate grows increasingly frustrated by Will's mood swings.

episodes:7767.name: Episode 9
episodes:7767.summary: A runaway bride causes concern, while Claire's increasingly erratic behaviour worries Alex, and Kate starts spending more and more time with James.

episodes:7767.name: Episode 10
episodes:7767.summary: Claire provides a much-needed shoulder to cry on for Will, who is public enemy number one following the emergence of his plans to dissolve the Beeches partnership.

episodes:7767.name: Episode 11
episodes:7767.summary: Claire's true colours shine through as she accuses Will of rape, and Alex oversees the exhumation of a marine she believes was murdered by her mentally unstable colleague.

episodes:7767.name: Episode 12
episodes:7767.summary: Claire's disappearance has disturbing repercussions, while Will deals with a depressed gardener, and Shaun takes desperate measures to make himself more appealing to Kerri.

episodes:7767.name: Episode 13
episodes:7767.summary: Tim and Alex's wedding plans have to be put on hold as a cable car emergency demands their attention, and to make matters worse Claire turns up.

show:the texan.name: The Texan
show:the texan.summary: A Civil War veteran whose reputation of being the fastest gun in the west precedes him. He roams across Texas from town to town, not looking for trouble, but trouble finds him.

The Terrified Town
episodes:56283.summary: The governor summons Bill Longley and appoints him a special deputy to rid the town of Rio Nada of corruption. His first job is to determine the identity of the outlaw leader who controls the town.

episodes:56283.name: Sixgun Street
episodes:56283.summary: To stop Longley's attempt to clean up the town, gamblers pay some outlaws to ambush him. When this fails, they bring in a pair of professional gunmen: Luke Short and the Brazos Kid.

episodes:56283.name: The Taming of Rio Nada
episodes:56283.summary: As Longley pursues his search for the bandit leader known as El Sombro, gambling house proprietor Poker Alice save him from an ambish by her own partner Tim Craven.

episodes:56283.name: Town Divided
episodes:56283.summary: Bill tries to help a former commanding officer, now doctor, that has turned to drinking while his town falls apart amid a feud between two ranchers, and Bill tries to convince the man not to run away from the challenges he faces.

episodes:56283.name: The Guilty and the Innocent
episodes:56283.summary: An angry mob calls for the death of a young man convicted of killing a family of homesteaders, and Bill races in with a stay of execution as the group breaks into the jail to execute the prisoner.

show:barney and friends.name: Barney & Friends
show:barney and friends.summary: Barney & Friends is an American children's television series aimed at children from ages 1 to 8. show:candid camera.name: Candid Camera
show:candid camera.summary: Classic hidden camera reality series Candid Camera is returning to television with a new incarnation at TV Land from the series' long-time host, Peter Funt, son of creator and original host Allen Funt, and Electus‘ Ben Silverman.
