Operators at a call center get squirted during a video chat. A movie theater uses scanners to check patrons for illegal snack food

show:upstairs downstairs.name: Upstairs Downstairs
show:upstairs downstairs.summary: Revival of the iconic '70s series. Life in a London townhouse in the late 1930s, where the fates of the servants 'downstairs' and their masters 'upstairs' are intimately linked.

episodes:1047.name: The Fledgling
episodes:1047.summary: Sir Hallam Holland and his beautiful wife Lady Agnes inherit a dilapidated 165 Eaton Place, and set about restoring the house to its full glory. Former housemaid Rose Buck finds herself back in the house where she was happiest, but the arrival of an unwelcome guest puts a strain on relations, both upstairs and down.

episodes:1047.name: The Ladybird
episodes:1047.summary: With no sign of a thaw in relations between Lady Agnes and Maud, Hallam finds his diplomatic skills put to the test at home as well as at work. The servants are intrigued by a mysterious new addition to the household, while a restless Lady Persie embarks on a dangerous flirtation, and is drawn to the thrill of radical politics.

episodes:1047.name: The Cuckoo
episodes:1047.summary: Sir Hallam finds himself at the centre of a national crisis when his friend, the Duke of Kent, asks for help. Meanwhile, storm clouds are gathering within 165 Eaton Place, with Lady Agnes's growing fear over the imminent arrival of her baby, and the servants' concern for Lotte, who refuses to speak. But, as the king finally abdicates, Hallam makes a discovery that will change his life forever.

episodes:1047.name: A Faraway Country About Which We Know Nothing
episodes:1047.summary: As 165 Eaton Place reopens its doors, two new arrivals make their mark. But whilst Sir Hallam's forthright aunt Blanche disrupts life upstairs, feisty new maid Beryl struggles to adjust to life in service. Meanwhile, Lady Agnes' concern for her children reveals a dark secret about Mr Pritchard. Sir Hallam's preoccupation with burgeoning Nazi Germany leads him into dangerous waters, and a chance meeting with an unexpected face unlocks a hidden desire within.

episodes:1047.name: The Love That Pays the Price
episodes:1047.summary:
Lady Agnes catches the eye of charismatic American millionaire Caspar Landry but, as she and Sir Hallam look to their future, a tragic turn of events leaves their promised dreams - and a close family member - in jeopardy.

Downstairs, Mrs Thackeray makes a momentous decision, which throws the running of the house into chaos. Blanche and Mr Amanjit continue to clash, until a heart-breaking cause compels them to reconsider their differences.

episodes:1047.name: A Perfect Specimen of Womanhood
episodes:1047.summary:
Blanche comes face to face with her former lover when a scandalous novel is published and, when the passion between the pair reignites, begins to consider a life away from Eaton Place.

Downstairs, Beryl's decision to take a stand causes serious ructions to the running of the house until a familiar face offers wise words.

Meanwhile, when Lady Persie reveals a shocking secret to Sir Hallam, the pair get ever closer as Persie is forced to make a life changing decision about her future.

episodes:1047.name: All the Things You Are
episodes:1047.summary: Harry's desire to impress Beryl leads him and Johnny into the world of boxing and, as their big fight draws ever closer, the boys are determined to reign victorious. Upstairs, as she and Sir Hallam drift further apart, Lady Agnes is reacquainted with a familiar face who shows her an exciting world away from 165 Eaton Place; and Sir Hallam makes a dangerous decision which will change his life forever.

episodes:1047.name: The Last Waltz
episodes:1047.summary: As 165 Eaton Place prepares for the Annual Servants' Ball, Mr Pritchard enjoys a romance with fellow servant Miss Whisset, and starts to wonder if there is more to life than service. With war looming, Harry has a proposition for Beryl, however, a shock revelation threatens to thwart their plans. Meanwhile, as Lady Persie and Sir Hallam continue their dangerous affair, Sir Hallam is about to discover just how destructive his actions have been.

episodes:1047.name: Somewhere Over the Rainbow
episodes:1047.summary: On the eve of war, Beryl and Harry face a race against time to get married. Meanwhile, Mr Pritchard makes a decision which throws the running of the house into chaos, until an old face lends a helping hand. And as Lady Agnes returns to London, a dark discovery has explosive consequences for all inside Eaton Place and changes the landscape forever.

show:the baby sitters club.name: The Baby-Sitters Club
show:the baby sitters club.summary: Based on Ann M. Martin's best-selling book series, The Baby-Sitters Club follows the friendship and babysitting adventures of five best friends in Stoneybrook, Connecticut.

episodes:41167.name: Kristy's Great Idea
episodes:41167.summary: A creative concept comes to life as Kristy starts a club with her best friends — and a new classmate. But is she ready to be a team leader?

episodes:41167.name: Claudia and the Phantom Phone Calls
episodes:41167.summary: The spooky spirit of Halloween sweeps through Stoneybrook. Meanwhile, Claudia explores budding romance and struggles to connect with her parents.

episodes:41167.name: The Truth About Stacey
episodes:41167.summary: As competition heats up for the BSC, Stacey attempts to hide a personal secret and revisits a painful event from her past.

episodes:41167.name: Mary Anne Saves the Day
episodes:41167.summary: After dealing with a major dad dilemma, Mary Anne makes a dynamic new friend. Later, a medical emergency puts her caretaking skills to the test.

episodes:41167.name: Dawn and the Impossible Three
episodes:41167.summary: To prove herself to the BSC, Dawn agrees to babysit for a family of rowdy kids. Can she keep up with their mischief and mayhem?

episodes:41167.name: Claudia and Mean Janine
episodes:41167.summary: A family emergency triggers an emotional feud between Claudia and her older sister. Elsewhere, Mary Anne works to hide her feelings.

episodes:41167.name: Boy-Crazy Stacey
episodes:41167.summary: Mary Anne and Stacey team up for an out-of-town job: babysitting kids at the beach. But a cute new crush challenges business and friendship.

episodes:41167.name: Kristy's Big Day
episodes:41167.summary: Stoneybrook delights in a day of glitz and glamour as Kristy's mom prepares for a big day. Later, Kristy hits a major milestone, much to her surprise.

episodes:41167.name: Hello, Camp Moosehead! Part 1
episodes:41167.summary: The BSC braves the great outdoors at a summer sleepaway camp, where they explore archery, theater, activism ... and a dash of chilling mystery.

episodes:41167.name: Hello, Camp Moosehead! Part 2
episodes:41167.summary: As Stacey deals with a new normal, Kristy leads a crucial search, Dawn and Claudia start a revolution, and Mary Anne finds her place in the spotlight.

episodes:41167.name: Kristy and the Snobs
episodes:41167.summary: After moving in with Watson, Kristy navigates a not-so-warm neighborly welcome. The BSC helps Mary Anne define her post-camp relationship status.

episodes:41167.name: Claudia and the New Girl
episodes:41167.summary: A slumber party quiz sparks intrigue, uncertainty and an awkward beginning for Claudia and Mallory. Elsewhere, Kristy learns to let go of control.

episodes:41167.name: Stacey's Emergency
episodes:41167.summary: The BSC prepares to rule the runway as Stacey's special guests for a gala fashion show. But a series of concerning symptoms challenge the glitz and glam.

episodes:41167.name: Jessi and the Superbrat
episodes:41167.summary: Passion meets persistence as Jessi struggles with a rough patch in her ballet career, all while signing on to babysit a pint-sized vlogging superstar.

episodes:41167.name: Mary Anne and the Great Romance
episodes:41167.summary: As Dawn and Mary Anne await big news from their mom and dad, Logan sweeps in with a Valentine's Day surprise. But is it too much too soon?

episodes:41167.name: Dawn and the Wicked Stepsister
episodes:41167.summary: Worlds collide — and tension boils over — when Mary Anne and her dad move in with Dawn and her mom. The BSC plans a major party for Mallory's sister.

episodes:41167.name: Claudia and the Sad Goodbye
episodes:41167.summary: A heartbreaking turn of events redefines Claudia's life and — with loving support from her friends and family — pushes her out of her comfort zone.

episodes:41167.name: Kristy and the Baby Parade
episodes:41167.summary: The return of the Stoneybrook Baby Parade leads to a crafty (and chaotic) project for the BSC — and a bittersweet surprise for Kristy and her family.

show:death walker with nick groff.name: Death Walker with Nick Groff
show:death walker with nick groff.summary: Nick Groff theorises and investigates the origin of some of the most notorious hauntings in America, redefining our understanding of the paranormal. Death Walker: a person that walks among the dead.

previousepisode.name: Ghosts in the Herschell Carrousel Museum

episodes:54655.name: Space Time
episodes:54655.summary: Nick ventures into the Brushy Mountain Penitentiary in Tennessee and the Madison Seminary in Ohio to communicate with the ghosts that are tied to these locations.

episodes:54655.name: Stone Tape Theory
episodes:54655.summary: Nick investigates the 6th Precinct in Detroit and the House of Wills in Cleveland. Both locations have a dark history of death and tragedy.

episodes:54655.name: The Others
episodes:54655.summary: The owners of the Willis House Inn in Michigan call Nick to see if their inn is safe to open. Nick sleeps there to investigate how the entities will react.

episodes:54655.name: Masonic Mysteries
episodes:54655.summary: Nick visits The Octagon Hall, a property built by the secret society known as the Freemasons. During the investigation, he witnesses what appears to be a UFO.

episodes:54655.name: Thought Form Entity
episodes:54655.summary: Nick revisits two iconic haunted locations that changed his outlook on the paranormal, Bobby Mackey's Music World and the Washoe Club.

episodes:54655.name: The Sallie House
episodes:54655.summary: Nick visits the Sallie House in Atchison, Kansas. He attempts to get the entity known as Sallie to physically lash out at him so that he can capture it on camera.

episodes:54655.name: Broken Bow Asylum
episodes:54655.summary: Nick heads to the Broken Bow Asylum in Oklahoma. For two days, he attempts to interact with an aggressive spirit who's known to torment those who dare enter.

episodes:54655.name: Haunted Hill House
episodes:54655.summary: Nick sets out to investigate the Haunted Hill House in Mineral Wells, Texas, a sinister location where hundreds of people have left with mysterious bite marks.

episodes:54655.name: Northeastern Hospital
episodes:54655.summary: Nick has gained exclusive access to be the first to conduct a paranormal investigation in an abandoned hospital in the Northeastern region of the US.

episodes:54655.name: Kendrick House
episodes:54655.summary: Nick visits Kendrick House, the only pre-Civil War building that remains standing in Jasper County, Missouri. What will he encounter at this chilling property?

episodes:54655.name: Nazareth Hospital
episodes:54655.summary: Nick investigates the Nazareth hospital in Mineral Wells, Texas. The abandoned location has reports of disembodied cries and ghostly figures wandering the halls.

episodes:54655.name: Olde Park Hotel
episodes:54655.summary: The Olde Park Hotel located in Ballinger, Texas, has a past that is shrouded in mystery. Nick investigates the haunted building for two days and two nights.

episodes:54655.name: Myrtles Plantation
episodes:54655.summary: The Myrtles Plantation is shrouded in a controversial dark history. Nick and talented medium Tessa Del Zoppo investigate this iconic haunted location.

episodes:54655.name: McInteer Villa
episodes:54655.summary: Nick visits the McInteer Villa in Actinson, Kansas. He sleeps inside the room said to have the most paranormal activity to increase his chances of making contact.

episodes:54655.name: Electro Magnetic Sanitorium
episodes:54655.summary: Nick Groff is the first person to conduct a paranormal investigation at Electromagnetic Sanitorium. During his visit, he allows entities to attack him.

episodes:54655.name: Lavaca Jail
episodes:54655.summary: In Hallettsville, Texas, sits the old Lavaca Jail. Nick stays at the property for the next two days and focuses on making contact with an intelligent entity.

episodes:54655.name: Columbia Hospital
episodes:54655.summary: Nick investigates Columbia Hospital in Weatherford, Texas. He spends 48 hours inside the clinic, using new equipment to see if he can communicate with entities.

episodes:54655.name: Indiana State Asylum
episodes:54655.summary: Nick visits a sanatorium in Indiana with reports of paranormal activity. He tries to make physical contact with the deceased patients of the hospital.

episodes:54655.name: Niagra Club
episodes:54655.summary: Nick investigates the Niagara Club. He attempts to reveal the secrets of what occurred behind these walls that have long been shrouded in secrecy for so many years.

episodes:54655.name: New Orleans Spirits with Bloody Mary
episodes:54655.summary: Nick meets with Voodoo priestess and occult expert Bloody Mary in hopes that she can cleanse Nick’s body’s energy. Plus, he visits Bloody Mary’s haunted museum.

episodes:54655.name: Rolling Hills Asylum
episodes:54655.summary: Nick and Tessa investigate an asylum from 1827 with reports of paranormal activity. There, they attempt to contact the infamous screaming lady spirit

episodes:54655.name: Sweet Home Entity Doll
episodes:54655.summary: Nick and Tessa visit the Sweets Home Estate, where haunted items terrorise guests. Will the spirits reveal why they're lashing out at visitors?

episodes:54655.name: Bihl Manor Shadow Man
episodes:54655.summary: The paranormal investigator examines the origins of notorious hauntings in America

episodes:54655.name: Eastern Niagara Hospital
episodes:54655.summary: The paranormal investigator examines the origins of notorious hauntings in America

episodes:54655.name: Bell Mansion Funeral Home
episodes:54655.summary: The paranormal investigator examines the origins of notorious hauntings in America

episodes:54655.name: Haunted Frontier House
episodes:54655.summary: The paranormal investigator examines the origins of notorious hauntings in America

episodes:54655.name: The Chalkman Entity
episodes:54655.summary: Nick uses an enhanced audio device to make contact with the spirits in the basement of Westwood School and uncover the secrets of the past.

episodes:54655.name: Fort Niagara Barracks
episodes:54655.summary: Nick and Tessa have been given exclusive access to be the first ones to conduct a paranormal investigation inside the abandoned Fort Niagara Barracks.

episodes:54655.name: Supernatural Church
episodes:54655.summary: Nick investigates the spirits haunting the 1895 Methodist Episcopal church. Visitors report apparitions of a young girl and an aggressive older woman.

episodes:54655.name: Genesee Falls Inn
episodes:54655.summary: Nick and Tessa stay overnight at the Genesee Falls Inn and attempt to make contact with the many intelligent spirits said to haunt this old inn.

episodes:54655.name: Haunted Stagecoach Inn
episodes:54655.summary: Nick visits the Old Stagecoach also known as the Palmyra Center Hotel. During the investigation, he tries to contact the spirits haunting the old inn.

episodes:54655.name: Wildwood Sanitarium
episodes:54655.summary: The owner of the Wildwood Sanitarium reports seeing shadow figures, orbs and many EVPs. Nick and Tessa join scientist John Griffin to investigate.

episodes:54655.name: Return to the Western Block
episodes:54655.summary: Nick returns to the haunted Western Block for further investigation.

episodes:54655.name: Ghosts at Marjim Manor
episodes:54655.summary: Nick and Tessa investigate the aggressive entities at the Marjim Manor.

episodes:54655.name: A Haunting at Rapids Theater
episodes:54655.summary: Nick and Tessa seek to connect with a spirit at the Bellevue Theatre.

episodes:54655.name: Death at a Strip Club
episodes:54655.summary: Nick and Tessa attempt to contact an elusive shadow figure at a strip club.

episodes:54655.name: Spirits of Dunkirk Lighthouse
episodes:54655.summary: Nick and Tessa try to contact an aggressive entity at Dunkirk Lighthouse.

episodes:54655.name: Genesee Falls Inn: Night 2
episodes:54655.summary: Nick's haunting investigation of the Genesee Falls Inn continues.

episodes:54655.name: Haunted Hinsdale House Part 1
episodes:54655.summary: Nick and Tessa undertake an overnight investigation at the Hinsdale House.

episodes:54655.name: Haunted Hinsdale House Part 2
episodes:54655.summary: Nick and Tessa extend their chilling investigation of the Hinsdale House.

episodes:54655.name: Demon at the McCoy House
episodes:54655.summary: Nick and Tessa Groff investigate a family home overtaken by a violent entity bound to the bloodline, where shadow figures, chilling screams, and escalating attacks threaten to consume anyone who dares to uncover the truth.

episodes:54655.name: The Shadow Man
episodes:54655.summary: Nick and Tessa Groff return to Iron Island, a historic site haunted by shadow figures and a violent presence that once attacked Tessa, to confront the dark force that refuses to stay buried.

episodes:54655.name: Ghostlight Theater
episodes:54655.summary: Nick and Tessa Groff investigate the haunted Ghostlight Theatre, where a restless history, a Lady in Red, and a menacing Shadow Man threaten to turn a stage for the living into a portal for the dead.

episodes:54655.name: Haunted Family Home
episodes:54655.summary: Nick and Tessa Groff investigate a family home where a child's connection to an unseen presence and escalating paranormal encounters suggest a dark force may be hiding behind the veil of a haunting.

episodes:54655.name: Ghosts of Renwick Manor
episodes:54655.summary: Nick and Tessa Groff investigate the Renwick House, a historic refuge turned paranormal hotspot, to determine whether its ghostly activity stems from restless spirits of the past or a darker presence that has made the manor its own.

episodes:54655.name: Haunted Mansion
episodes:54655.summary: Nick and Tessa Groff investigate a historic mansion plagued by voices, shadows, and unexplained movement to determine whether its hauntings are remnants of the past or signs of something more disturbing taking hold.

episodes:54655.name: Graestone Manor
episodes:54655.summary: Nick and Tessa Groff enter Graestone Manor, a Victorian mansion haunted by imitative voices, shadow figures, and a link to unmarked graves, to uncover whether the spirits are trapped by history or stirred by something far more powerful.

episodes:54655.name: Haunted Red Brick School
episodes:54655.summary: Nick and Tessa Groff investigate a historic schoolhouse where disembodied voices and ghostly figures reveal a haunting far more intelligent and watchful than anyone imagined.

episodes:54655.name: Lewiston Haunted Library
episodes:54655.summary: Nick and Tessa Groff investigate a historic library haunted by shadowy figures and a silent clock tied to a lingering presence, searching for answers buried in a place where knowledge and the paranormal collide.

episodes:54655.name: The Banshee Spirits
episodes:54655.summary: Nick and Tessa Groff investigate The Banshee Irish Pub, where unexplained activity hints at either residual energy or an intelligent force waiting to make itself known.

episodes:54655.name: The Legion Haunting
episodes:54655.summary: Nick and Tessa Groff investigate the American Legion in Kenmore, where shifting shadows and ghostly voices suggest that fallen soldiers may still gather, or that something else is keeping watch in the dark.

episodes:54655.name: Haunted Bloodline
episodes:54655.summary: Nick and Tessa Groff investigate a family home where unexplained activity raises a chilling question: is a protective spirit watching over the residents, or has something darker latched onto their bloodline?

episodes:54655.name: Ghosts at Riviera Theater
episodes:54655.summary: Nick and Tessa Groff investigate the historic Riviera Theatre, where unexplained voices and shadow figures suggest that the curtain never truly closed for the spirits still roaming its halls.

episodes:54655.name: Haunted Boarding School
episodes:54655.summary: Nick and Tessa Groff investigate the Alexander Lane house in Lewiston, where stories of a restless spirit and a violent past point to something far more ancient than a single haunting.

episodes:54655.name: Barton Hill Ghosts
episodes:54655.summary: Nick and Tessa Groff investigate Barton Hill Mansion, a centuries-old estate built on land scarred by war and tragedy, where the ghosts of the past may be hiding something far more unsettling.

episodes:54655.name: Apartment Haunting
episodes:54655.summary: Nick and Tessa Groff investigate the Miller Mackey House in Lancaster, New York, where unexplained activity points to a haunting that may go beyond former residents.

episodes:54655.name: Ghosts at District 8
episodes:54655.summary: Nick and Tessa Groff investigate a 19th-century schoolhouse in Youngstown, New York, where unexplained activity suggests former students, or something far more unsettling, may still be inside.

episodes:54655.name: Phantom Residence
episodes:54655.summary: Nick and Tessa Groff investigate a family home in Sloan, New York, where unexplained activity and a tragic history suggest that not everyone who died there has moved on.

episodes:54655.name: Haunted Eagle House
episodes:54655.summary: Nick and Tessa Groff investigate the Eagle House Restaurant in Williamsville, New York, where unexplained activity suggests the spirits of the past may not be the only ones still present.

episodes:54655.name: Ghosts in the Herschell Carrousel Museum
episodes:54655.summary: Nick and Tessa Groff investigate the Herschell Carrousel Factory in North Tonawanda, New York, where strange activity may point to the spirits of former workers or to something much older hidden beneath the surface.

show:ben.name: Ben
show:ben.summary: A recently divorced reporter moves back to her hometown of Nantes with her daughter, but painful memories await her there… When she was just 16, her Jehovah's Witness parents forced her to give up her newborn son, a decision that drove her to run away from home and leave Nantes.
